title: 物品图标：装备、套组件、生成型装备与附纹

subject.zh: 一把锈蚀的铁短剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。剑身铁灰#7a7f88爬满橙褐锈斑，刃口两处缺口；护手上残留半个磨平的圆形压印；握柄缠褪色旧布条，用细绳补扎。整体发暗，没有亮点。
subject.en: A rusted iron shortsword lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. The iron-grey #7a7f88 blade is crawling with orange-brown rust and has two notches in the edge; the crossguard keeps half of a worn-flat round stamp; the grip is wrapped in faded old cloth tied back on with string. Dull overall, no highlight points.

items.notes: 品质语言（劣品）：锈斑、缺口、褪色，没有高光点。劣品：锈斑与缺口要明显，不加高光；比新兵长剑更短更旧，护手半个压印是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一把素面铁长剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。剑身铁灰#7a7f88笔直无纹，刃口干净；十字护手是一根简单铁条，握柄整齐缠着深褐硬革#6a4226，柄尾一颗圆铁球。没有纹饰，没有发光。
subject.en: A plain iron longsword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. Straight unadorned iron-grey #7a7f88 blade with a clean edge; the crossguard is a simple iron bar, the grip is neatly wrapped in dark brown hardened leather #6a4226, and the pommel is a round iron ball. No decoration, no glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（凡品）：素面实用，无纹不发光。凡品制式剑：比锈蚀短剑更长更干净，不能有刻纹或任何光，与行会剑、授剑区分。

subject.zh: 一张普通木猎弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。弓身中褐#8a6040，素面无纹，上臂有一处天然木节；握把缠一段皮革#8a5a34，弦是本色麻弦。简单实用，不发光。
subject.en: A plain wooden hunting bow, upright and slightly tilted, back of the bow facing left, string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. Mid-brown #8a6040 wood, unadorned, with a natural knot on the upper limb; the grip is wrapped in leather #8a5a34 and the string is undyed hemp. Simple and practical, no glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（凡品）：素面实用，无纹不发光。凡品弓：素木加皮握把，短而单曲；与北境长弓（更高、铆钉毛皮）和复合弓区分。

subject.zh: 一根橡木法杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。中褐橡木杖身#8a6040略有弯曲，杖头是一团天然卷曲的木瘤，木瘤下箍一圈铁箍#7a7f88。素面无纹，不镶晶石，不发光。
subject.en: An oak staff lying at 45 degrees, butt at lower left and head at upper right. A slightly crooked mid-brown oak shaft #8a6040, its head a naturally curled knot of burl with a single iron band #7a7f88 below it. Unadorned, no crystal set in it, no glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（凡品）：素面实用，无纹不发光。凡品法杖：只有木瘤和一道铁箍，不镶晶、不刻纹；与北泉苇杖的节节苇秆区分。

subject.zh: 一把灰牙匕首，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刃尖在右上。刃身是一枚弯长的灰白兽牙#b8b4ac，牙根套铁箍，箍上一道暗一阶的细刻纹；握柄缠整齐的皮条#8a5a34。牙面散着几处灰中带紫的斑点。
subject.en: A grey-fang dagger at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and tip at upper right. The blade is a long curved grey-white beast fang #b8b4ac seated in an iron collar that carries one fine engraved line a shade darker; the grip is neatly wrapped in leather strips #8a5a34. A few grey spots tinged with purple dot the fang.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。第一件灰器：灰紫斑只几处，要克制；刻纹不发光；兽牙刃与剥皮刀的铁弯刃区分。

subject.zh: 一柄单手劈刀斧，斜放45度，握柄在左下、斧头在右上。宽方的铁斧刃#7a7f88，刃根一道暗一阶的细刻纹；厚刀背蒙着一层灰烬色，灰里散着几处灰中带紫的斑点。木柄#8a6040缠皮，柄尾包铁。
subject.en: A one-handed cleaver axe at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A broad squared iron blade #7a7f88 with one fine engraved line a shade darker at its root; the thick spine is coated in ash grey with a few purple-tinged grey spots in it. Leather-wrapped wooden haft #8a6040 with an iron-capped butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。灰只在刀背，刃口保持铁色；方头单手劈刀形，与双手伐木斧、老兵斧区分。

subject.zh: 一把晶脊长剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。蓝灰澱钢剑身#5a6a80，剑脊上一排浑浊灰晶#8a8a90短刺像蜈蚣背；多道刻纹顺刃走，纹槽透极淡的澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过剑面；护手精致，镶一枚菱形匠记。
subject.en: A crystal-spined longsword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A blue-grey steel blade #5a6a80 with a row of short murky grey crystal spikes #8a8a90 along the spine like a centipede's back; several engraved lines follow the blade with a very faint dusky purple glow in the grooves, and thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep across the flat. A finely made crossguard set with a small diamond-shaped maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。剑脊晶刺是标志，晶质须与钟鸣晶一致；中档澱纹只是细纹，不要整片发紫。

subject.zh: 一面量产的旧木圆盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。中褐木板#8a6040拼成，外缘包一圈生皮，中央一个凹进一块的铁盾心#7a7f88；盾面有几处浅坑和刮痕。素面无纹，不发光。
subject.en: A mass-produced old wooden round shield, front-facing three-quarter view tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. Planks of mid-brown wood #8a6040 with a rawhide-bound rim and a central iron boss #7a7f88 with a dent pushed into it; a few shallow pits and scratches on the face. No decoration, no glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（凡品）：素面实用，无纹不发光。凡品量产盾：凹坑是辨识点，但不能锈烂补丁像劣品；圆形，与鸢盾、塔盾区分。

subject.zh: 一件旧皮背心，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。中褐皮革#8a5a34，无袖，前襟用三根皮绳系住；肩头和下摆磨得发白，颜色深浅不匀。素面无纹，没有金属件，不发光。
subject.en: An old leather vest seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Sleeveless mid-brown leather #8a5a34 laced shut with three leather thongs; the shoulders and hem are rubbed pale and the colour is uneven. Plain, no metal fittings, no glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（凡品）：素面实用，无纹不发光。凡品二手货：磨白处要有，但不画破洞补丁；无金属件，与钉甲、突袭者皮甲区分。

subject.zh: 一只狼皮短靴，侧前四分之三视角，鞋尖朝左下。靴身是中褐皮革#8a5a34，靴口翻出一圈蓬松的灰狼毛#8a8a86；鞋底一层硬皮，靴侧绑一根皮绳。素面无纹，不发光。
subject.en: A single wolfhide ankle boot, front-side three-quarter view, toe pointing lower left. Mid-brown leather #8a5a34 body with a fluffy rolled cuff of grey wolf fur #8a8a86 at the top, a hard leather sole, and one leather thong tied around the side. Plain, no glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（凡品）：素面实用，无纹不发光。凡品短靴：灰狼毛翻口是辨识点，靴身素面；与水道长靴、泥巷巨口皮靴区分长短。

subject.zh: 一只蛛丝手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。灰白丝料#c8c8c4织得极细，有一道柔光；五指修长贴合，手背中央一道暗一阶的细绣线，袖口用同色丝线细细包边，食指尖垂着一缕细丝。不发光。
subject.en: A single spider-silk glove, back of the hand outward, fingers pointing upper right. Very finely woven grey-white silk #c8c8c4 with one soft sheen; slim close-fitting fingers, a single fine stitched line a shade darker across the back of the hand, a neat same-colour silk binding at the cuff, and one loose strand of silk trailing from the index fingertip. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。灰丝柔光与指尖一缕丝是辨识点；修长五指薄手套，与焚书者灰手套的焦黑指尖区分。

subject.zh: 一顶骸骨盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。古旧的灰烬色铁盔#6a6660，额板有一个小小的门形镂空，颊甲是两片泛黄骨片；磨平的古纹旁钉着两颗新铆钉，额板下沿一道暗一阶的细刻纹。不发光。
subject.en: A bone helm in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. An ancient ash-coloured iron helm #6a6660 with a small door-shaped cutout in the brow plate and two yellowed bone plates as cheek guards; two new rivets sit beside worn-flat old patterns, and one fine engraved line a shade darker runs under the brow. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。拾遗作最早样本：门形镂空小而清楚，古纹配新铆钉；良品不发光，不用门扉金。

subject.zh: 一枚鸦羽护符，居中，上方带一小段黑系绳。一根乌黑大鸦羽#1e2028，羽面泛蓝色光泽，羽尖一点银白；羽根套着银箍#d0d4dc，箍上多道细刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光#a8e0d8，箍底一枚小三角匠记。
subject.en: A raven-quill charm, centred, with a short black cord above. One large jet-black raven feather #1e2028 with a blue sheen across the vane and a silver-white tip; its quill sits in a silver collar #d0d4dc whose several fine engraved lines let out a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e0d8, with a tiny triangular maker's mark at the base.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。大黑羽要清晰、银箍有微光；与雀羽香囊（布袋加小褐羽）区分开。

subject.zh: 一对水道长靴式皮护腿，正面，两条腿并列。涂蜡的暗苔褐皮革#4a4630泛着湿光，长及大腿，腰侧一枚圆形栅格纹铜扣#c87a48（水道行者共用徽记）；膝头加厚，左膝护片一道暗一阶的细刻纹，下缘沾着干泥。
subject.en: A pair of wader-style leather leggings, front view, both legs side by side. Waxed dark moss-brown leather #4a4630 with a damp sheen, reaching the thigh, with a round grate-patterned copper buckle #c87a48 at the hip (the shared Waterway Walker emblem); thickened knees, one fine engraved line a shade darker on the left knee plate, and dried mud along the bottom.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。水道行者套组腿件：暗苔褐涂蜡皮与圆栅格铜扣须与B04的头、胸、手三件统一。

subject.zh: 一件门徒会长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。深炭灰布料#3a3638，宽袖垂到下摆，兜帽堆在肩后；胸前缝一枚暗红色的同心圆几何纹章#7a3030，纹章下一道暗一阶的细绣线。不发光。
subject.en: A cultist robe from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Deep charcoal cloth #3a3638 with wide sleeves hanging to the hem and a hood bunched behind the shoulders; a dark red concentric-circle geometric emblem #7a3030 is sewn on the chest, with one fine stitched line a shade darker beneath it. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。胸前暗红同心圆纹章是辨识点，不加紫也不用门扉金；与慈济院灰白袍区分。

subject.zh: 一副灰烬骑士胸铠，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。古旧灰烬色板甲#5e5a56，胸板中央一个门形镂空，磨平古纹间钉着新铆钉；多道刻纹顺甲片走，纹槽透极淡的澱紫微光，暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过胸板，肩甲边一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: An ashen knight's breastplate from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Ancient ash-coloured plate #5e5a56 with a door-shaped cutout at the centre of the chest and new rivets set among worn-flat old patterns; several engraved lines follow the plates with a very faint dusky purple glow in the grooves, dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the chest, and a small square maker's mark sits on the pauldron edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。拾遗作精品：胸口门形镂空，古纹配新铆钉；中档澱纹是细纹，不加边缘暗雾。

subject.zh: 一对亚龙鳞腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。锁子底衬上层层叠着暗青铜绿的大鳞片#4e5a40，鳞缘泛冷光；多道刻纹顺腿甲走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光#a8e0d8，膝甲是一枚完整的尖角大鳞，腰带扣上一枚小菱形匠记。
subject.en: A pair of drake-scale leggings, front view, both legs side by side. Large dark bronze-green scales #4e5a40 overlap in rows on a mail backing, their edges catching a cold sheen; several engraved lines run down the legs with a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e0d8 in the grooves, each knee guard is a single whole pointed scale, and a small diamond maker's mark sits on the belt buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。层叠尖鳞是主轮廓，膝头整片尖角大鳞是辨识点；不加紫，与鲶王的圆鳞背心区分。

subject.zh: 一把剥皮刀，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刃尖在右上。弯而薄的铁刃#7a7f88像一弯新月，刃背靠根部一道暗一阶的细刻纹；鹿角握柄#c8b890打磨光滑，柄尾穿一根短皮绳，串一颗小木珠。不发光。
subject.en: A skinning knife at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and tip at upper right. A thin curved iron blade #7a7f88 shaped like a crescent, with one fine engraved line a shade darker on the spine near the root; a smooth polished antler handle #c8b890 with a short leather thong and a small wooden bead through the butt. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。月牙形薄弯刃与鹿角柄是辨识点；良品刻纹不发光，与灰牙匕首的兽牙刃区分。

subject.zh: 一只雀羽香囊，居中，上方带一小段麻系绳。本色布小袋#d8c8a8鼓鼓的，袋口扎紧，插着一根褐白相间的小雀羽，旁边露出两片灰绿干草叶；袋面一道暗一阶的细绣线。不发光。
subject.en: A sparrow-feather sachet, centred, with a short hemp cord above. A plump little pouch of undyed cloth #d8c8a8 tied tight at the neck, with a small brown-and-white sparrow feather tucked in and two grey-green dried herb leaves peeking out beside it; one fine stitched line a shade darker across the front. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。布袋是主体，雀羽小、草叶灰绿；与鸦羽护符（大黑羽加银箍）区分。

subject.zh: 一只熊掌护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。厚实的中褐皮革#8a5a34，指节上缝着一排泛黄的熊掌骨片，腕口缠着红与赭两色彩绳；最大一块骨片上一道暗一阶的细刻纹。不发光。
subject.en: A single bear-paw gauntlet, back of the hand outward, fingers pointing upper right. Thick mid-brown leather #8a5a34 with a row of yellowed bear-paw bone plates sewn over the knuckles and red-and-ochre coloured cords wound around the wrist; one fine engraved line a shade darker on the largest bone plate. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。骨角作：指节骨片与彩绳是辨识点；厚实粗犷，与蛛丝手套、歪手套区分。

subject.zh: 一杆卫队长枪，斜放45度占满对角线，枪头在右上。叶形铁枪头#7a7f88下套铁箍，箍上一道暗一阶的细刻纹；中褐木杆#8a6040上刻着一排整齐的短竖痕，握处缠皮。不发光。
subject.en: A watch spear lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, spearhead at upper right. A leaf-shaped iron head #7a7f88 above an iron collar carrying one fine engraved line a shade darker; the mid-brown wooden shaft #8a6040 is cut with a neat row of short vertical notches, and leather wraps the grip. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。木杆上一排短竖痕是辨识点，不能画成字；与比武长枪的红白漆杆、斧戟区分。

subject.zh: 一枚铜环戒，单枚，倾斜约30度露出戒面。赭橙铜#c87a48，戒面是一块扁平方牌，正中一道暗一阶的横向刻线；戒圈内侧带点铜绿#5a9a80，缝里嵌着几粒细白盐晶。不发光。
subject.en: A copper ring, single, tilted about 30 degrees to show its face. Ochre-orange copper #c87a48 with a flat square plate for a face, one fine horizontal engraved line a shade darker across its centre; a touch of verdigris #5a9a80 inside the band, with a few tiny white salt crystals caught in the crevices. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。方牌戒面只一道横刻线，不写字；盐粒与铜绿是辨识点，与灌铅骰戒区分。

subject.zh: 一把伐木长柄斧，斜放45度占满对角线，斧头在右上。窄而深的铁斧刃#7a7f88，斧颈一道暗一阶的细刻纹；长木柄#8a6040略弯，柄身砍出几道斜向防滑槽，缠两圈整齐皮条，柄尾挂一个小铁环。不发光。
subject.en: A long-hafted felling axe lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, head at upper right. A narrow, deep iron bit #7a7f88 with one fine engraved line a shade darker on the neck; a long, slightly curved wooden haft #8a6040 cut with a few slanted grip grooves, two neat leather wraps, and a small iron ring at the butt. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。双手伐木斧：窄深斧刃加长弯柄；与单手灰烬劈刀、宽月刃老兵斧区分。

subject.zh: 一盏守墓人提灯，直立，四分之三视角。铁框方灯#4a4e55，顶上一个提环；灯罩糊着泛黄旧纸，纸上是褪色的几何墨线纹，里面一点暗黄烛光；灯顶下缘一道暗一阶的细刻纹。
subject.en: A gravekeeper's lantern, upright, three-quarter view. A square iron-framed lamp #4a4e55 with a carrying ring on top; the panes are pasted with yellowed old paper covered in faded geometric ink lines, a dim yellow candle glows inside, and one fine engraved line a shade darker runs under the lamp's cap.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。糊纸灯罩上只画几何墨线，不能像文字；方铁框，与黑曜尖顶灯、海烛区分。

subject.zh: 一只孤儿院手织的歪手套，单只，手背朝外，指端朝右上。米褐毛线#d8c8a8拼织一截红褐毛线，针脚歪歪扭扭，拇指位置偏高，袖口一边长一边短；手背一道暗一阶的细绣线。不发光。
subject.en: A crooked hand-knitted mitten from an orphanage, single, back outward, fingertips pointing upper right. Oatmeal wool #d8c8a8 knitted together with a stretch of reddish-brown yarn, with wobbly stitches, a thumb set too high, and a cuff longer on one side than the other; one fine stitched line a shade darker across the back. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。连指毛线手套，歪斜不对称是辨识点；是良品不是劣品，不画破洞和补丁。

subject.zh: 一顶灰鬃猎帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。中褐软皮帽#8a5a34，后颈垂着一溜灰狼鬃毛#8a8a86；帽沿彩绘一圈赭红与白的锯齿猎纹，额前一道暗一阶的细刻纹。不发光。
subject.en: A grey-mane hunter's cap in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. A soft mid-brown leather cap #8a5a34 with a strip of grey wolf mane #8a8a86 hanging down the back of the neck; the brim is painted with a band of ochre-red and white zigzag hunting marks, and one fine engraved line a shade darker crosses the brow. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。帽沿赭红白锯齿彩绘与后颈灰鬃是辨识点；与灰鼠兜帽（面巾、无毛）区分。

subject.zh: 一顶旧矿工铁盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。圆顶铁盔#7a7f88带短帽檐，盔顶焊着一个空的铜灯石座#c87a48；盔面有煤灰擦痕，内檐一排无字压印，额前一道暗一阶的细刻纹。不发光。
subject.en: An old miner's iron helm in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. A round-topped iron helm #7a7f88 with a short brim and an empty copper lamp-stone mount #c87a48 welded on the crown; coal-dust smudges on the shell, a row of wordless stamped marks along the inner brim, and one fine engraved line a shade darker across the brow. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。盔顶灯座是主辨识点，座里空着不发光；内檐压印不能像数字或字。

subject.zh: 一件拾荒者灰布外套，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。厚实的灰褐粗布#8a8478，前襟缝着好几个大口袋，肩上罩一块挡风披片；胸口一道暗一阶的细绣线，布面散着几处灰中带紫的斑点。
subject.en: A scavenger's grey cloth coat from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Heavy grey-brown coarse cloth #8a8478 with several big pockets sewn on the front and a windbreak cape over the shoulders; one fine stitched line a shade darker on the chest, and a few purple-tinged grey spots scattered over the cloth.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。轻档澱纹只是几处斑点；大口袋与挡风披片是辨识点，与门徒会长袍区分。

subject.zh: 一根北泉苇杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。杖身是一根粗老苇秆，浅黄绿#b8b070，节节分明；杖头几片干苇叶向上散开，叶下缠一圈细麻绳，一个苇节上有一道暗一阶的细刻纹。不发光。
subject.en: A reed staff at 45 degrees, butt at lower left and head at upper right. The shaft is one thick old reed stalk in pale yellow-green #b8b070 with clearly marked joints; a few dried reed leaves fan upward at the head over a wrap of fine hemp cord, and one fine engraved line a shade darker sits on a joint. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。节节分明的浅黄绿苇秆是辨识点；与橡木法杖的木瘤头区分，不镶晶。

subject.zh: 一只礼拜堂旧香炉，直立，四分之三视角。暗黄铜色钟铜炉身#b08840，圆腹带镂空炉盖，上方三根细链汇成一个提环；炉腹一道暗一阶的细刻纹，表面留着擦不掉的旧烟熏色，盖孔飘出一缕淡烟。不发光。
subject.en: An old chapel censer, upright, three-quarter view. A round-bellied bell-bronze body #b08840 with a pierced lid, three thin chains rising to one carrying ring; one fine engraved line a shade darker around the belly, old smoke stains that never quite came off, and a thin wisp of smoke from the lid holes. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。良品不发光，不加神光白金也绝不加紫；三链提环与镂空盖是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一把比武剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。修长的精钢剑身#a8b0bc，刃口一线高光，中段有一处磨平的旧缺口；多道刻纹顺剑脊走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光#a8e0d8；一字护手带一个侧环，柄尾一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A dueling sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A slender fine-steel blade #a8b0bc with a bright line on the edge and one ground-smooth old nick midway; several engraved lines follow the ridge with a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e0d8 in the grooves, a straight crossguard with one side ring, and a small round maker's mark on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一字护手加侧环与中段旧缺口是辨识点；与宫廷细剑的鎏金回旋篮柄区分。

subject.zh: 一件钉甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。深褐硬革#6a4226下衬铁片，表面一排排铁铆钉#7a7f88；多道刻纹沿铆钉行走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光，领口内衬露出一角缝着的无字布签，腰侧一枚小菱形匠记。
subject.en: A brigandine from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Dark brown hardened leather #6a4226 over hidden iron plates, studded with rows of iron rivets #7a7f88; several engraved lines run along the rivet rows with a very faint pale cyan glow in the grooves, a wordless cloth tag sewn into the lining peeks out at the collar, and a small diamond maker's mark sits at the hip.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。成排铆钉是主轮廓，领口露出的无字布签是辨识点；与旧皮背心、鳞背心区分。

subject.zh: 一枚骰戒，单枚，倾斜约30度露出戒面。银戒圈#d0d4dc，戒面镶一颗小骨骰，朝上一面是几个黑圆点，侧面嵌着一粒暗灰铅芯；戒圈上多道细刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，内侧一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: A die ring, single, tilted about 30 degrees to show its face. A silver band #d0d4dc set with a small bone die, its upper face marked with a few black pips and one side plugged with a speck of dull grey lead; several fine engraved lines on the band let out a very faint pale cyan glow, with a small square maker's mark inside.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。骨骰戒面是主辨识点，骰面只画圆点；铅芯小而可见，与盐巷铜环区分。

subject.zh: 一把行会师傅剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢剑身#a8b0bc整洁笔直，刃口一线高光；剑格方正合身，正中压着一枚锤形印；多道刻纹顺剑身走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光，柄尾一枚小六角匠记。
subject.en: A guild master's sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A clean, straight fine-steel blade #a8b0bc with a bright line on the edge; a neat, well-fitted squared crossguard stamped at its centre with a hammer-shaped mark; several engraved lines follow the blade with a very faint pale cyan glow in the grooves, and a small hexagonal maker's mark on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。河谷行会作：剑格的锤形印必须清楚，整洁合身；与授剑的溪流纹圆章区分。

subject.zh: 一柄白钟银锤，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锤头在右上。银色锤头#d0d4dc铸成一口带凸棱的小钟形，钟面嵌白釉；多道对称刻纹绕锤头走，纹槽透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0；银柄缠白皮，柄尾一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A white-bell silver mace at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. The silver head #d0d4dc is cast as a small flanged bell inlaid with white enamel; several symmetrical engraved lines circle the head with a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0 in the grooves, the silver haft is wrapped in white leather, and a small round maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。钟形锤头是辨识点；教会之物只用白银与白金，绝不加紫；与赦罪锤、祝圣锤区分。

subject.zh: 一张北境橡心长弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。修长的深褐橡心木弓身#6a4628，两梢套灰角片；握把缠硬革，钉两颗粗大铁铆钉，外裹一圈毛皮；多道刻纹顺弓臂走透淡青微光，一处未打磨的修补痕，握把旁一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A northern oakheart longbow, upright and slightly tilted, back facing left, string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. Long dark brown oakheart limbs #6a4628 tipped with grey horn nocks; the grip is wrapped in hardened leather with two heavy iron rivets and a collar of fur; several engraved lines run along the limbs with a faint pale cyan glow, one unpolished repair mark on a limb, and a small maker's mark by the grip.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。灰墙作：粗铆钉、毛皮握把、修补痕；单曲长弓比猎弓高得多，与复合弓区分。

subject.zh: 一把铁闸营劲弩，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，握把在右下。厚重的铁弩臂#7a7f88，中褐木弩身#8a6040包铁边，前端挂一个上弦踏环；多道刻纹沿弩臂走透淡青微光，弩身侧压一块小栅门格纹铁片与一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: A heavy crossbow with the bow arms across the top and the stock angled down to the right, grip at lower right. Thick iron bow arms #7a7f88 on a mid-brown wooden stock #8a6040 edged in iron, with a stirrup for spanning at the front; several engraved lines run along the arms with a faint pale cyan glow, and a little portcullis-grid iron plate plus a small square maker's mark sit on the side of the stock.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。前端踏环与厚铁弩臂表现劲弩；侧面栅门格纹铁片是辨识点，比翼魔手弩大一圈。

subject.zh: 一把灰鼠细锥，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锥尖在右上。三棱细长的精钢锥身#a8b0bc，尖端一点高光；多道刻纹顺棱走，透出极淡的浅青微光；暗灰握柄是空心的，柄尾一个可旋开的小圆盖，盖上一枚细弧线匠记。
subject.en: A grey-rat stiletto at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A long, thin three-sided fine-steel spike #a8b0bc with a glint at the tip; several engraved lines follow the edges with a very faint pale cyan glow; the dark grey grip is hollow, ending in a small screw-off round cap stamped with a fine curved-line maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。无刃三棱锥身是辨识点，柄尾圆盖暗示空心；与剥皮刀、灰牙匕首区分。

subject.zh: 一件细羊毛法衣，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。近白细羊毛#ece6d8垂坠平整，立领与前襟镶一道蓝灰包边#5a6a7a；多道细绣纹沿前襟下行，透出极淡的浅青微光，袖口细褶整齐，领扣是一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A fine-wool vestment from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Near-white fine wool #ece6d8 hanging smooth, with a blue-grey trim #5a6a7a on the standing collar and front edges; several fine embroidered lines run down the front with a very faint pale cyan glow, neat small pleats at the cuffs, and a little round maker's mark as the collar clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。近白细羊毛加蓝灰包边，干净体面；与慈济院灰白袍（袖口补丁）、诵经袍区分。

subject.zh: 一顶卫兵长铁盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。精钢盔身#a8b0bc带护鼻与宽盔檐，盔檐上一道发亮的新砍痕斜切而过；多道刻纹顺盔脊走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光，盔顶一束短红缨，颊甲边一枚小菱形匠记。
subject.en: A guard captain's helm in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. Fine-steel shell #a8b0bc with a nasal guard and a broad brim, a bright fresh sword cut slashing diagonally across the brim; several engraved lines follow the crest with a very faint pale cyan glow, a short red plume on top, and a small diamond maker's mark on the cheek guard edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盔檐上的新砍痕必须明亮清晰；红缨与护鼻，与灰墙前排盔的灰横条区分。

subject.zh: 一枚秤纹胸针，坠子居中，上方一小段金链。鲜亮的镀金圆牌#d8a840，中央浮雕一架小天平，两盘一高一低；外圈多道细刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，边缘一圈小珠粒，底缘一枚小三角匠记。
subject.en: A scale-pattern brooch, centred, with a short gold chain above. A bright gilded round plate #d8a840 embossed at its centre with a small balance, one pan higher than the other; several fine engraved lines around the rim let out a very faint pale cyan glow, a ring of tiny beads edges it, and a small triangular maker's mark sits at the bottom.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。镀金圆牌浮雕倾斜小天平；与审判庭天平徽（银白、整枚做成水平天平）区分。

subject.zh: 一杆比武长枪，斜放45度占满对角线，枪尖在右上。长锥形枪身漆成红白相间的螺旋条纹，握处套一个精钢喇叭形护手盘#a8b0bc；护手盘上多道刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，顶端是精钢尖头，护盘边一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A tourney lance lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, tip at upper right. A long tapering shaft painted in red-and-white spiral stripes, with a fine-steel trumpet-shaped vamplate #a8b0bc over the grip; several engraved lines on the vamplate glow very faintly pale cyan, the tip is a fine-steel point, and a small round maker's mark sits on the vamplate rim.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。红白螺旋漆杆加喇叭护手盘是辨识点；与卫队长枪、王室斧戟区分。

subject.zh: 一根见习史官录杖，斜放45度，握柄在左下、杖头在右上。细长的深褐橡心木杖身#6a4628，杖头嵌一枚透明浅青录晶#a8e8e8，晶内隐约排着几行细小点线；多道刻纹缠杖身而上透淡青微光，握处系一条墨蓝色带，柄尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: An apprentice chronicler's record wand at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A slender dark brown oakheart shaft #6a4628 with a clear pale cyan record crystal #a8e8e8 set in the head, faint rows of tiny dotted lines visible inside it; several engraved lines spiral up the shaft with a faint pale cyan glow, an ink-blue ribbon is tied at the grip, and a small maker's mark sits on the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。录晶内只画点线，不能像文字；与圣柱碎晶录杖的白瓷杖身与苍白碎晶区分。

subject.zh: 一件慈济院灰白袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。灰白细布#d8d4cc宽松朴素，一侧袖口叠着好几块深浅不一的整齐小补丁；多道细绣纹沿领口与前襟走，透出极淡的浅青微光，腰间系麻绳，领口一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A grey-white mercy-house robe from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Loose, plain grey-white fine cloth #d8d4cc, with one cuff layered with several neat small patches in different shades; several fine embroidered lines run along the collar and front with a very faint pale cyan glow, a hemp cord at the waist, and a small round maker's mark at the collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。袖口一串整齐补丁是辨识点，但袍子整洁不破，是精品；不加紫，不用神光白金。

subject.zh: 一枚公会银徽，坠子居中，上方一小段银链。盾形银牌#d0d4dc，中央浮雕一柄竖剑穿过圆环的几何会徽，下缘一排小凸点；多道细刻纹沿盾边走，透出极淡的浅青微光，背扣旁一枚小六角匠记。
subject.en: A guild silver badge, centred, with a short silver chain above. A shield-shaped silver plate #d0d4dc embossed with a geometric guild crest of an upright sword passing through a ring, with a row of small raised dots along the bottom; several fine engraved lines follow the edge with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small hexagonal maker's mark beside the clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盾形银牌加剑穿环会徽，无字；与秤纹胸针的圆牌、天平徽的天平形区分。

subject.zh: 一只闸指护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。厚重的铁板护手#7a7f88，指节是一排小齿轮，齿缘留着暗红旧锈色；手背中央一颗铆住齿轮的大铆钉，多道刻纹顺手背走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光，腕甲边一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: A single sluice-gear gauntlet, back outward, fingers pointing upper right. A heavy iron plate gauntlet #7a7f88 whose knuckles are a row of small cogwheels with old dark rust-red on their teeth; one big rivet holds the gears at the centre of the back, several engraved lines run over the back with a very faint pale cyan glow in the grooves, and a small square maker's mark sits on the cuff edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。指节一排齿轮是辨识点；带旧锈色但做工精整，不是劣品；与经文锁手区分。

subject.zh: 一只焚书者的灰手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。灰烬色细布手套#6a6664，指尖一截焦黑#2a2624，像被火燎过；多道细绣纹沿手背走，透出极淡的澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过手背，袖口一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A single book-burner's ash glove, back outward, fingers pointing upper right. Ash-coloured fine cloth #6a6664 with fingertips charred black #2a2624 as if singed; several fine embroidered lines run over the back with a very faint dusky purple glow, thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep across the back, and a small round maker's mark on the cuff.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。焦黑指尖是辨识点；中档澱纹只是细纹；与蛛丝手套的灰白柔光区分。

subject.zh: 一柄门闩锤，斜放45度占满对角线，锤头在右上。锤头是一根粗方的黑铁门闩#3c3f46横装在长柄上，两端包暗金门铜箍#9a7840；多道刻纹沿门闩走，纹槽透出极淡的门扉金微光#f0d890，闩身留着一个滑扣环，柄尾一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: A door-bolt maul lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, head at upper right. The head is a thick square blackiron door bolt #3c3f46 mounted crosswise on a long haft, both ends capped in dark gold door-bronze bands #9a7840; several engraved lines run along the bolt with a very faint door-gold glow #f0d890 in the grooves, a sliding latch ring still sits on it, and a small square maker's mark sits on the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。锤头要看得出是一根门闩（带滑扣环）；门扉金只在纹槽一线，不铺满。

subject.zh: 一面伯爵卫队鸢盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。上宽下尖的长鸢形，深蓝灰盾面#3a4a5a绘一道蜿蜒的灰白溪流纹#c8ccd0，精钢包边#a8b0bc；多道刻纹沿包边走，透出极淡的浅青微光，盾顶一枚小盾形匠记。
subject.en: A count's guard kite shield, front-facing three-quarter view tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. A long kite shape wide at the top and pointed at the bottom, its deep blue-grey face #3a4a5a painted with one winding grey-white stream motif #c8ccd0 and edged in fine steel #a8b0bc; several engraved lines follow the rim with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small shield-shaped maker's mark at the top.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。鸢形轮廓加蜿蜒灰白溪流纹是辨识点，溪流纹与授剑圆章同纹；与塔盾、圆盾区分。

subject.zh: 一只巨口皮靴，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。深褐硬革长靴#5a3a24湿漉漉地泛着水光，靴口宽大外翻像张开的嘴，靴底挂着泥；多道刻纹沿靴筒走，透出极淡的浅青微光，几处灰中带紫的斑点，靴扣一枚小圆匠记。
subject.en: A single maw boot, front-side three-quarter view, toe pointing lower left. A tall dark brown hardened-leather boot #5a3a24 shining wet, its wide flared top gaping like an open mouth and mud clinging to the sole; several engraved lines run down the shaft with a very faint pale cyan glow, a few purple-tinged grey spots, and a small round maker's mark on the buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。湿亮皮面与张口般外翻的靴口是辨识点；轻档澱纹只几处斑点。

subject.zh: 一件鲶王鳞背心，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。无袖背心缀满暗橄榄褐的圆大鳞片#5a5a3e，鳞面泛油光；多道刻纹沿鳞行走透淡青微光，胸前一片鳞被一道平直得过分的切口整齐削开，肩扣一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A catfish-king scale vest from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. A sleeveless vest covered in large round dark olive-brown scales #5a5a3e with an oily sheen; several engraved lines run along the scale rows with a faint pale cyan glow, one scale on the chest is sliced clean by an unnaturally straight cut, and a small maker's mark sits on the shoulder clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。胸前那片鳞的平直切口是唯一辨识点，要清楚；圆鳞，与亚龙尖鳞区分。

subject.zh: 一把老兵双手斧，斜放45度占满对角线，斧头在右上。宽月形精钢斧刃#a8b0bc，斧颈钉着粗大铆钉，留着未打磨的修补痕；斧柄缠着褪色的灰与褐旧布条；多道刻纹顺刃走，透出极淡的浅青微光，斧颈一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: A veteran's two-handed axe lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, head at upper right. A broad crescent fine-steel blade #a8b0bc with heavy rivets in the neck and unpolished repair marks; the haft is wound with faded grey and brown old cloth strips; several engraved lines follow the edge with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small square maker's mark on the neck.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。灰墙作：粗铆钉与修补痕，柄上灰褐旧布条是辨识点；与伐木斧的窄刃区分。

subject.zh: 一把骑士团授剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。笔直的精钢长剑#a8b0bc，刃口一线高光；十字护手两端微微下垂，正中镶一枚灰蓝圆章，章面刻蜿蜒溪流纹；多道刻纹顺剑身走透淡青微光，柄尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A knightly accolade sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A straight fine-steel longsword #a8b0bc with a bright line on the edge; the crossguard tips droop slightly and a grey-blue roundel carved with a winding stream motif is set at its centre; several engraved lines follow the blade with a faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。护手正中溪流纹圆章与卫队鸢盾同纹；与行会剑的锤形印区分。

subject.zh: 一枚钟鸣晶法器，直立，四分之三视角。一根浑浊灰的六棱晶柱#8a8a90立在黑铁三爪座上，晶芯一缕澱紫#4a3a62；晶面绕着一圈圈细密的同心波纹，多道刻纹透出极淡的澱紫微光，暗紫纹路爬上底座，座脚一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A humming crystal focus, upright, three-quarter view. A murky grey hexagonal crystal column #8a8a90 stands in a three-clawed blackiron mount, a wisp of dusky purple #4a3a62 at its core; fine concentric ripple rings circle the crystal, several engraved lines give off a very faint dusky purple glow, dark purple veins creep up the mount, and a small maker's mark sits on one foot.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。同心波纹表现嗡鸣，不画钟形；晶质与晶脊刃的晶刺一致，不要画成透明浅青。

subject.zh: 一顶灰鼠兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。鼠灰软皮兜帽#6a6a6e，帽檐压得很低，下连一截遮住口鼻的面巾；多道细刻纹沿帽缘走，透出极淡的浅青微光，帽尖垂成一条细长的尾，面巾角一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A grey-rat hood in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. A mouse-grey soft leather hood #6a6a6e pulled low over the brow, joined to a face scarf that covers the mouth and nose; several fine engraved lines follow the hood edge with a very faint pale cyan glow, the hood's peak trails into a long thin tail, and a small maker's mark sits on the scarf corner.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。低压帽檐加面巾与细长帽尾是辨识点；没有毛皮，与灰鬃猎帽区分。

subject.zh: 一杆拾门者钩镰，斜放45度占满对角线，钩刃在右上。灰烬色铁钩刃#5e5a56向内弯成撬钩，刃面一个小门形镂空，古纹旁钉着新铆钉；多道刻纹顺钩走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光，长木柄缠皮，钩根一枚小方匠记。
subject.en: A gate-picker's hook glaive lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, hook at upper right. An ash-coloured iron hook blade #5e5a56 curving inward into a prying hook, with a small door-shaped cutout in the blade and new rivets beside old patterns; several engraved lines follow the hook with a very faint pale cyan glow in the grooves, a long leather-wrapped wooden haft, and a small square maker's mark at the hook's root.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。拾遗作：内弯撬钩加门形镂空，镂空不发门扉金；与王室斧戟的三合一头区分。

subject.zh: 一副千骨肋甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。一条条弯曲的骨白甲条#d8d0b8像肋骨般环抱胸口，中间一道脊骨似的竖梁；多道刻纹顺甲条走，透出极淡的澱紫微光，暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过甲条，肩扣一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A thousand-bone ribplate from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Curved bone-white plates #d8d0b8 wrap the chest like ribs on either side of a spine-like central bar; several engraved lines follow the plates with a very faint dusky purple glow, dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep across them, and a small maker's mark sits on the shoulder clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。肋骨状甲条与中央脊梁是主轮廓；不缠彩绳，与骨角作骨片缀甲区分。

subject.zh: 一对沉灰巨蠕皮腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。灰褐的环节状蠕皮#7a7268，一圈圈横向褶节，皮面沾着细沙；多道刻纹沿褶节走，透出极淡的澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过腿面，腰带扣上一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A pair of ash-worm hide leggings, front view, both legs side by side. Grey-brown segmented worm hide #7a7268 in ring after ring of horizontal folds, fine sand clinging to the surface; several engraved lines follow the folds with a very faint dusky purple glow, thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep down the legs, and a small maker's mark sits on the belt buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。横向环节褶皮是辨识点；中档澱纹细纹；与水道长靴、亚龙鳞腿甲区分。

subject.zh: 一顶残门卫门盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。高耸的古旧灰烬色闭面盔#5e5a56，盔顶竖着一片门形镂空的冠板，面甲是几道横向窥缝；多道古纹顺盔走，透出极淡的澱紫微光，暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过面甲，颈甲一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A ruined gate-guard helm in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. A tall ancient ash-coloured closed helm #5e5a56 crowned by an upright crest plate pierced with a door-shaped cutout, its visor a few horizontal eye slits; several old engraved lines follow the helm with a very faint dusky purple glow, dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the visor, and a small maker's mark sits on the neck guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盔顶门形镂空冠板是辨识点，不用门扉金；比骸骨盔的小额孔大且是闭面盔。

subject.zh: 一把灰烬遗金大剑，斜放45度占满对角线，剑尖在右上。宽厚的灰烬色重锻剑身#6a6660；剑格是古旧残件，中间一个门形镂空，用新铆钉固定在柄上；多道刻纹顺剑身走透淡青微光，剑面几处灰中带紫的斑点，柄尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: An ashen salvage greatsword lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, point at upper right. A broad, thick ash-coloured reforged blade #6a6660; the crossguard is an ancient salvaged piece with a door-shaped cutout at its centre, held to the hilt by new rivets; several engraved lines follow the blade with a faint pale cyan glow, a few purple-tinged grey spots on the flat, and a small maker's mark on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。拾遗作首件：门形镂空剑格加新铆钉；轻档澱纹只几处斑点，与晶脊刃区分。

subject.zh: 一柄圣战军赦罪锤，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锤头在右上。银白精钢锤头#c8ccd4是一个四面方块，每面浮铸一枚无字的放射状几何纹章；多道刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0，铁柄缠白布，柄尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A crusader's absolution mace at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A silver-white fine-steel head #c8ccd4 shaped as a four-faced block, each face cast in relief with a wordless radiating geometric emblem; several engraved lines give off a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0, the iron haft is wrapped in white cloth, and a small maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。方块锤头每面一个放射纹章，不能像字；教会军器不加紫，与钟形银锤区分。

subject.zh: 一只审判官经文锁手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。银灰锁子甲手套#b8bcc4，手背压着一块白钢护片，护片上刻满一行行细密的几何纹带；纹槽透出极淡的神光白金微光，腕口缠一圈白布条，扣环一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A single inquisitor's scripture mail gauntlet, back outward, fingers pointing upper right. A silver-grey mail glove #b8bcc4 with a white-steel plate over the back of the hand, densely engraved with row upon row of fine geometric bands; the grooves give off a very faint holy white-gold glow, a band of white cloth wraps the wrist, and a small maker's mark sits on the buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。护片上的几何纹带代表经文，绝不能像字；不加紫，与锈闸齿轮护手区分。

subject.zh: 一件红牙突袭者皮甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。贴身的黑褐硬革短甲#3a2a22，两肩各缀一排弯弯的红漆兽牙#b04030；多道刻纹沿前襟走，透出极淡的浅青微光，两侧交叉系皮绳，腰扣一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A redfang raider's jerkin from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. A close-fitting black-brown hardened leather jerkin #3a2a22 with a row of curved red-lacquered fangs #b04030 along each shoulder; several engraved lines run down the front with a very faint pale cyan glow, cross-laced leather thongs at the sides, and a small maker's mark on the waist buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两肩红漆兽牙是辨识点；贴身短甲，与独眼团钉甲、旧皮背心区分。

subject.zh: 一把翼魔斥候手弩，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，握把在右下。小巧的黑铁弩身#3c3f46，弩臂像一对收拢的皮膜翅骨，后端带一个单手上弦的小曲柄；多道刻纹沿弩身走，透出极淡的浅青微光，握把侧一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A wingfiend scout's hand crossbow with the arms across the top and the stock angled down to the right, grip at lower right. A compact blackiron body #3c3f46 whose bow arms look like a pair of folded membrane wing-bones, with a small one-handed spanning crank at the rear; several engraved lines run along the body with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark on the side of the grip.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。翅骨状弩臂与小曲柄是辨识点；体型比铁闸营劲弩小一圈。

subject.zh: 一盏夜魔黑曜灯，直立，四分之三视角。黑曜石雕成的尖顶灯身#1e1a22，几道竖向棱面反着冷光，里面一团幽暗的深蓝灯火#3a4a8a；多道刻纹沿棱走，透出极淡的浅青微光，底座是黑铁爪足，座边一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A night-caster's obsidian lamp, upright, three-quarter view. A spire-topped lamp body carved from obsidian #1e1a22, its vertical facets catching a cold gleam, with a dim deep-blue flame #3a4a8a inside; several engraved lines follow the facets with a very faint pale cyan glow, standing on blackiron claw feet with a small maker's mark at the base.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。黑曜尖顶灯身加深蓝暗火，不用紫；与守墓人提灯的方铁框区分。

subject.zh: 一把军团短剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。宽而短的叶形精钢剑身#a8b0bc，刃根刻一排无字的编号刻痕；铁灰圆护手配深红握柄#7a2a2a与球形柄头；多道刻纹顺剑身走，透出极淡的浅青微光，柄头一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A legion gladius at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A short, broad leaf-shaped fine-steel blade #a8b0bc with a row of wordless numbering notches at its root; an iron-grey round guard with a deep red grip #7a2a2a and a ball pommel; several engraved lines follow the blade with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。军坊作：铁灰配深红，刃根刻痕不能像数字；短宽叶形，与锈蚀短剑区分。

subject.zh: 一顶前排重盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。厚重的灰钢盔#8a8c90带宽护颊，盔左侧漆一道醒目的灰白横条，颈后一圈褐色毛皮领；粗大铆钉旁有未打磨的修补痕，多道刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，护颊一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A front-line helm in three-quarter front-side view, facing lower left. A heavy grey steel helm #8a8c90 with wide cheek guards, a bold grey-white horizontal stripe painted on its left side, and a brown fur collar around the back of the neck; heavy rivets with unpolished repair marks beside them, several engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark on a cheek guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。灰墙作：盔左侧灰横条是辨识点，毛皮领与粗铆钉；与北门卫兵长盔的红缨区分。

subject.zh: 一把宫廷细剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。极细长的精钢剑身#a8b0bc，刃口一线高光；鎏金回旋篮柄#d8a840绕成几道优雅弧线，柄头是一颗珍珠白小圆球；多道刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，护手根一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A court rapier at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A very long, slender fine-steel blade #a8b0bc with a bright line on the edge; a gilded swept hilt #d8a840 curling into several elegant arcs, with a small pearl-white ball pommel; several engraved lines give off a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark at the guard's root.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。鎏金回旋篮柄是辨识点，剑身最细；与比武剑的一字护手侧环区分。

subject.zh: 一把盐蚀弯刀，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刀尖在右上。宽弧的精钢刀身#a8b0bc被海盐蚀出一片片云状的灰白花纹，刃口仍有一线高光；黄铜贝壳形护手#b08840，多道刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，护手内侧一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A salt-etched cutlass at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and tip at upper right. A broad curved fine-steel blade #a8b0bc etched by sea salt into patches of cloudy grey-white pattern, its edge still showing one bright line; a brass shell-shaped guard #b08840, several engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark inside the guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盐蚀云纹与贝壳护手是辨识点；宽弧单刃，与各把直剑区分。

subject.zh: 一张兽人复合弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。短而强的反曲弓臂，木芯外贴骨白角片#d8ccb0，两梢反翘；握把缠着红、黄、青彩绳，弓臂缀几片小骨片；多道刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，握把旁一枚小匠记。
subject.en: An orc composite bow, upright and slightly tilted, back facing left, string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. Short powerful recurved limbs with a wooden core faced in bone-white horn #d8ccb0, the tips flicking back; the grip is wound with red, yellow and teal cords and small bone plates hang on the limbs; several engraved lines glow very faintly pale cyan, with a small maker's mark beside the grip.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。骨角作：反曲双弯与彩绳是辨识点；与猎弓、北境长弓的单曲直臂区分。

subject.zh: 一面桥头大盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。高大的长方塔盾，上缘做成石桥拱形，银灰钢盾面#b8bcc4中央浮起一道拱桥纹；多道刻纹沿包边走，透出极淡的浅青微光，盾面几道新刮痕，下角一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A bridgehead tower shield, front-facing three-quarter view tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. A tall rectangular tower shield whose top edge is shaped like a stone bridge arch, its silver-grey steel face #b8bcc4 raised with an arched-bridge motif at the centre; several engraved lines follow the rim with a very faint pale cyan glow, a few fresh scrapes on the face, and a small maker's mark at the lower corner.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。高大塔盾加拱桥形上缘是辨识点；与鸢盾、圆盾区分尺寸与形状。

subject.zh: 一根圣柱碎晶录杖，斜放45度，握柄在左下、杖头在右上。细长的白瓷色杖身#ece8e0配金箍#d8b060，杖头嵌一块苍白的不规则碎晶#f4f0e8，断面锋利；多道对称刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0，握处缠白丝带，柄尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A holy-pillar shard record wand at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A slender porcelain-white shaft #ece8e0 with gold bands #d8b060, set at the head with a pale irregular crystal shard #f4f0e8 with sharp broken faces; several symmetrical engraved lines give off a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0, white silk ribbon wraps the grip, and a small maker's mark sits on the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。防剧透：纯白瓷与金，绝不加紫或灰斑；苍白碎晶要有锋利断面。

subject.zh: 一枚铜门环挂件，居中，上方一小段系绳。暗金门铜#9a7840的圆底座衔着一个粗圆环，环底被敲得磨亮一块；多道古纹沿底座走，纹槽透出极淡的门扉金微光#f0d890，细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过底座，座背一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A bronze door-knocker charm, centred, with a short cord above. A round backplate of dark gold door-bronze #9a7840 holding a thick ring, the bottom of the ring worn bright where it was struck; several old engraved lines run around the backplate with a very faint door-gold glow #f0d890 in the grooves, thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over it, and a small maker's mark sits on the back.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。门环底部磨亮的一块是辨识点；门扉金只在纹槽，暗紫只是细纹，不加暗雾。

subject.zh: 一把深层矿镐，斜放45度占满对角线，镐头在右上。长而弯的双尖黑铁镐头#3c3f46，高光偏蓝，尖端沾着赭红色岩粉；多道刻纹顺镐头走，纹槽透出极淡的浅青微光，橡心木长柄#6a4628包铁箍，镐颈一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A deep-mine pick lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, head at upper right. A long curved double-pointed blackiron head #3c3f46 with bluish highlights, its points dusted with ochre-red rock powder; several engraved lines follow the head with a very faint pale cyan glow in the grooves, a long iron-banded oakheart haft #6a4628, and a small maker's mark on the neck.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。双尖弯镐头是主轮廓，不要画成斧；尖端赭红岩粉是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一杆王室近卫斧戟，斜放45度占满对角线，戟头在右上。精钢戟头#a8b0bc一侧是新月斧刃、一侧是后钩、顶端长矛尖，斧刃面压着一束麦穗纹；多道刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，深红漆长杆配金箍#d8a840，箍上一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A royal guard halberd lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, head at upper right. A fine-steel head #a8b0bc with a crescent axe blade on one side, a back hook on the other and a long spear point on top, the axe face pressed with a sheaf-of-wheat motif; several engraved lines glow very faintly pale cyan, on a long deep red lacquered shaft with gold bands #d8a840 and a small maker's mark on a band.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。斧刃面的麦穗纹是辨识点；斧、钩、矛三合一轮廓，与钩镰、比武长枪区分。

subject.zh: 一枚空心戒，单枚，倾斜约30度露出戒面。金戒圈#d8a840，戒面是一个可掀开的小圆盒盖，盖子微微翘起，露出空着的戒托，托底残留一点白色粉末痕迹；盖面多道细刻纹透出极淡的浅青微光，内侧一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A hollow ring, single, tilted about 30 degrees to show its face. A gold band #d8a840 whose face is a small hinged round box lid, lifted slightly to show the empty bezel inside with a faint trace of white powder at its bottom; several fine engraved lines on the lid give off a very faint pale cyan glow, with a small maker's mark inside the band.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。掀开的盒盖与空托是辨识点，白粉只一点痕迹；与骰戒、铜环区分。

subject.zh: 一柄白冕祝圣锤，斜放45度占满对角线，锤头在右上。厚重的方锤头覆着瓷白釉片#f4f2ec，银镶边#d0d4dc，两侧各一圈光环形对称纹，镶浅蓝釉点#a8c8e8；纹槽透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0，长柄缠白皮配金箍，锤颈一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A white-crown consecration maul lying corner to corner at 45 degrees, head at upper right. A heavy square head clad in porcelain-white glaze plates #f4f2ec with silver edging #d0d4dc, each side bearing a symmetrical halo ring set with pale blue enamel dots #a8c8e8; the grooves give off a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0, the long haft is wrapped in white leather with gold bands, and a small maker's mark sits on the neck.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。白冕作：瓷白釉、银镶边、光环对称纹；只用白、金、浅蓝，绝不加紫。

subject.zh: 一件七钟诵经袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。白色细布长袍#ece6d8，前襟自上而下分成七段金线绣带#d8b060，每段一种几何纹，段与段之间缀一枚小钟扣；纹线透出极淡的神光白金微光，领口一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A seven-bell chant robe from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. A long white fine-cloth robe #ece6d8 whose front is divided top to bottom into seven bands of gold-thread embroidery #d8b060, each a different geometric pattern, with a small bell button between bands; the threads give off a very faint holy white-gold glow, and a small maker's mark sits at the collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。前襟分段金绣带与小钟扣是辨识点，绣纹不能像字；教会袍不加紫。

subject.zh: 一件看守锁甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。冷灰锁子甲#8a8e96长及大腿，胸前一块白钢护心板压着一口无舌的钟形浮雕，腰间挂一副黑铁镣铐#3c3f46；多道刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光，肩扣一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A warden's mail from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin with the shoulders up. Cold grey chain mail #8a8e96 reaching the thighs, a white-steel chest plate embossed with a tongueless bell, and a pair of blackiron shackles #3c3f46 hanging at the waist; several engraved lines give off a very faint holy white-gold glow, and a small maker's mark sits on the shoulder clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。无舌钟浮雕与腰间镣铐是辨识点；冷峻但仍是教会之物，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一根朝圣杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。笔直的浅色灰皮木杖身#8a8680，杖顶弯成一个小钩，钩下用白绳系着一串大小不一的钟铜小铃#b08840；多道刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光，握处缠白布，杖身一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A pilgrim's staff at 45 degrees, butt at lower left and head at upper right. A straight pale greybark wood shaft #8a8680 curling into a small hook at the top, with a string of little bell-bronze bells #b08840 of different sizes tied below the hook on white cord; several engraved lines give off a very faint holy white-gold glow, white cloth wraps the grip, and a small maker's mark sits on the shaft.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。杖顶小钩下的一串铃铛是辨识点；与苇杖、橡木杖区分，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一支海烛法器，直立，四分之三视角。粗白蜡烛立在银色扇贝形烛台#d0d4dc里，烛身缠一圈细绳结，顶端一朵暖黄小火苗；烛台多道刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0，台缘挂两颗小珍珠，台底一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A sea candle focus, upright, three-quarter view. A thick white candle standing in a silver scallop-shell holder #d0d4dc, a band of fine knotted cord around the wax and a small warm yellow flame on top; several engraved lines on the holder give off a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0, two tiny pearls hang from its rim, and a small maker's mark sits under the base.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。扇贝形银烛台与粗白烛是辨识点；与提灯、黑曜灯区分，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一把勇者院练习剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。朴素的精钢长剑#a8b0bc，两侧刃口布满大小不一的旧缺口，一个叠着一个；握柄换过好几层皮条，多道刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光，简单十字护手正中一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A heroes'-hall practice sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A plain fine-steel longsword #a8b0bc whose edges are covered on both sides with old nicks of every size, one overlapping another; the grip has been rewrapped in several layers of leather, several engraved lines give off a very faint holy white-gold glow, and the simple crossguard carries a small maker's mark at its centre.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两侧刃口密集的旧缺口是唯一辨识点；是精品不是劣品，不加锈，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一枚圣骨堂瓷骨坠，坠子居中，上方一小段金链。一块光洁的白瓷骨片#f4f2ec雕成细长的水滴形，外框金托#d8b060；骨面多道对称细刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0，顶端一颗小金珠，金托背面一枚小匠记。
subject.en: An ossuary porcelain-bone pendant, centred, with a short gold chain above. A smooth white porcelain bone piece #f4f2ec carved into a slender teardrop and set in a gold frame #d8b060; several symmetrical fine engraved lines on the bone give off a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0, a small gold bead sits on top, and a small maker's mark is on the back of the frame.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。防剧透：纯白瓷与金，不画灰斑、不加任何紫；水滴形骨片是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一枚审判庭天平徽，坠子居中，上方一小段银链。整枚徽章做成一架银白天平#e0e4ea，竖梁顶端一个小光环，两只秤盘完全水平；多道细刻纹透出极淡的神光白金微光#fff0c0，横梁正中嵌一颗白瓷小圆片，梁下一枚小匠记。
subject.en: An inquisition scale badge, centred, with a short silver chain above. The whole badge is shaped as a silver-white balance #e0e4ea, a small halo atop the upright beam and both pans hanging perfectly level; several fine engraved lines give off a very faint holy white-gold glow #fff0c0, a small white porcelain disc is set at the centre of the crossbeam, and a small maker's mark sits beneath the beam.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。整枚做成天平且两盘水平；与秤纹胸针（镀金圆牌、两盘一高一低）区分，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一只光径朝圣靴，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。浅奶褐净革短靴#c8a878，靴筒用白绳交叉绑紧，靴口翻出一圈白毡边，厚鞋底缝两道明线；多道刻纹沿靴筒走，透出极淡的浅青微光，后跟一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A single pilgrim-road boot, front-side three-quarter view, toe pointing lower left. A pale cream-brown clean-leather ankle boot #c8a878, its shaft cross-laced with white cord, a white felt cuff turned out at the top, and a thick sole stitched with two visible seams; several engraved lines run down the shaft with a very faint pale cyan glow, and a small maker's mark sits on the heel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。浅奶褐净革加白绳交叉绑腿与白毡边是辨识点；与狼皮靴、巨口皮靴区分颜色。

subject.zh: 一把军坊作单手直剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；精钢剑身 #a8b0bc，铁灰护手配深红缠柄；剑身中线刻一列无字的短竖痕，多道刻纹顺剑身走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光 #a8e0d8；剑首一枚小小的几何匠记。
subject.en: A military-workshop one-handed straight sword lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; fine steel blade #a8b0bc, iron-grey crossguard and a deep red grip wrap. A column of short textless tally notches runs down the fuller, and several engraved lines follow the blade with a faint pale cyan glow (#a8e0d8) in the grooves; a tiny geometric maker's mark on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。剑身中线那列短竖痕是辨识点，必须是刻痕不能像字；配色守住铁灰加深红。

subject.zh: 一柄斗场三叉戟，占满整条对角线，叉头在右上；三根精钢叉齿 #a8b0bc 上刻着顺齿走的细纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；叉头下方挂一团收拢的绳网，杆身缠红褐皮条，皮条间沾着红砂色的尘；铁箍上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An arena trident spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; three fine steel tines #a8b0bc carry fine engraved lines along each prong, glowing faintly pale cyan in the grooves. A bundled rope net hangs just below the head, the shaft is wrapped in red-brown leather strips dusted with reddish grit, and a geometric maker's mark sits on an iron collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。三齿加叉头下的一团绳网是辨识点，与普通长枪、骑枪区分开。

subject.zh: 一面军坊作长方塔盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者；铁灰盾面 #7a7f88 上横贯一条深红宽带，带上压出一排城垛形凸纹；多道刻纹沿盾缘走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；四角包铁，下缘一排无字编号刻痕与一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A military-workshop rectangular tower shield in three-quarter view, face toward the viewer; an iron-grey face #7a7f88 crossed by a broad deep red band embossed with a row of battlement-shaped ridges. Engraved lines run along the rim with a faint pale cyan glow, iron caps guard the four corners, and the lower edge has a row of textless serial notches and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。深红横带上的城垛凸纹是辨识点；高长的长方形，不要画成圆盾。

subject.zh: 一支录纹作录杖，斜放45度，握柄在左下、杖头在右上；深褐乌木杖身缠一圈墨绿学派色带，杖头银爪托着一枚椭圆录晶，晶内有几圈同心细纹，泛极淡浅青光；杖身织刻满极小的点线纹，杖尾一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A scholar-school record wand lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, head upper right; a dark brown ebony shaft wrapped with one dark green school band, and a silver claw at the head holding an oval record crystal with a few concentric ripple rings inside, glowing faintly pale cyan. Tiny dot-and-line patterns cover the shaft; a geometric maker's mark at the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。录晶里的同心细纹是辨识点；点线纹不能像文字。

subject.zh: 一杆军坊作重骑枪，占满整条对角线，枪尖在右上；锥形铁灰枪身 #7a7f88 由粗渐细，握处套一只漏斗形护手盘，盘面压一圈马蹄形凸纹；多道刻纹顺枪身螺旋而上，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；深红缠握，盘缘有无字编号刻痕与几何匠记。
subject.en: A military-workshop heavy cavalry lance spanning the full diagonal, tip at upper right; a tapering conical iron-grey shaft #7a7f88 with a funnel-shaped hand guard embossed with a ring of horseshoe shapes. Engraved lines spiral up the shaft with a faint pale cyan glow, the grip is wrapped deep red, and the guard rim bears textless serial notches and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。锥形枪身加漏斗护手盘是骑枪的轮廓，与三叉戟、角兽骑枪区分。

subject.zh: 一把旧式单手剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；钢灰剑身下半截沾着泥褐土痕，像久插在地里；剑格中央开一道细长空槽；顺形刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路 #4a3a62 爬过剑身；柄尾一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An old-pattern one-handed sword lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; the steel-grey blade is stained mud brown along its lower half as if long planted in the ground, and a thin hollow slot opens in the center of the crossguard. Engraved lines glow faintly dusk violet, fine dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep across the blade, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。中澱纹：暗紫细纹爬过剑身但不发强光；剑是完整的，不要画成断剑。

subject.zh: 一把军坊作守城弩，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，握把在右下；铁灰钢臂 #7a7f88 配深红漆木弩身，尾端装一只小绞盘；多道刻纹沿弩身走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；弩身侧面一排无字编号刻痕，边角沾一点灰白石屑。
subject.en: A military-workshop rampart crossbow with the bow arms across the top and the stock angled down to the right, grip at lower right; iron-grey steel arms #7a7f88 on a deep red lacquered stock with a small winch at the rear. Engraved lines run along the stock with a faint pale cyan glow, a row of textless serial notches marks its side, and pale grey stone dust clings to the corners.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。尾端小绞盘是辨识点，与铃路连弩、门扉制式弩区分；弩身偏大偏重。

subject.zh: 一枚半截剑形吊坠居中，上方一小段黑铁细链；坠身是一截精钢断剑 #a8b0bc，断口平齐如切，只留剑格与半段剑身；剑身两侧细刻纹顺形而下，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；断口包一圈细银线，剑格背面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A half-sword pendant centered under a short length of fine black iron chain; the charm is a snapped stub of fine steel blade #a8b0bc cut cleanly flat, keeping only the crossguard and half the blade. Fine engraved lines run down both sides with a faint pale cyan glow, a thin silver wire binds the break, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the back of the guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。是缩小的吊坠，不是武器；断口平齐包银线，上方要有链。

subject.zh: 一张骨角作复合弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾；弓臂贴牛角与骨片，弓梢缠红黄两色彩绳；弓臂内侧多道刻纹透极淡浅青微光；握把处挂一枚铁灰小牌，压着无字编号刻痕，另有一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A bone-and-horn composite bow standing nearly upright, bow back to the left, string on the right, upper tip leaning slightly right; the limbs are faced with horn and bone plates, and the tips are wrapped in red and yellow cords. Engraved lines along the inner limbs glow faintly pale cyan, and a small iron-grey tag stamped with textless serial notches hangs at the grip beside a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。草原角弓上挂一枚帝国式铁牌，两种风格同在一件上是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一件军坊作战法师长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；深红袍身 #8a2a2a 镶铁灰宽边，肩头一对铁灰小肩片；前襟两道织纹顺衣缝下行，纹线透极淡浅青微光；左胸一枚无字几何军团徽，腰束铁灰扣带。
subject.en: A military-workshop battle mage robe seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; a deep red body #8a2a2a trimmed with broad iron-grey borders and a pair of small iron-grey shoulder plates. Two woven lines run down the front seams with a faint pale cyan glow, a textless geometric legion badge sits on the left chest, and an iron-grey buckled belt cinches the waist.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。深红配铁灰是军坊作配色；胸前徽章只能是几何形，不能有数字。

subject.zh: 一枚税吏戒指，倾斜约30度露出戒面；铁灰戒圈 #7a7f88，方形戒面嵌深红珐琅，珐琅上压出三级台阶状的银色几何纹；戒圈两侧细刻纹顺弧走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；戒托侧面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A tax collector's ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face; an iron-grey band #7a7f88 with a square bezel of deep red enamel, stamped with a silver geometric motif of three rising steps. Fine engraved lines follow the curve of the band with a faint pale cyan glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the side of the setting.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。三级台阶纹加深红珐琅方面是辨识点，与其他戒指的戒面区分。

subject.zh: 一柄深锤作双手战锤，占满整条对角线，锤头在右上；方正厚重的黑铁锤头 #3c3f46，侧面铆钉排成矿纹，中央一枚无字方形契印匠记；几道符形刻纹顺锤头走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光 #f0a040；锤柄包铁，柄尾嵌一粒小火玉。
subject.en: A deep-hammer two-handed warhammer spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; a square, heavy black iron head #3c3f46 with rivets laid out like an ore vein and a textless square contract-seal maker's mark at its center. A few rune-like engraved lines follow the head with a faint fire orange glow (#f0a040); the haft is iron-banded and a small fire jade is set in the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。方正厚重的锤头与矿纹铆钉是深锤作语法；契印必须是无字几何形。

subject.zh: 一副深锤作护目镜，四分之三侧前视，镜面朝左下；硬革头带 #6a4226 边缘压线，两只圆镜片是烟黄色厚玻璃，镶方正的钟铜镜框 #b08840，框上排一圈小铆钉；镜框刻纹透极淡火橙微光；左镜外有一片可翻起的小遮片，侧面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: Deep-hammer forge goggles in three-quarter front view, lenses facing lower left; a hard leather strap #6a4226 with stitched edges and two round lenses of thick smoky amber glass set in square bell bronze frames #b08840 ringed with small rivets. The frames carry engraved lines with a faint fire orange glow, a small flip-up shade sits over the left lens, and a geometric maker's mark is on the side.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两只圆镜片加左边的翻起遮片是辨识点；镜片烟黄，不要发紫。

subject.zh: 一柄行炉矮人单手锤，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锤头在右上；短粗的铁锤头 #7a7f88 一端是平面、一端是小砧角，锤身刻几道顺形纹，纹槽透极淡火橙微光；柄身缠硬革，挂一只装钉子的小皮袋，锤颈一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A wandering-forge dwarven one-handed hammer lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, head upper right; a short, stout iron head #7a7f88 with a flat face on one end and a small anvil horn on the other, carrying a few engraved lines with a faint fire orange glow. The handle is wrapped in hard leather with a small pouch of nails tied on, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the neck.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。锤头一端的小砧角与柄上的钉袋是辨识点，是随身修理用的工具锤。

subject.zh: 一把金秤作决斗佩刀，连鞘斜放45度，刀柄在左下、鞘尖在右上；刀鞘通体镀金 #e0b848，鞘面压一列小天平纹，鞘口与鞘尖包宝蓝珐琅；弧形镀金护手顺形刻纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；刀柄缠鲜红丝绳，柄首一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A gold-scale duelling sabre in its scabbard lying at 45 degrees, hilt lower left, scabbard tip upper right; the scabbard is fully gilded #e0b848, stamped with a row of small balance-scale motifs and capped at mouth and tip with royal blue enamel. A curved gilded knuckle guard carries engraved lines with a faint pale cyan glow, the grip is wrapped in bright red silk cord, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。画成连鞘的弧形佩刀，镀金刀鞘与天平纹是辨识点，颜色要鲜艳。

subject.zh: 一把铃路作连弩，尺寸偏小，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，握把在右下；圆润的浅褐木弩身上顶着一只方形箭匣，侧面挂一只小铜铃；铜弩臂顺形刻纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；托底挂一只小皮袋，扳杆旁一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A bell-road repeating crossbow, small in scale, with the bow arms across the top and the stock angled down to the right, grip at lower right; a rounded light brown wooden stock topped with a square bolt magazine and a small brass bell hanging at its side. The copper arms carry engraved lines with a faint pale cyan glow, a small leather pouch hangs under the stock, and a geometric maker's mark sits by the lever.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。顶上方形箭匣加小铜铃是辨识点；整体圆润小巧，不要画成重弩。

subject.zh: 一盏方形玻璃提灯，直立，四分之三视角；四面是透明薄玻璃，镶镀金细框，顶上一只提环；灯心封着一粒白色立方盐晶，透出方块形的淡青光 #a8e0d8；镀金框上顺形刻细纹，底座一圈宝蓝镶线与一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A square glass hand lantern standing upright in three-quarter view; four panes of thin clear glass in fine gilded frames with a carrying ring on top. At its heart a single white cubic salt crystal is sealed in, casting a square-shaped soft pale cyan light (#a8e0d8); fine engraved lines follow the gilded frame, and the base has a royal blue inlay band and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。灯里那粒立方盐晶和方块形的光是辨识点；灯身是方的不是圆的。

subject.zh: 一枚金秤作印戒，倾斜约30度露出戒面；镀金厚戒圈 #e0b848，椭圆印面嵌深蓝玛瑙，上面阴刻一座拱桥托着天平的几何印纹；戒肩两侧顺弧刻纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；戒肩一侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A gold-scale signet ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face; a thick gilded band #e0b848 with an oval seal of deep blue agate, intaglio-cut with a geometric device of an arched bridge carrying a balance scale. Engraved lines follow the curve of both shoulders with a faint pale cyan glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits on one shoulder.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。拱桥托天平的印纹是辨识点，必须是图形不能有字；镀金要亮。

subject.zh: 一件金秤作军官胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；精钢胸板 #a8b0bc 镀金包边，胸口正中浮雕一架镀金天平；多道刻纹顺胸板弧线走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；肩甲系鲜红绶带，腰缘一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A gold-scale officer's cuirass seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; a fine steel breastplate #a8b0bc edged in gilding with a gilded balance scale in relief at the center of the chest. Engraved lines follow the curve of the plate with a faint pale cyan glow, bright red sashes tie at the pauldrons, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the waist edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。胸口正中的镀金天平是最大辨识点，32 像素里也要能看出天平形。

subject.zh: 一只深锤作板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上；方正的黑铁甲片 #3c3f46 层叠，指节排一列铆钉；手背嵌一块长方钟铜铭板 #b08840，上面是一行无字的几何契印；刻纹沿甲片走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光，腕口一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single deep-hammer plate gauntlet, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right; square, layered black iron plates #3c3f46 with a row of rivets across the knuckles. A rectangular bell bronze nameplate #b08840 is set into the back of the hand, bearing a line of textless geometric contract seals; engraved lines follow the plates with a faint fire orange glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the cuff.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手背的长方钟铜铭板是辨识点；铭板上只能是几何印，不能像字。

subject.zh: 一顶潜水头盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下；圆球形铜盔 #c87a48 带铜绿，正面一扇圆舷窗，下缘垂一圈锁子护颈；盔面刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路 #4a3a62 爬过盔顶；舷窗边缘结着一层金黄碎屑壳，侧面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A diving helmet in three-quarter front view, facing lower left; a round copper dome #c87a48 touched with verdigris, a circular porthole at the front, and a mail neck curtain hanging from the lower rim. Engraved lines glow faintly dusk violet while fine dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the crown; a crust of golden flakes has formed around the porthole rim, and a geometric maker's mark is on the side.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。球形铜盔加圆舷窗是轮廓；中澱纹的暗紫细纹与舷窗边金黄碎屑都要有。

subject.zh: 一件铃路作皮背心，尺寸偏小，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；浅褐软革 #8a5a34，前襟缝满大小不一的圆角口袋，袋盖各钉一颗铜扣；襟边顺形压纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；左肩挂一只小铜铃，下摆一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A bell-road leather vest, small in scale, seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; soft light brown leather #8a5a34 with the front covered in round-cornered pockets of many sizes, each flap fastened with a brass button. Pressed lines follow the edges with a faint pale cyan glow, a small brass bell hangs at the left shoulder, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the hem.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。满身圆角小口袋是辨识点；无袖背心，尺寸小巧，挂一只小铃。

subject.zh: 一枚拟金戒，倾斜约30度露出戒面；戒圈是几乎乱真的亮金色 #e8c050，素面圆戒台托着一颗金色小圆珠；戒圈顺形刻细纹，纹槽透极淡澱紫微光；金面上有几处灰中带紫的斑点，像镀层下透出底色；戒托侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A mimic-gold ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face; the band is a convincing bright gold #e8c050, with a plain round setting holding a small golden bead. Fine engraved lines follow the band with a faint dusk violet glow, and a few grey spots tinged with purple show through the gold like a base metal under plating; a geometric maker's mark sits on the side of the setting.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。轻澱纹只是几处灰紫斑点，不要画暗紫纹路；金色要像真金。

subject.zh: 一张倒木作紫杉长弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾；不上漆的红褐紫杉弓臂 #9a4a3a 露出木纹，弓弦是苍绿色；弓臂刻年轮纹顺弧走，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光 #7ac060；握把下系一枚苔绿与青灰绳编的结，弓梢一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A fallen-wood yew longbow standing nearly upright, bow back to the left, string on the right, upper tip leaning slightly right; unvarnished red-brown yew limbs #9a4a3a show their grain, and the string is a deep green. Growth-ring engravings follow the curve with a faint leaf green glow (#7ac060), a braided knot of moss green and slate grey cord hangs below the grip, and a geometric maker's mark sits at one tip.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。苍绿弓弦与握把下的绳结是辨识点；木面不上漆，与落枝弓的银白区分。

subject.zh: 一顶月银额环，四分之三侧前视，正面朝左下；细细的冷白银环 #e0e8f0 带浅蓝，额前分出两片叶形银饰，中间垂一粒水滴形月白珠；环身刻细细的年轮纹，纹槽透极淡冰蓝微光 #a0d0f0；环内衬一圈青灰细布，侧面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A moonsilver circlet in three-quarter front view, front facing lower left; a slender cold white-silver band #e0e8f0 tinted pale blue that splits at the brow into two leaf-shaped silver ornaments with a teardrop moon-white pearl hanging between them. Fine growth-ring engravings run along the band with a faint ice blue glow (#a0d0f0), a slate grey cloth lines the inside, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the side.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。额前两片银叶加一粒水滴珠是辨识点；整体冷白偏蓝，与星眼额环区分。

subject.zh: 一件倒木作林丝长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；浅绿银林丝 #c8dcc0 有一道柔光，前襟与袖口绣银灰苔藓状团纹；年轮式织纹顺衣褶下行，纹线透极淡叶绿微光；下摆层叠如垂苔，领口一枚木质几何匠记扣。
subject.en: A fallen-wood forest-silk robe seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; pale green-silver forest silk #c8dcc0 with one soft sheen, its front and cuffs embroidered with silver-grey moss-like rosettes. Growth-ring weave lines follow the folds with a faint leaf green glow, the hem falls in layers like hanging moss, and a wooden geometric maker's mark serves as the collar clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。浅绿银的丝光与垂苔般的层叠下摆是辨识点，与鳞书派长袍、穹纱长袍区分。

subject.zh: 一件倒木作树皮背心，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；由灰褐树皮片 #7a6a58 拼成，片缘自然卷翘、带苔绿斑；片面刻环状年轮纹，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光；树皮片用青灰皮绳穿系，胸口一枚根须盘成的几何匠记。
subject.en: A fallen-wood bark vest seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; pieced from grey-brown bark plates #7a6a58 whose edges curl naturally and carry moss green patches. Ring-shaped growth engravings on each plate glow faintly leaf green, the plates are laced together with slate grey leather cord, and a geometric maker's mark of coiled roots sits on the chest.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一片片自然卷边的树皮拼成甲身是辨识点，不要画成平整皮革。

subject.zh: 一顶雾叶面纱，四分之三侧前视，正面朝左下；青灰薄纱 #a8b8b0 半透明，从一条细细的叶形头箍垂到下巴，纱面缀几片银灰小叶；头箍刻细纹，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光；纱缘以苔绿细线锁边，额侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A mist-leaf veil in three-quarter front view, front facing lower left; translucent slate grey gauze #a8b8b0 hangs to the chin from a slender leaf-shaped headband, with a few small silver-grey leaves stitched onto the veil. Fine engraved lines on the headband glow faintly leaf green, the veil edge is hemmed in moss green thread, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the temple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。半透明垂纱遮住脸部是辨识点；只画面纱与头箍，不画脸。

subject.zh: 一条静苔眼带，四分之三侧前视，正面朝左下；一道宽宽的苔绿软革带 #5a7048 横过眼部，两端系青灰细绳；眼位处压出一对闭合的眼形弧纹，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光；带面缀几簇真苔，边缘压线，绳端一枚木质几何匠记。
subject.en: A still-moss eye band in three-quarter front view, front facing lower left; a broad band of moss green soft leather #5a7048 that would cross the eyes, tied with slate grey cords at both ends. A pair of closed-eye arcs is pressed where the eyes would be, glowing faintly leaf green, small tufts of real moss sit on the band with stitched edges, and a wooden geometric maker's mark hangs from a cord end.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一对闭眼弧纹是辨识点；是一条蒙眼带，不是额环或面纱。

subject.zh: 一根倒木作紫杉法杖，占满整条对角线，杖头在右上；不上漆的红褐紫杉杖身 #9a4a3a 自然弯曲，杖头盘着一圈带短刺的棘条，托住一粒苔绿木珠；杖身刻年轮纹顺纹理走，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光；杖尾包青灰铜箍，箍上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A fallen-wood yew staff spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; an unvarnished, naturally curving red-brown yew shaft #9a4a3a whose head is coiled with a ring of short-spined thorn stems cradling a moss green wooden bead. Growth-ring engravings follow the grain with a faint leaf green glow, and the butt is capped with a slate grey bronze ferrule bearing a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。杖头一圈带刺棘条是辨识点，与根须杖、门木杖的杖头区分。

subject.zh: 一只晨露泉布手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上；近白细布 #ece6d8 缝成，指尖染成渐淡的水青色；手背绣一枚水滴形纹，几道细绣线顺手指走，纹线透极淡浅青微光；腕口青灰镶线，缀几粒露珠般的小水晶，腕侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single morning-dew cloth glove, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right; sewn from near-white fine cloth #ece6d8 with fingertips dyed a fading water cyan. A teardrop motif is embroidered on the back, fine stitched lines run along the fingers with a faint pale cyan glow, and the cuff has slate grey piping, a few dewdrop-like crystal beads, and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。白布手套指尖渐变水青色是辨识点，与皮手套、板甲护手区分。

subject.zh: 一面心木圆盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者；整块深褐橡心木截面 #6a4628，盾面就是一圈圈紧密年轮，中心一块瘤状结疤凸起；年轮刻纹透极淡叶绿微光，盾缘绕一圈带细绿芽的活藤；背带青灰，缘上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A heartwood round shield in three-quarter view, face toward the viewer; a single cross-section of dark brown heartwood #6a4628 whose face is a tight spiral of growth rings around a raised burl at the center. The ring engravings glow faintly leaf green, a living vine with tiny green sprouts wraps the rim, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the edge beside a slate grey strap.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。整块截面年轮当盾面是辨识点；盾缘的活藤带绿芽，不要加金属包边。

subject.zh: 一杆骨角作角兽骑枪，占满整条对角线，枪头在右上；枪头是一根磨尖的长角，基部套铁箍 #7a7f88，枪杆缀几片骨片；角面顺形刻纹透极淡浅青微光；枪尾缠一大束红、黄、靛三色彩绳，垂下流苏，箍上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A bone-and-horn beast-rider lance spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; the head is a long sharpened horn set into an iron collar #7a7f88, and a few bone plates hang along the shaft. Engraved lines follow the horn with a faint pale cyan glow, a thick bundle of red, yellow and indigo cords wraps the butt and trails tassels, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。长角做枪头与枪尾三色彩绳流苏是辨识点，与铁蹄骑枪的铁枪区分。

subject.zh: 一柄骨角作双手骨锤，占满整条对角线，锤头在右上；锤头是一块巨大的熊掌骨节 #d8ccb0，外包一块灰岩，用彩绳捆紧；骨面顺形刻纹透极淡浅青微光；锤柄刻一列断剑形的几何纹，柄尾缀一枚熊爪和一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A bone-and-horn two-handed maul spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; the head is a huge bear paw knuckle bone #d8ccb0 bound to a block of grey stone with colored cords. Engraved lines follow the bone with a faint pale cyan glow, the haft carries a row of geometric broken-sword shapes, and a bear claw and a geometric maker's mark hang from the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。骨节加灰岩捆成的锤头是辨识点，与深锤作的方正铁锤完全不同。

subject.zh: 一只斑影夜爪拳套，单只，拳面朝右上，指节护甲清楚；哑光黑皮 #2a2826 上有暗褐豹斑，指节前伸出三根弯钩形黑骨爪；爪背细刻纹透极淡浅青微光；腕口缠暗色彩绳并缀骨片，整只哑光，腕侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single spot-shadow night claw gauntlet, fist facing upper right with clear knuckle armor; matte black leather #2a2826 with dark brown leopard spots and three hooked black bone claws jutting forward from the knuckles. Fine engraved lines on the backs of the claws glow faintly pale cyan, the cuff is wrapped in dark tribal cords strung with bone plates, the whole piece is matte, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the wrist.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。整只哑光不反光，三根弯钩骨爪是辨识点；豹斑要暗，不要鲜艳。

subject.zh: 一圈灰鬃誓绳，居中摆放，一段编成的灰白马鬃绳 #a8a49c 绕成闭合小环，顶端打一个紧实的死结；绳上串两颗骨珠，夹着一缕部族红绳；骨珠刻细纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；绳结下垂一片刻几何匠记的小骨片。
subject.en: A grey-mane oath cord centered in frame; a braided grey-white horsehair cord #a8a49c closed into a small loop and tied at the top in one tight, permanent knot. Two bone beads are strung on it with a strand of tribal red cord between them, their fine engravings glowing faintly pale cyan, and a small bone tag carved with a geometric maker's mark hangs below the knot.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。顶端那个大死结是辨识点；是一圈绳环，不是项链或手镯金属件。

subject.zh: 一件赤尾狐毛外套，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；外层是赤橙狐毛 #c86a30，前襟翻开一角露出里层灰褐鞣面，可两面穿；下摆缀一圈白尖狐尾；襟边骨扣顺形刻纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光，领口一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A red-tail fox fur coat seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; the outer face is red-orange fox fur #c86a30, and one front panel is folded back to show the grey-brown tanned inner side, worn either way. White-tipped fox tails trim the hem, the bone toggles along the front carry engraved lines with a faint pale cyan glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。翻开的一角露出另一面颜色，表示可两面穿；下摆白尖狐尾是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一顶獠牙劫掠盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下；铁灰圆顶盔 #7a7f88 下缘垂锁子护颈，两侧颊边各伸出一根真獠牙向上弯；盔顶缀彩绳与骨片；盔面顺形刻纹透极淡浅青微光，额前一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A tusk-fang raider helm in three-quarter front view, facing lower left; an iron-grey round dome #7a7f88 with a mail neck curtain, and a real tusk curving upward from each cheek. Colored cords and bone plates hang from the crown, engraved lines follow the dome with a faint pale cyan glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the brow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两颊向上弯的一对真獠牙是辨识点，要象牙白、粗大，32 像素里也能看清。

subject.zh: 一只疾耳信使皮靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下；轻软的浅褐皮革 #a07850，靴筒后缘竖起一对长耳形的皮翎；靴面顺形刻纹透极淡浅青微光；靴筒缠一道部族彩绳并缀一片骨片，脚踝侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single swift-ear courier boot in three-quarter side-front view, toe toward lower left; light, soft pale brown leather #a07850 with a pair of long ear-shaped leather flaps standing up from the back of the shaft. Engraved lines follow the upper with a faint pale cyan glow, a band of tribal colored cord with one bone plate wraps the shaft, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the ankle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。靴筒后的一对长耳形皮翎是辨识点；轻便短靴，不要画成重靴。

subject.zh: 一串祖灵骨风铃，直立，四分之三视角；一截弯曲的兽角作横梁，下垂几根长短不一的空心白骨管 #e0d8c0，彼此轻碰；骨管顺形刻纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；横梁缠红、靛彩绳，顶端一段系绳，梁端一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An ancestor bone wind chime standing upright in three-quarter view; a curved beast horn serves as the crossbar, with several hollow white bone tubes #e0d8c0 of different lengths hanging and touching below it. Engraved lines follow each tube with a faint pale cyan glow, red and indigo cords wrap the crossbar, a short cord rises from the top, and a geometric maker's mark sits at one end of the bar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。同名的另一件是单只钟形骨铃；这件必须画成一排垂管的风铃。

subject.zh: 一件骨角作角兽皮甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；厚实的灰褐角兽皮 #7a5a40 带粗毛边，肩头各缀一块短角片护肩；胸前以骨扣与彩绳交叉系紧；皮面顺形压纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光，腰缘一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A bone-and-horn beast hide jerkin seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; thick grey-brown hornbeast hide #7a5a40 with a rough fur edge and a short horn plate on each shoulder. The chest is laced crosswise with bone toggles and colored cord, pressed lines follow the hide with a faint pale cyan glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the waist edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两肩短角片护肩与胸前交叉彩绳是辨识点，与赤尾狐毛外套区分。

subject.zh: 一把夜铁作双手大剑，占满整条对角线，剑尖在右上；宽厚的夜铁剑身 #26232a 不反光，泛暗红光泽 #8a3030；护手做成多角冠形，刃脊刻一排角位刻痕；多道刻纹顺剑身走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光；柄尾嵌一块黑岩，有一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A night-iron two-handed greatsword spanning the full diagonal, point at upper right; a broad, thick night iron blade #26232a that does not reflect light, with a dull dark red sheen #8a3030. The crossguard is shaped like a many-horned crown, the spine carries a row of horn-rank notches, and engraved lines follow the blade with a faint fire orange glow; a black stone is set in the pommel beside a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。多角冠形护手与不反光的黑红剑身是辨识点；高光要压得很低。

subject.zh: 一件夜铁作鬼人板甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；宽大的夜铁胸板 #26232a 不反光，肩甲高耸成一对赤红短角 #a83030；胸板多道刻纹顺甲片走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光；甲片用暗红绳编缀，胸口一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A night-iron oni plate armor seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; a broad, oversized night iron breastplate #26232a that does not reflect light, with the pauldrons rising into a pair of short crimson horns #a83030. Engraved lines follow the plates with a faint fire orange glow, the plates are laced with dark red cord, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the chest.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。肩甲上一对赤红短角是辨识点；胸甲宽大厚重，不反光。

subject.zh: 一顶温泽夜纱兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下；半暗的蓝黑夜纱 #2a2e40 薄而透，层层垂到肩下，帽缘织一圈细小蛇鳞纹，纹线透极淡浅青微光；额前垂一片遮面的薄纱帘，帽侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A warm-fen night gauze hood in three-quarter front view, facing lower left; thin, translucent half-dark blue-black night gauze #2a2e40 falls in layers past the shoulders, and the hood edge is woven with a band of tiny serpent-scale motifs glowing faintly pale cyan. A sheer gauze curtain hangs over the face opening, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the side of the hood.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。层层半透明的蓝黑薄纱与额前垂帘是辨识点；帽里不画脸。

subject.zh: 一只滑翔手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上；深灰软革 #4a4450，从手腕到小指外侧连着一片可折起的薄皮翼膜，由几根细骨撑开；手背顺形刻纹透极淡浅青微光；腕口绕一圈暗红镶线，有一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single glider glove, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right; dark grey soft leather #4a4450 with a thin, foldable membrane wing running from the wrist to the outer edge of the little finger, held open by a few slender bone struts. Engraved lines follow the back of the hand with a faint pale cyan glow, and the cuff has a ring of dark red piping and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手侧张开的细骨翼膜是辨识点，与其他手套的轮廓明显不同。

subject.zh: 一只夜铁作决斗拳套，单只，拳面朝右上，指节护甲清楚；四个指节各立一枚短角形夜铁尖刺 #26232a，不反光；拳背刻一排角位刻痕，多道刻纹顺甲片走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光；腕口绕暗红皮带，系一块奖牌形小黑石与一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single night-iron duelling fist weapon, fist facing upper right with clear knuckle armor; a short horn-shaped night iron spike #26232a rises from each of the four knuckles, matte and unreflective. A row of horn-rank notches crosses the back of the fist, engraved lines follow the plates with a faint fire orange glow, and the cuff is wrapped in a dark red strap holding a small medal-shaped black stone and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。四个指节上的短角尖刺是辨识点，与斑影夜爪的弯钩骨爪区分。

subject.zh: 一枚夜铁作角位戒，倾斜约30度露出戒面；哑光夜铁戒圈 #26232a 带暗红光泽，戒面是一枚多角形小角片，角片边缘刻着一排短刻痕；戒圈顺弧细纹透极淡火橙微光；戒肩一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A night-iron horn-rank ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face; a matte night iron band #26232a with a dull dark red sheen, its face a small many-pointed horn plate whose edge is cut with a row of short notches. Fine engraved lines follow the band with a faint fire orange glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the shoulder.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。戒面多角角片边缘的一排短刻痕是辨识点；刻痕不能像数字。

subject.zh: 一把黑曜仪刀，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刀尖在右上；刀身是打制出贝壳状棱面的黑曜石 #1e1a24，刃缘薄而微透；夜铁刀柄缠暗红丝带；刀身刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路 #4a3a62 爬过刀柄；柄首一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An obsidian ritual knife lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; the blade is knapped obsidian #1e1a24 with shell-like facets and a thin, slightly translucent edge, on a night iron handle wrapped in dark red silk ribbon. Engraved lines on the blade glow faintly dusk violet, fine dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the handle, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。贝壳状打制棱面的黑曜刀身是辨识点，不是金属刃；中澱纹只到细纹。

subject.zh: 一面夜铁作城盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者；高大的多角形夜铁盾面 #26232a 不反光，上缘两角各镶一根弯獠牙；盾面中线一道暗红宽脊 #8a3030，脊上刻角位刻痕；刻纹顺盾缘走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光，下角一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A night-iron wall shield in three-quarter view, face toward the viewer; a tall, many-angled night iron face #26232a that does not reflect light, with a curved tusk set into each upper corner. A broad dark red ridge #8a3030 runs down the center carrying horn-rank notches, engraved lines follow the rim with a faint fire orange glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits in the lower corner.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。多角形盾面加上缘两根獠牙是辨识点，与长垒塔盾的长方形区分。

subject.zh: 一柄锁链连枷，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锤头在右上；木柄 #8a6040 顶端连着一段粗铁链，链尾坠一只箍成球形的旧镣铐 #7a7f88；链环与铁球刻几道顺形纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；柄上套一截断开的镣环当护手，柄尾一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A chain flail lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, head upper right; a wooden handle #8a6040 joined at the top to a length of heavy iron chain ending in an old shackle hammered into a ball #7a7f88. A few engraved lines follow the links and the ball with a faint pale cyan glow, a broken shackle ring slipped over the handle serves as a guard, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。镣铐打成的球头和柄上断开的镣环是辨识点，要看得出是锁链改的。

subject.zh: 一件鳞书派长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；深青墨色丝袍 #2a4048 有一道柔光，下摆缀满层叠的青铜绿小鳞片 #6a7a50；每片鳞上刻着不成字的点线纹，纹线透极淡浅青微光；领口一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A scale-script robe seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; deep teal-ink silk #2a4048 with one soft sheen, its hem covered in layered small bronze-green scales #6a7a50. Each scale is cut with dot-and-line marks that form no letters, glowing faintly pale cyan, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。下摆层叠的青铜绿鳞片是辨识点；鳞上纹样绝不能像任何文字。

subject.zh: 一柄穹铁双手巨斧，占满整条对角线，斧头在右上；宽阔的半月斧刃是灰白穹铁 #c8ccd8，表面散着几粒星点般的亮斑；斧颈方正厚重，铆钉排成矿纹；刻纹顺斧刃弧线走，纹槽透极淡冰蓝微光 #a0d0f0；斧柄包铁，有一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A vault-iron two-handed greataxe spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; a broad crescent blade of grey-white vault iron #c8ccd8 scattered with a few star-like bright specks. The neck is square and heavy with rivets laid out like an ore vein, engraved lines follow the curve of the edge with a faint ice blue glow (#a0d0f0), and the haft is iron-banded with a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。灰白斧面上的星点亮斑是穹铁的材料特征；不要画孔洞或网纹。

subject.zh: 一顶星眼额环，四分之三侧前视，正面朝左下；一条深蓝细布额带 #2a3460 绣着细小银点，额前正中镶一枚圆形穹铁眼座，托着一粒深蓝透镜，镜里有几点星光；带上细纹透极淡浅青微光；两侧系银坠，侧边一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A star-eye circlet in three-quarter front view, front facing lower left; a slender deep blue cloth band #2a3460 embroidered with tiny silver dots, with a round vault-iron eye setting at the center of the brow holding a deep blue lens that shows a few points of starlight. Fine lines on the band glow faintly pale cyan, silver drops hang at both sides, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the side.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。额前圆形透镜里的星点是辨识点，与月银额环的银叶水滴珠区分。

subject.zh: 一件穹铁锁甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；细密的灰白穹铁环 #c8ccd8 编成，环面散着几粒星点般的亮斑；领口与袖缘包一圈方正穹铁片，片上刻纹透极淡冰蓝微光；表面挂一层薄薄的白霜，胸前一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A vault-iron mail shirt seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; woven from fine grey-white vault iron rings #c8ccd8 scattered with a few star-like bright specks.
