Square vault-iron plates edge the collar and sleeves with engraved lines glowing faintly ice blue, a thin film of white frost covers the surface, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the chest.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。锁环质感加表面薄霜是辨识点，与门铜鳞片甲的暗金鳞片区分。

subject.zh: 一只渊兽皮靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下；未净的渊兽皮近黑 #1e1a22，泛暗紫光泽，靴筒保留一圈粗硬刺毛；靴面刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，暗紫纹路 #4a3a62 爬满表面，边缘绕一圈淡淡的暗雾；靴扣一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single abyss-beast hide boot in three-quarter side-front view, toe toward lower left; unpurified abyss hide, near black #1e1a22 with a dark purple sheen, keeping a ring of coarse bristly hair around the shaft. Engraved lines glow faintly dusk violet, dark purple veins #4a3a62 cover the surface, a faint ring of dark haze wraps the outline, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。重澱纹：暗紫纹路加边缘暗雾都要画；靴筒的粗刺毛是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一只深锤作炉心金手甲，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上；方正厚重的甲片是深橙金 #e0a030，像余火一样暖；指节排一列矿纹铆钉，手背中央镶一颗火玉；刻纹顺甲片走，纹槽透极淡火橙微光；腕甲黑铁包边，有一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single deep-hammer forgeheart gold gauntlet, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right; square, heavy plates of deep orange gold #e0a030, warm like embers, with a row of ore-vein rivets across the knuckles and a fire jade set in the center of the back. Engraved lines follow the plates with a faint fire orange glow, and the cuff is edged in black iron with a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。通体深橙金加手背火玉是辨识点，与契约名护手的黑铁钟铜区分。

subject.zh: 一张落枝长弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾；弓臂是一整根银白落枝 #e8e4d8，保留自然弯节，节上冒出几粒细小绿芽；弓臂刻年轮纹顺弧走，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光；握把缠苔绿细绳，弦是银绿丝，弓梢一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A fallen-branch longbow standing nearly upright, bow back to the left, string on the right, upper tip leaning slightly right; each limb is one whole silver-white fallen branch #e8e4d8 that keeps its natural knots, with tiny green buds sprouting from them. Growth-ring engravings follow the curve with a faint leaf green glow, the grip is wrapped in moss green cord, the string is silver-green silk, and a geometric maker's mark sits at one tip.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。银白木色与节上细小绿芽是辨识点，与红褐紫杉长弓区分。

subject.zh: 一盏王晶心灯，直立，四分之三视角；精雕银灯座托着一枚冠状透明浅青大棱晶 #a8e8e8，晶心一点亮光，四周两三颗单像素亮点；灯座多道刻纹顺弧走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；顶上一只银提环，灯座边缘一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A king-crystal heart lamp standing upright in three-quarter view; a finely carved silver base holds a large crown-shaped prism of clear pale cyan crystal #a8e8e8 with a bright point at its heart and two or three single-pixel sparkles around it. Engraved lines follow the curves of the base with a faint pale cyan glow, a silver carrying ring sits on top, and a geometric maker's mark is on the base rim.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。冠状大棱晶是净炼魔晶，透明浅青，不带任何灰或紫。

subject.zh: 一把门铜长剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；剑身是暗金铜色门铜 #9a7840，中段浮出一扇拱门形纹样；多道刻纹顺剑身走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；剑格做成两扇小门板的形状，柄首一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A gatebronze longsword lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; the blade is dark gold-bronze gatebronze #9a7840 with an arched doorway motif rising from its middle. Engraved lines follow the blade with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), the crossguard is shaped like a pair of small door leaves, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。剑身中段的拱门纹与门板形剑格是辨识点，与门刃的多色拼锻区分。

subject.zh: 一件门铜鳞片甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；层叠的门铜鳞片 #9a7840，每片都是一段小小的拱形门框，中间镂空；鳞片刻纹顺甲身走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；领口一圈暗金铜镶边，胸前一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A gatebronze scale coat seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; layered gatebronze scales #9a7840, each one a tiny arched door frame with an open center. Engraved lines follow the coat with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), a dark gold-bronze band trims the collar, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the chest.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。每片鳞都是镂空的小拱门框，这是唯一辨识点，32 像素里画成重复的小拱形。

subject.zh: 一根门木法杖，占满整条对角线，杖头在右上；深褐门木 #5a3a24 打磨得发亮，杖身留着家具式的车削圆箍和一个方榫眼；杖头是一个小小的拱门形木框，框内嵌暗金铜片；刻纹顺木纹走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890，杖尾一枚门形匠记。
subject.en: A gatewood staff spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; dark brown gatewood #5a3a24 polished to a shine, its shaft keeping furniture-style turned rings and one square mortise hole. The head is a small arched wooden door frame with a dark gold-bronze plate inside, engraved lines follow the grain with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), and a door-shaped maker's mark sits at the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。杖身的车削圆箍与方榫眼看得出原是家具木料，杖头是拱门框。

subject.zh: 一件穹纱长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；整件是近乎透明的灰白蓝薄纱 #c8d4e8，层层叠叠，纱面散着几粒星点般的亮斑；织纹顺衣褶垂下，纹线透极淡浅青微光；领口与袖缘一圈穹铁细边，下摆渐淡如云，领侧一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A vault gauze robe seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; made entirely of near-transparent grey-white-blue gauze #c8d4e8 in many layers, scattered with a few star-like bright specks. Woven lines fall with the folds and glow faintly pale cyan, thin vault-iron edging trims the collar and cuffs, and the hem fades away like cloud, with a small geometric maker's mark at the collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。近透明的层叠薄纱与星点亮斑是辨识点；不要用白金色或神光色。

subject.zh: 一面原龙鳞盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者；盾面是一整片巨大的龙鳞，形如尖底盾，深海青色 #2a5a5a 带珍珠般虹彩边；鳞面天然的放射细纹透极淡浅青微光；鳞缘只用一圈素银扣住，未打孔未切削，背缘一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An elder dragon scale shield in three-quarter view, face toward the viewer; the face is one single enormous dragon scale shaped like a pointed-base shield, deep sea teal #2a5a5a with a pearly iridescent rim. The scale's natural radiating fine lines glow faintly pale cyan, and it is held only by a plain silver rim clasp, undrilled and uncut, with a geometric maker's mark on the back edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。整片完整的鳞当盾面，不打孔不切削是辨识点；不要画成多片鳞拼接。

subject.zh: 一枚门晶吊坠居中，上方一小段暗金铜细链；坠身是一枚细长的淡金透明棱晶，晶心有一道门形亮影，透出极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；晶体由门铜 #9a7840 拱形托爪扣住，托爪刻细纹，托底一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A gate crystal pendant centered under a short length of fine dark gold-bronze chain; the charm is a slender clear prism tinted pale gold with a door-shaped bright shadow at its heart, giving off a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890). The crystal is held in arched gatebronze claws #9a7840 with fine engravings, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits at the base of the setting.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。晶心那道门形亮影是辨识点；晶体淡金透明，不要画成浅青魔晶。

subject.zh: 一把门扉作护卫佩剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；精钢剑身 #a8b0bc，护手由铜铁两色拼铆而成，两端做成小门扇形，剑格中央一枚门形徽记；剑身两道刻纹顺形走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光；柄缠深蓝皮条，柄首一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A gate-house guard sword lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; a fine steel blade #a8b0bc with a crossguard riveted together from copper and iron pieces, its ends shaped like small door leaves and a door-shaped emblem at its center. Two engraved lines follow the blade with a faint gate gold glow, the grip is wrapped in dark blue leather, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。铜铁两色拼铆的护手与门形徽记是门扉作语法；剑身是普通精钢不是门铜。

subject.zh: 一把村坊首炉短刀，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刀尖在右上；铁灰刀身 #7a7f88 刃口磨亮，刀背故意留着一排锻打锤痕；刀身两道顺形细纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；木柄 #8a6040 缠新麻绳，铜箍上压一枚小小的门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A village forge's first-made knife lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; an iron-grey blade #7a7f88 with a polished edge and a row of forging hammer marks deliberately left along the spine. Two fine engraved lines follow the blade with a faint pale cyan glow, the wooden handle #8a6040 is wrapped in fresh hemp cord, and a small door-shaped geometric maker's mark is stamped on the brass collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。刀背保留的锤痕和新麻绳显示是新炉的第一件；朴素但做工整齐。

subject.zh: 一件守望皮外套，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上；灰烬色硬革 #5a5450 边缘压线，立领翻毛；左胸绣一枚门形徽记，线迹透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；前襟两道压纹顺衣缝下行，铜扣成排，下摆一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A warden's leather coat seen from the front, slightly from above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at the top; ash-colored hard leather #5a5450 with stitched edges and a fur-lined standing collar. A door-shaped emblem is embroidered on the left chest with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), two pressed lines run down the front seams beside a row of brass buttons, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the hem.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。灰烬色外套加胸前门形徽记是辨识点；徽记移到正面，背面看不见。

subject.zh: 一把门扉作制式弩，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，握把在右下；铁灰弩臂与木弩身 #8a6040 由一排规整的方头螺栓拼接，零件接缝清楚；弩身侧面一枚门形徽记，顺形刻纹透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；扳机护圈旁一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A gate-house standard-pattern crossbow with the bow arms across the top and the stock angled down to the right, grip at lower right; iron-grey arms and a wooden stock #8a6040 joined by a row of uniform square-headed bolts with clearly visible part seams. A door-shaped emblem sits on the side of the stock, engraved lines glow faintly gate gold (#f0d890), and a geometric maker's mark sits by the trigger guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一排规整螺栓与清楚的零件接缝是辨识点，像可拆换的制式件。

subject.zh: 一枚门扉账房戒，倾斜约30度露出戒面；钟铜戒圈 #b08840，长方戒面被一道竖线分成左右两栏，各压一列对称的小方格纹；戒肩刻一枚门形徽记，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；戒托侧面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A gate-house ledger ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face; a bell bronze band #b08840 with a rectangular face split by one vertical line into two columns, each stamped with a matching row of small square cells. A door-shaped emblem is engraved on the shoulder with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), and a geometric maker's mark sits on the side of the setting.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。戒面左右两栏的对称方格是辨识点；方格里不能有数字。

subject.zh: 一面拾遗作塔盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者；高长的灰烬色铁盾 #6a6660，中央镂空出一个拱门形窗洞，洞缘嵌一圈钥匙齿状的铜边；古旧刻纹与崭新铆钉混在一起，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；下角一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A salvage-school tower shield in three-quarter view, face toward the viewer; a tall ash-colored iron shield #6a6660 with an arched doorway window cut through its center, the opening edged in copper notched like key teeth. Old worn engravings sit side by side with bright new rivets, the grooves glowing faintly gate gold (#f0d890), and a geometric maker's mark sits in the lower corner.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盾心镂空的拱门窗洞与旧纹新铆混搭是辨识点，与长垒塔盾区分。

subject.zh: 一只净澱者皮手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上；净过的兽皮呈浅灰青色 #9aa8a8，表面带细细的鳞状纹理；手背缝一块白色净纹皮片，几道刻纹顺手指走，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；腕口束硬革护腕，挂一只小药瓶扣，一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A single purifier's leather glove, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right; purified beast hide in a pale grey-cyan #9aa8a8 with a fine scaly texture. A white patch of purification-patterned leather is sewn on the back, engraved lines run along the fingers with a faint pale cyan glow, and a hard leather bracer at the cuff carries a small vial clip and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。已净过的皮，干净的浅灰青，不带任何紫色；手背白色净纹皮片是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一把门扉作杰作长剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；剑身由几种钢色分段拼锻而成，每段纹路手法各不相同；剑格是一个镂空的小拱门，门洞对着剑脊；多道刻纹沿剑身并行，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；柄首一枚门形匠记。
subject.en: A gate-house masterwork longsword lying at 45 degrees, grip lower left, point upper right; the blade is forge-joined from segments of several different steel tones, each segment patterned in a different craft style. The crossguard is a small open archway framing the spine, several engraved lines run in parallel along the blade with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), and a door-shaped maker's mark sits on the pommel.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。剑身分段多色、每段纹样不同是辨识点，与单一暗金色的门铜长剑区分。

subject.zh: 一盏钟形小提灯，居中，上方一小段系绳；钟铜灯罩 #b08840 开着细密的听孔，罩里封着一枚浑浊灰晶 #8a8a90，晶内一缕澱紫芯；灯罩刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，细细的暗紫纹路 #4a3a62 爬过罩面；底托一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A small bell-shaped hand lamp centered under a short cord; a bell bronze hood #b08840 pierced with fine listening holes, sealing in a cloudy grey crystal #8a8a90 with a wisp of dusk violet at its core. Engraved lines on the hood glow faintly dusk violet, fine dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over its surface, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the base.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。钟形灯罩加未净炼的浑浊灰晶是辨识点；晶是灰的，不要画成透明浅青。

subject.zh: 一杆守线长矛，占满整条对角线，矛头在右上；叶形铁矛头 #7a7f88 配灰褐木杆，杆上结着一层化不开的白霜；矛头两道刻纹顺形走，纹槽透极淡冰蓝微光 #a0d0f0；矛颈用粗大铆钉固定，缠一圈旧毛皮，铁箍上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A line-holder spear spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; a leaf-shaped iron spearhead #7a7f88 on a grey-brown wooden shaft coated in a layer of unmelting white frost. Two engraved lines follow the head with a faint ice blue glow (#a0d0f0), the neck is fixed with large rivets and wrapped in a band of old fur, and a geometric maker's mark sits on an iron collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。矛杆上的白霜是辨识点；北境粗铆钉与旧毛皮，朴实不华丽。

subject.zh: 一只驿卒铜铃，居中，上方一小段皮系带；铃身是赭橙旧铜 #c87a48 带一点铜绿，铃肩一圈门形镂空纹，铃舌微微下坠；铃面顺形刻纹，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光 #f0d890；系带穿过一只门形小铜扣，铃口一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A courier's copper bell centered under a short leather strap; an ochre-orange old copper body #c87a48 with a touch of verdigris, a ring of door-shaped openwork around its shoulder, and the clapper hanging just below the mouth. Engraved lines follow the bell with a faint gate gold glow (#f0d890), the strap passes through a small door-shaped copper buckle, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the rim.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。铃肩一圈门形镂空是辨识点；是腰挂小手铃，与两件祖灵骨铃区分。

subject.zh: 一盏矿灯，居中，顶上一只挂钩；短粗的铁灰灯身 #7a7f88 外罩铁丝护笼，玻璃罩里的灯芯是一粒透明浅青小晶 #a8e8e8，稳稳亮着；灯身刻纹透极淡浅青微光；底座沾着一点矿尘，侧面一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A miner's lamp centered with a hook on top; a short, stout iron-grey body #7a7f88 inside a wire guard cage, its glass chimney holding a small clear pale cyan crystal #a8e8e8 as the wick, glowing steadily. Engraved lines on the body glow faintly pale cyan, a little ore dust clings to the base, and a geometric maker's mark sits on the side.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。铁丝护笼与灯芯里的浅青小晶是辨识点，与听澱灯的灰晶钟形罩区分。

subject.zh: 一只遮页符铜匣，正面四分之三视角，上方一小段系绳；扁长的铜匣 #c87a48 带铜绿，匣盖微开，露出几张叠放的符纸边角；匣面刻满极小的点线纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；匣盖中央一条墨绿珐琅色带，搭扣旁一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A veil-charm copper case in three-quarter front view under a short cord; a flat, oblong copper box #c87a48 touched with verdigris, its lid slightly open to show the corners of a few stacked charm papers. Tiny dot-and-line patterns cover the case with a faint pale cyan glow, a dark green enamel band crosses the center of the lid, and a geometric maker's mark sits by the clasp.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。微开的匣盖露出符纸边角是辨识点；符纸上只能是几何纹。

subject.zh: 一枚旧港币，倾斜约30度露出币面；铜币 #c87a48 边缘被咬出一道弧形缺口，币面是一艘小帆船的几何纹章；几处灰绿霉斑覆在币面，霉斑之间细刻纹透极淡浅青微光；币缘一圈细密滚边，有一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An old harbor coin tilted about 30 degrees to show its face; a copper coin #c87a48 with an arc-shaped bite taken out of its edge, its face bearing a geometric device of a small sailing ship. A few grey-green mold spots cover the face, fine engraved lines between them glow faintly pale cyan, and the rim has fine milled edging and a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。边缘弧形咬口与霉斑是辨识点；币面不能有数字或字。

subject.zh: 一只祖灵骨铃，直立，四分之三视角；铃身是一整块打磨成钟形的白骨 #e0d8c0，铃舌是一颗兽牙；顶上的骨柄缠红、靛、黄三色彩绳并垂流苏；铃身刻满顺形的部族纹，纹槽透极淡浅青微光；柄端一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: An ancestor bone bell standing upright in three-quarter view; the body is a single piece of white bone #e0d8c0 ground into a bell shape, with a beast fang as the clapper. Red, indigo and yellow cords wrap the bone handle on top and trail tassels, tribal patterns cover the bell following its shape with a faint pale cyan glow, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the end of the handle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。单只钟形骨铃带骨柄，与同名的骨管风铃区分；兽牙铃舌要看得见。

subject.zh: 一根根须法杖，占满整条对角线，杖头在右上；杖身由许多活根须自己绞成，灰褐色 #7a6448，杖头的根须散开成一只镂空的笼，包着一颗嫩绿芽苞；根须间刻纹透极淡叶绿微光 #7ac060；根梢还在冒细白根毛，杖尾一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A rootlace staff spanning the full diagonal, head at upper right; the shaft is many living roots twisted together on their own, grey-brown #7a6448, which open at the head into an open cage around a tender green bud. Engravings between the roots glow faintly leaf green (#7ac060), fine white root hairs still sprout from the root tips, and a geometric maker's mark sits at the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。绞在一起的根须杖身与杖头根笼里的绿芽苞是辨识点；不要加紫色。

subject.zh: 一粒四季种，居中，上方一小段青灰系绳；拇指大的椭圆种子，外壳分成四瓣颜色：嫩绿、火红、琥珀黄、霜白，交界处是细细的刻纹，纹槽透极淡叶绿微光；种脐冒出一根小芽，系绳穿过一只木环，环上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A four-season seed centered under a short slate grey cord; a thumb-sized oval seed whose shell is divided into four colored quarters, tender green, fire red, amber yellow and frost white, with fine engraved seams between them glowing faintly leaf green. A small sprout rises from the hilum, and the cord passes through a wooden ring bearing a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。外壳四瓣四色是唯一辨识点，四色要分区清楚，不要混成渐变。

subject.zh: 一片汇点碎片，居中，上方一小段黑绳；一块不规则的黑紫色片状结晶 #2a2032，边缘薄而锋利，像凝固的深色液面；多道纹路透极淡澱紫微光，暗紫纹路 #4a3a62 爬满晶面，边缘绕一圈淡淡的暗雾；黑绳由夜铁扣固定，扣上一枚几何匠记。
subject.en: A sink shard centered under a short black cord; an irregular flake of black-violet crystal #2a2032 with thin, sharp edges, like the surface of a dark liquid frozen in place. Several lines glow faintly dusk violet, dark purple veins #4a3a62 cover the crystal, a faint ring of dark haze wraps the outline, and a night iron clasp holding the cord bears a geometric maker's mark.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。重澱纹：暗紫纹路加边缘暗雾；片状像凝固液面，不要画成尖棱晶簇。

subject.zh: 一只旧铁左拳套，单只，拳面朝右上，指节护甲清楚。铁灰甲片#7a7f88被磨得发亮，指节上密密咬满一排排月牙形浅凹痕；腕口一圈红漆#b03030剥落大半，拳背立一枚弯弯的红漆兽牙；刻纹布满甲片，透稳定的火橙柔光#f0a040，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An old iron left gauntlet, single, knuckles toward the upper right, knuckle plates clear. Iron-grey plates #7a7f88 rubbed shiny, the knuckles packed with rows of shallow crescent dents like bite marks; the red lacquer #b03030 around the cuff has mostly flaked away, and a curved red-lacquered fang stands on the back of the fist; engravings cover the plates with a steady fire-orange glow #f0a040 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。指节上的月牙形咬痕是标志；必须是左手；与传器红牙那对拳套共用红漆兽牙与火橙光。

subject.zh: 一把双手宽刃长刀，占满整条对角线，刀尖在右上。宽厚的单刃铁刀身#7a7f88素面无纹，刀背一道被重物长年压出的平直旧痕；长柄缠旧皮，握处磨得发亮，护手是一块朴素方铁；只在刃口透一线稳定的淡青柔光#a8e0d8，一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A broad two-handed long blade filling the whole diagonal, point at upper right. A thick single-edged iron blade #7a7f88, plain and unengraved, with one flat old dent pressed straight along the spine by years under a heavy weight; the long grip is wrapped in old leather rubbed shiny where the hands go, and the guard is a plain square of iron; only the edge carries a steady thin pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, with one single-pixel highlight.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。表面上是一把朴素旧刀：不加满身刻纹与纹章，名器感只在磨痕和刃口微光；刀背压痕是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一把量产铁剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。普通铁剑身#7a7f88被反复研磨得略窄，没有刻纹；剑柄和剑根裹着一层褪色的黄褐油布#a08a58，用旧麻绳缠紧，布角磨毛；刃口一线极稳的淡青柔光，剑尖一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A mass-produced iron sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. An ordinary iron blade #7a7f88 honed so many times it has grown slightly narrow, with no engraving; the hilt and blade root are wrapped in faded yellow-brown oilcloth #a08a58 bound tight with old hemp cord, its corners frayed; one very steady thin pale-cyan glow along the edge and a single-pixel highlight at the point.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。看上去必须像便宜货：无纹、无宝石、护手最简单；褪色油布裹柄是唯一标志。

subject.zh: 一把晶背剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢剑身#a8b0bc，剑背嵌一条分节的半透明甲壳晶片#b8ccd0，像叠起的鳞壳；刃根留着细密锤痕，剑尖的刃角微微偏斜；刻纹顺剑身铺开，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，晶片一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A crystal-backed sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A fine steel blade #a8b0bc with a segmented ridge of translucent carapace crystal #b8ccd0 set along its back like overlapping shell plates; fine hammer marks remain at the blade root and the angle of the point is slightly off true; engravings spread along the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, and one single-pixel highlight on the crystal.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。剑背的半透明甲壳晶片是标志，不要浑浊灰晶与紫色；与晶脊长剑的尖刺区分。

subject.zh: 一把矮人终器单手剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。方肩厚刃的精钢剑身#a8b0bc，中脊嵌一道余火般暖亮的炉心金#e0a030；方正护手铆钉排成矿纹，正中镶一颗冠状浅青王晶#a8e8e8；刻纹布满剑身，透稳定的火橙柔光，三颗亮点。
subject.en: A dwarven final-work one-handed sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A square-shouldered, thick fine-steel blade #a8b0bc with a strip of forge-heart gold #e0a030 inlaid down the central ridge, warm and bright as embers; the squared crossguard has rivets laid out like an ore vein, with a crown-shaped pale-cyan king crystal #a8e8e8 set at its centre; engravings cover the blade with a steady fire-orange glow #f0a040 and three single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。这是默认图标（玩家选类，本图按单手剑形态）；中脊炉心金与护手王晶是标志，方正厚重。

subject.zh: 一根圣女光环短杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。白瓷釉短杖身#ece6d8包银边，杖顶立着一圈细金光环#d8a840，环心悬一颗珍珠白小珠；对称的光纹布满杖身，透稳定的神光白金柔光#fff0c0，握处银箍被磨亮，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A saint's halo wand at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A short white-porcelain-glazed shaft #ece6d8 edged in silver, topped by a slender upright gold ring halo #d8a840 with a small pearl-white bead hanging at its centre; symmetrical ray engravings cover the shaft with a steady divine white-gold glow #fff0c0, the silver band at the grip is rubbed bright, and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。杖顶直立的金光环是标志；白冕作的白金浅蓝，不加紫；与朝圣杖和破晓晶杖区分。

subject.zh: 一把静钟细剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。极细的银白精钢剑身#c8ccd4，护手是一口倒扣的小钟形杯罩，钟里没有钟舌；冷灰皮握柄被磨出光，刻纹布满剑身与钟面，透稳定的神光白金柔光#fff0c0，钟沿一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A still-bell rapier at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A very slender silver-white steel blade #c8ccd4 whose guard is a small upturned bell-shaped cup with no clapper inside; the cool grey leather grip is worn glossy, and engravings cover the blade and the bell with a steady divine white-gold glow #fff0c0, with one single-pixel highlight on the bell rim.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。无舌钟形杯护手是标志，与看守锁甲的无舌钟呼应；教会之物不加紫，与宫廷细剑的鎏金篮柄区分。

subject.zh: 一面旧木圆盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。中褐木板#8a6040包铁边，盾面布满一圈圈从中心向外扩散的浅击痕，像水面涟漪；铁盾心磨得锃亮，盾缘系一条褪色布条像小旗；刻纹铺满盾面，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An old wooden round shield in front-facing three-quarter view, tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. Mid-brown planks #8a6040 with an iron rim, the face covered in rings of shallow blow marks spreading out from the centre like ripples on water; the iron boss is rubbed to a shine and a faded strip of cloth is tied to the rim like a small flag; engravings spread over the face with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8 and one single-pixel highlight.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。涟漪状的层层击痕与盾缘布条是标志；仍是朴素木盾，与量产凹痕圆盾的单个凹坑区分。

subject.zh: 一张灰鬃长弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。深褐硬木弓臂#5a3e28贴着灰角片，两梢各垂一缕灰白鬃毛#c8c4bc；握把缠褪色的部族彩绳，绳已磨得发白；刻纹布满弓臂，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，弓梢两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A grey-mane longbow, upright and slightly tilted, back of the bow to the left and string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. Dark brown hardwood limbs #5a3e28 faced with grey horn strips, a lock of grey-white mane hair #c8c4bc hanging from each tip; the grip is wrapped in faded tribal-coloured cords worn almost white; engravings cover the limbs with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8 and two single-pixel highlights at the tips.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。两梢垂下的灰白鬃毛是标志；彩绳褪色发白，与苍弦紫杉长弓的苍绿弦区分。

subject.zh: 一根雀巢藤杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。浅褐藤条#a88050绞成杖身，杖头弯成一个钩，钩里托着一只小小的草编鸟巢，巢沿探出一只褐白小麻雀的头；握处藤皮磨得油亮，藤纹间刻纹透稳定的叶绿柔光#7ac060，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A sparrow-nest rattan staff at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A shaft of twisted light-brown rattan #a88050 whose head curls into a hook cradling a tiny woven grass nest, with the head of a small brown-and-white sparrow peeking over the rim; the rattan is polished glossy where it is held, and engravings among the twists give a steady leaf-green glow #7ac060, with two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。杖头钩里的草巢与探头小雀是标志，雀要小；与雀羽香囊的布袋区分。

subject.zh: 一柄守夜战锤，占满整条对角线，锤头在右上。方正的银白精钢锤头#c8ccd4，锤背弯出一枚新月形尖喙；长柄缠一条褪色的浅蓝旧布，握处磨得发亮；对称的放射刻纹布满锤头，透稳定的神光白金柔光#fff0c0，喙尖一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A vigil warhammer filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. A squared silver-white steel head #c8ccd4 whose back curves into a crescent-moon beak; the long haft is wrapped in a faded old pale-blue cloth rubbed shiny at the grip; symmetrical radiating engravings cover the head with a steady divine white-gold glow #fff0c0, and one single-pixel highlight on the tip of the beak.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。新月形锤背尖喙与褪色浅蓝旧布是标志；不加紫，与赦罪锤的方块纹章锤头区分。

subject.zh: 一面灰墙作旧盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。偏小的灰褐铁木盾#7a7470，盾面被大小不一的铁片铆补拼满，一道粗糙的灰白横条被补片截成几段；上缘包一圈毛皮，粗铆钉旁满是修补痕；刻纹布满盾面，透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An old greywall-style shield in front-facing three-quarter view, tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. A slightly small grey-brown iron-and-wood shield #7a7470 patched all over with riveted iron plates of mismatched sizes, a rough grey-white horizontal stripe #c8c8c0 broken into pieces by the patches; the top edge is trimmed with fur and the heavy rivets sit among unpolished repairs; engravings cover the face with a steady pale-cyan glow and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。满面拼补的铁片和被截断的灰横条是标志；比制式塔盾小，是少年兵用的尺寸。

subject.zh: 一杆灰狼戟，占满整条对角线，戟刃在右上。长弧形铁灰戟刃#7a7f88，刃背削成一排狼牙般的锯齿，刃下系一束灰狼毛；深红漆长杆#7a2a2a握处磨亮，杆箍上一枚断剑形几何徽记与无字编号刻痕；刻纹布满戟刃，透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A grey-wolf glaive filling the whole diagonal, blade at upper right. A long curved iron-grey blade #7a7f88 whose back is cut into a row of wolf-tooth serrations, with a tuft of grey wolf fur #9a9690 tied beneath it; the deep-red lacquered haft #7a2a2a is rubbed bright at the grip, and its collar carries a broken-sword geometric emblem and unlettered tally notches; engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。狼牙锯齿刃背与灰狼毛束是标志；军坊作铁灰深红，与近卫斧戟的麦穗纹区分。

subject.zh: 一柄赤铁大斧，占满整条对角线，斧头在右上。多角的夜铁斧头#26232a不反光，黑铁里渗着一缕缕红锈色纹#a04a30；宽刃上刻满一排排角位胜痕，斧背立一枚短角；长柄缠暗红皮，握处磨亮；刻纹透稳定的火橙柔光#f0a040，刃口两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A red-iron greataxe filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. A many-angled night-iron head #26232a with no shine, threaded with streaks of red-rust colour #a04a30 through the black; the broad blade is carved with row upon row of horn-rank victory notches and a short horn stands on its back; the long haft is wrapped in dark red leather rubbed glossy at the grip; engravings give a steady fire-orange glow #f0a040, with two single-pixel highlights on the edge.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。黑里渗红锈的斧面与满刃角位刻痕是标志；不反光，与暮冠大剑区分。

subject.zh: 一根鳞母杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。蛇身般蜿蜒的墨绿木杖#2e4a40，杖头用细绳垂下一串青绿虹光的大鳞片#3a7a6a，每片刻满细密的抽象划痕；握处磨亮，刻纹布满杖身，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，鳞片上两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A scale-mother staff at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A dark green wooden shaft #2e4a40 winding like a snake's body, its head hung on fine cords with a cluster of large teal scales #3a7a6a with an iridescent sheen, each scratched full of fine abstract marks; the grip is worn smooth, and engravings cover the shaft with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, with two single-pixel highlights on the scales.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。杖头垂下的一串刻痕鳞片是标志，划痕不能像字；与鳞书法袍区分。

subject.zh: 一把高巢手弩，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，握把在右下。黑铁弩身#3c3f46，弩臂是一对张开的皮膜翼骨，翼骨间绷着暗褐皮膜，弩托下系着一小卷封了暗红蜡的纸卷；握把磨亮，刻纹布满弩身，透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A high-nest hand crossbow, arms across the top and stock slanting to the lower right, grip at lower right. A black-iron stock #3c3f46 whose arms are a pair of spread membrane wing bones with dark brown membrane stretched between them, and a small paper roll sealed with dark red wax tied beneath the stock; the grip is worn bright, and engravings cover the stock with a steady pale-cyan glow and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。张开带皮膜的翼骨弩臂和弩托下的蜡封纸卷是标志；与翼魔斥候手弩收拢的翅骨区分。

subject.zh: 一只裂石熊掌拳套，单只，拳面朝右上，指节护甲清楚。厚重的深褐熊皮手套#4a3426，指节上用彩绳捆着一块灰岩板#8a8680，岩板中间裂开一道深缝；拳前伸出五枚短黑熊爪；皮毛磨秃一片，刻纹布满甲面，透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A stone-breaker bear-paw gauntlet, single, knuckles toward the upper right, knuckle armour clear. A heavy dark brown bearskin glove #4a3426 with a slab of grey rock #8a8680 lashed over the knuckles with coloured cord, a deep crack splitting the slab down the middle; five short black bear claws jut from the fist; one patch of fur is worn bald, and engravings cover the armour with a steady pale-cyan glow and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。指节上裂开的灰岩板与五枚熊爪是标志；与斑影夜爪和决斗拳套的尖刺区分。

subject.zh: 一对无声双牙匕首，两把交叉成X形，握柄在下、刃尖分别朝左上与右上。弯如兽牙的哑光黑钢刃#2e2c2a，刃面布满暗褐斑点；握柄裹着柔软的斑纹兽毛，柄尾缀骨片；整对几乎不反光，刻纹顺刃走，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A pair of silent fang daggers crossed in an X, grips at the bottom and points toward the upper left and upper right. Fang-curved matte black steel blades #2e2c2a speckled with dark brown spots; the grips are wrapped in soft spotted fur with bone chips hanging from the pommels; the pair barely reflects light, and engravings follow the blades with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。成对交叉、哑光不反光；兽牙弯刃加斑纹毛裹柄是标志，与灰牙匕首区分。

subject.zh: 一把天平剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢剑身#a8b0bc，镀金十字护手#e0b848做成一根天平横梁，两端各吊一只小小的天平盘；握柄缠鲜红丝绳，柄首宝蓝珐琅；刻纹布满剑身，透稳定的浅青柔光，护手被摩挲得发亮，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A balance-scale sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A fine steel blade #a8b0bc whose gilded crossguard #e0b848 is shaped as a balance beam with a tiny scale pan hanging from each end; the grip is wrapped in bright red silk cord and the pommel is royal-blue enamel; engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow, the guard is rubbed bright by handling, and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。护手两端吊着的小天平盘是标志；金秤作鲜艳镀金，与决斗佩刀的鞘区分。

subject.zh: 一把铁誓剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。宽直的铁灰军用剑身#7a7f88，剑根箍着一只厚重的粗铁环，像一道锻死的誓环；刃上几处磨平的旧缺口，深红握柄磨得发黑，柄头一枚断剑形几何徽记；刻纹布满剑身，透稳定的浅青柔光，一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An iron-oath sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A broad straight iron-grey military blade #7a7f88 with a thick rough iron ring clamped around its root like a vow band forged shut; a few old nicks on the edge have been ground smooth, the deep red grip is worn nearly black, and the pommel bears a broken-sword geometric emblem; engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow and one single-pixel highlight.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。剑根锻死的粗铁环是标志；老兵用的朴实军剑，与军团短剑的叶形刃区分。

subject.zh: 一根月角杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。灰褐木杖身#7a6448，杖顶是一枚弯成新月的象牙白长角#e8e0cc，角面彩绘赭红与靛蓝的环带；角下挂一串骨珠与彩绳；刻纹布满杖身，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，角尖两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A moon-horn staff at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A grey-brown wooden shaft #7a6448 topped by a long ivory-white horn #e8e0cc curved into a crescent moon, painted with bands of ochre red and indigo; a string of bone beads and coloured cords hangs below the horn; engravings cover the shaft with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, and two single-pixel highlights on the horn tip.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。新月形彩绘长角是标志；骨角作彩绳骨珠，不加门扉金，与祖骨鸣铃区分。

subject.zh: 一把狮首剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢剑身#a8b0bc磨得像镜子；柄首是一颗张口的镀金狮头#e0b040，鬃毛卷曲分明，剑格方正合身压一枚锤形印；刻纹布满剑身，透稳定的浅青柔光，狮头被摸得最亮，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A lion-head sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A fine steel blade #a8b0bc polished like a mirror; the pommel is a gilded lion's head #e0b040 with open jaws and a crisply curled mane, and the neat square guard carries a hammer-shaped stamp; engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow, the lion head is rubbed brightest of all, and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。柄首镀金张口狮头要够大、32像素可读；河谷行会作的锤形印，与骑士授剑区分。

subject.zh: 一把老骑士剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。修长的旧精钢剑身#a8b0bc微微发乌，护手正中嵌一枚冠形几何纹章；柄首穿一个褪色的深蓝绳环，像长年挂在床头；握柄皮面龟裂，刻纹布满剑身但柔光偏弱，淡浅青，一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An old knight's sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A long slender old steel blade #a8b0bc gone slightly dull, a crown-shaped geometric crest set at the centre of the guard; a faded deep-blue cord loop passes through the pommel as if it had hung from a bedpost for years; the grip leather is crackled, and engravings cover the blade but their glow is weak, a faint pale cyan, with one single-pixel highlight.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。柄首褪色的深蓝挂绳与冠形纹章是标志；光要比其他名器弱，显得老。

subject.zh: 一面古老的长方大盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。厚重的旧精钢盾面#9aa0aa，斜斜划过三道深深的平行爪痕；上缘凝着几道白色烛泪#ece6d8；边框磨得圆润，刻纹布满盾面，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An ancient rectangular great shield in front-facing three-quarter view, tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. A heavy old steel face #9aa0aa slashed diagonally by three deep parallel claw gouges; a few drips of white candle wax #ece6d8 have hardened along the top edge; the frame is worn round, and engravings cover the face with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。三道平行深爪痕与上缘白烛泪是标志；长方大盾，与灰墙旧盾的拼补和守冢盾的苔斑区分。

subject.zh: 一杆古门戟，占满整条对角线，戟头在右上。暗金铜色门铜戟头#9a7840，斧刃中央镂空出一个拱门形窗洞；表面覆着一层灰烬色积尘，长杆握处被磨出深深的手形凹槽；纹路布满戟头，透稳定的门扉金柔光#f0d890，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An ancient gate halberd filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. A dark gold-bronze gate-bronze head #9a7840 with an arch-shaped window pierced through the middle of the axe blade; the surface carries a layer of ash-grey dust, and the long haft is worn into a deep hand-shaped groove at the grip; patterns cover the head with a steady gate-gold glow #f0d890 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。斧刃上的拱门形镂空与握处深凹槽是标志；门扉金可用于此戟，与执钥塔盾的窗洞区分。

subject.zh: 一根沙盘指挥杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。整根是锻成的透明浅青大晶#a8e8e8，杖身刻满像地形等高线的细纹，两端包铁灰银箍；杖头是一颗多面晶块，面上刻细细的方格；握处晶面被摸得温润，透稳定的浅青柔光，三颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A sand-table command baton at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. The whole baton is forged from a large clear pale-cyan crystal #a8e8e8, its shaft engraved all over with fine lines like terrain contours, both ends capped with iron-grey silver bands; the head is a faceted crystal block scored with a fine grid; the crystal is worn smooth where it is held, with a steady pale-cyan glow and three single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。通体晶质加等高线细纹与方格杖头是标志；短而直，与学士录杖区分。

subject.zh: 一把家传长剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢剑身#a8b0bc，剑格方正合身压一枚锤形印；柄首是一枚圆盘，蓝银珐琅上嵌一座几何塔楼纹章，盘缘磨出一圈光；柄上垂一条红穗；刻纹布满剑身，透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A house heirloom longsword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A fine steel blade #a8b0bc with a neat square guard stamped with a hammer mark; the pommel is a round disc of blue and silver enamel set with a geometric tower crest, its rim rubbed to a shine; a red tassel hangs from the grip; engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。蓝银圆盘柄首上的塔楼纹章与红穗是标志；与行会剑、骑士授剑的溪流圆章区分。

subject.zh: 一根折断的贤者法杖，断成两截并排斜放，杖头一截在右上。灰白古木#a8a090杖身，断口参差露出木丝，两截的下端都裹着干结的泥土；杖头托一颗暗淡的浅青晶球；刻纹布满两截，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，晶球一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A broken sage's staff in two pieces laid side by side on the diagonal, the head piece toward the upper right. A pale grey ancient wooden shaft #a8a090 with jagged breaks showing splintered fibres, the lower ends of both pieces caked in dried earth; the head holds a dim pale-cyan crystal orb; engravings cover both pieces with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, and one single-pixel highlight on the orb.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。必须画成两截，断口参差、下端带泥；不要画成完整的杖。

subject.zh: 一件殉光胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。纯净的白瓷釉板甲#ece6d8配金边#d8a840，胸口浮雕一面小盾，盾心一圈放射光纹；胸板一道竖向裂痕用金线补起；对称纹布满甲面，透稳定的神光白金柔光#fff0c0，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A martyr's breastplate, front view tilted slightly from above as if on an invisible stand, shoulders at the top. Pure white porcelain-glazed plate #ece6d8 with gold edging #d8a840, a small shield in relief on the chest with a ring of radiating light lines at its centre; one vertical crack down the breastplate has been mended with gold; symmetrical patterns cover the armour with a steady divine white-gold glow #fff0c0 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。只用纯白瓷与金，绝不加紫或暗纹；胸前小盾浮雕与金线补裂是标志。

subject.zh: 一柄千骨链枷，斜放45度，握柄在左下、枷头垂在右上。骨白短柄#d8d0b8，连着一串由椎骨串成的短链，枷头是一团用细骨捆成的圆球；细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过骨面，刻纹透稳定的澱紫柔光，握处骨面磨得发亮，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A thousand-bone flail at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head hanging toward the upper right. A short bone-white handle #d8d0b8 joined to a short chain strung from vertebrae, the head a round ball of small bones bound tight together; thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the bone, engravings give a steady dusky purple glow, the handle is worn glossy where held, and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。椎骨链和细骨捆成的球头是标志；中档澱纹只是细纹，与千骨肋甲的肋条区分。

subject.zh: 一柄灰牙巨斧，占满整条对角线，斧头在右上。斧头是一颗扁平巨大的灰白磨牙#a8a298，咬合面布满一圈圈石磨般的同心棱纹；牙根套黑铁箍#3c3f46，长木柄#6a4628握处磨亮；刻纹布满牙面，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A grinding-tooth greataxe filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. The head is a huge flat grey-white molar #a8a298 whose biting face is covered in concentric ridges like a millstone; the root is set in a black-iron collar #3c3f46 and the long wooden haft #6a4628 is rubbed bright at the grip; engravings cover the tooth with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。石磨般同心棱纹的扁磨牙斧头是标志；不是刃形斧，与灰烬巨剑和兽牙匕首区分。

subject.zh: 一盏引导者门灯，直立，四分之三视角。黑铁六角灯框#3c3f46顶有提环，提环被磨得发亮；一面灯罩上贴着一张边角翘起的白纸拓片，拓着一个门形纹样；灯里透出稳定的门扉金柔光#f0d890，框上刻纹布满，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A guide's gate lantern, upright, three-quarter view. A black-iron hexagonal frame #3c3f46 with a carrying ring on top worn shiny; one pane is covered by a pasted white paper rubbing, its corners curling up, showing a door-shaped pattern; a steady gate-gold glow #f0d890 shines from inside, engravings cover the frame, and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。灯罩上翘角的门形拓片是标志，拓纹不能像字；与守墓人提灯的泛黄墨线纸区分。

subject.zh: 一把斗场冠军剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢剑身#a8b0bc一侧刻满一排排整齐的细短竖痕，密到剑尖；护手与握柄沾着洗不掉的红砾色#b0583a，握皮被汗磨得发黑；刻纹布满剑身，透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An arena champion's sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. One flat of the fine steel blade #a8b0bc is carved with row after row of neat short vertical tally marks running all the way to the point; the guard and grip are stained an indelible red-gravel colour #b0583a and the grip leather is sweat-worn nearly black; engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。剑身上密密的短竖刻痕是标志，不能像数字；红砾色只在护手与柄上。

subject.zh: 一把祭斗冠军双手刃，占满整条对角线，刃尖在右上。宽阔的夜铁刃#26232a不反光，刃背带一排锯齿，刃脊刻角位刻痕；柄首挂着一长串彩色短绳结，一结挨一结；握处磨亮，刻纹布满刃身，透稳定的火橙柔光#f0a040，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A festival champion's two-handed blade filling the whole diagonal, point at upper right. A broad night-iron blade #26232a with no shine, a row of saw teeth along its back and horn-rank notches on the spine; a long string of short coloured cord knots hangs from the pommel, knot after knot; the grip is worn bright, and engravings cover the blade with a steady fire-orange glow #f0a040 and two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。柄首一长串彩色绳结与锯齿刃背是标志；与暮冠大剑的冠形护手区分。

subject.zh: 一把沉船旗舰弯刀，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刀尖在右上。宽弧的精钢刀身#a8b0bc，黄铜贝壳篮柄长满铜绿#5a9a80，上面粘着几簇小藤壶；刻纹布满刀身，透稳定的冰蓝柔光#a0d0f0，握处仍被磨亮，刀尖两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A sunken flagship cutlass at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A broad curved fine steel blade #a8b0bc with a brass shell-shaped basket hilt thick with verdigris #5a9a80 and crusted with a few clusters of small barnacles; engravings cover the blade with a steady ice-blue glow #a0d0f0, the grip still rubbed bright, and two single-pixel highlights at the point.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。篮柄上的铜绿与藤壶是标志；冰蓝光，与盐蚀弯刀的云状盐纹区分。

subject.zh: 一幅夜纱面纱，居中垂挂，上缘一条细绳带。半暗的蓝黑夜纱#2a2e40薄而透，下摆垂成柔和的弧，边缘缀一排细小的银鳞形珠；纱面织进一层细碎的银色散光点，像夜空洒了粉；整幅泛稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，三颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A night-gauze face veil hanging at the centre from a thin cord band along its top edge. Half-dark blue-black night gauze #2a2e40, thin and sheer, falling to a soft curved hem edged with a row of tiny silver scale-shaped beads; a layer of fine scattered silver glints is woven into the gauze like powder across a night sky; the whole veil holds a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8 and three single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。平挂的一幅面纱，不戴在头上；散光点与鳞形珠边是标志，与夜纱兜帽区分。

subject.zh: 一对红牙铁拳套，两只并排，拳面都朝右上。左只是新淬的多角夜铁#26232a，不反光；右只是磨亮的旧铁，指节咬满月牙形凹痕；两只拳背各立一枚红漆兽牙#b03030，刻纹布满甲面透火橙柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素火橙光晕，三颗亮点。
subject.en: A pair of red-fang iron gauntlets side by side, both knuckles toward the upper right. The left one is freshly quenched, many-angled night iron #26232a with no shine; the right one is old iron #7a7f88 rubbed bright, its knuckles packed with crescent bite dents; a red-lacquered fang #b03030 stands on the back of each fist, engravings cover the plates with a fire-orange glow #f0a040, a one-pixel fire-orange halo runs along part of the outer outline, and three highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。必须是一新一旧的一对：旧的那只与旧左拳同样的咬痕，新的那只黑而多角；红漆兽牙成对。

subject.zh: 一把无铭长剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。毫无装饰的精钢剑身#a8b0bc，没有任何刻纹，被几十年研磨得略窄，刃口一线锋利的亮光；一字铁护手，旧皮握柄磨出手指的凹痕；剑身自带稳定的浅青柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: An unnamed longsword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. A completely unadorned fine steel blade #a8b0bc with no engraving at all, narrowed slightly by decades of honing, one keen bright line along the edge; a plain straight iron crossguard and an old leather grip worn into finger grooves; the blade itself holds a steady pale-cyan glow, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。唯一不加刻纹的传器：朴素到极致就是它的辨识点；不加宝石、纹章与神光白金。

subject.zh: 一根会发芽的白木杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。整根银白落枝木#e8e4d8，节上冒细绿芽，杖头分出几根细枝，撑开一簇嫩绿叶#7ac060；握处温润发亮；年轮刻纹布满杖身，透稳定的叶绿柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素叶绿光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A sprouting white-wood staff at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A whole silver-white fallen world-tree branch #e8e4d8 with tiny green buds on its knots, the head splitting into a few twigs that hold open a small cluster of fresh green leaves #7ac060; the wood is smooth and glossy where held; growth-ring engravings cover the staff with a steady leaf-green glow, a one-pixel leaf-green halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。杖头撑开的一簇活绿叶是标志；与落枝长弓和根须法杖的根笼区分。

subject.zh: 一根摄政权杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。修长的冷白月银杖身#e0e8f0带浅蓝，杖头是一弯新月托着一颗暗红夜铁宝石，新月两侧各挑起一枚小角；握处银面磨得极亮；纹样布满杖身，透稳定的浅青柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，三颗亮点。
subject.en: A regent scepter at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A long slender cold-white moon-silver shaft #e0e8f0 with a light blue tint, its head a crescent moon cradling a dark red night-iron gem, with a small horn rising from each side of the crescent; the silver is rubbed very bright where it is held; patterns cover the shaft with a steady pale-cyan glow, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and three highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。新月托暗红宝石、两侧小角的杖头是标志；银白主调，与月角杖的彩绘角区分。

subject.zh: 一杆初誓长枪，占满整条对角线，枪头在右上。银白精钢叶形枪头#c8ccd4，根部套一圈金色放射光环；白漆长杆缠一条褪色白誓带，带尾长长飘起；对称光纹布满枪头，透稳定的神光白金柔光#fff0c0，轮廓外缘局部一像素白金光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A first-vow lance filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. A silver-white steel leaf-shaped head #c8ccd4 with a ring of radiating gold halo #d8a840 around its base; the white-lacquered shaft is wound with a faded white vow ribbon whose tail streams out long; symmetrical light patterns cover the head with a steady divine white-gold glow #fff0c0, a one-pixel white-gold halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。枪头根部的金色放射光环与飘起的白誓带是标志；不加紫，与比武长枪的红白螺纹区分。

subject.zh: 一面守冢古盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。风化的灰钢鸢盾#8a8e94，下尖裹着干土与细草根，盾面斑驳长着苔绿#6a8a50与地衣斑；古老刻纹布满盾面，透稳定的浅青柔光#a8e0d8，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: An ancient tomb-guard shield in front-facing three-quarter view, tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. A weathered grey steel kite shield #8a8e94 whose lower point is caked with dry earth and fine grass roots, its face mottled with moss green #6a8a50 and lichen spots; ancient engravings cover the face with a steady pale-cyan glow #a8e0d8, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。下尖带土与草根、盾面苔斑是标志，像久立在地里；与长方遗盾的三道爪痕区分。

subject.zh: 一张初弦古弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。弓臂由两根银白落枝木#e8e4d8相互绞缠成螺旋，节上冒细绿芽；弓弦是一缕发着微光的苍绿丝；握把磨得温润，年轮纹布满弓臂透叶绿柔光#7ac060，轮廓外缘局部一像素叶绿光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: An ancient first-string bow, upright and slightly tilted, back of the bow to the left and string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. The limbs are two silver-white fallen world-tree branches #e8e4d8 twisted around each other in a spiral, tiny green buds on the knots; the string is a faintly glowing thread of deep green; the grip is worn smooth, growth-ring patterns cover the limbs with a leaf-green glow #7ac060, a one-pixel leaf-green halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。两根落枝绞缠成螺旋的弓臂是标志；与落枝长弓的单根弓臂区分。

subject.zh: 一根兽王角杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。七根形状各异的兽角，螺旋的、弯的、直的、分叉的，用七色彩绳缠成一束，杖头散开成一圈角冠；骨片与骨珠垂在角间；握处角面磨亮，刻纹布满角身透浅青柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，三颗亮点。
subject.en: A beast-king horn staff at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. Seven horns of different shapes, spiral, curved, straight and branching, bound into one shaft with cords of seven colours, the head spreading into a crown of horns; bone chips and bone beads hang between them; the horn is rubbed bright where held, engravings cover the horns with a pale-cyan glow, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and three highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。七根不同兽角缠成一束、杖头散成角冠是标志；与月角杖的单根新月角区分。

subject.zh: 一柄炉主之锤，占满整条对角线，锤头在右上。巨大方正的黑铁锤头#3c3f46，箍着一道道炉心金#e0a030，铆钉排成矿纹，侧面正中镶一块火玉；锤面像余火般暖红；长柄包铁磨亮，刻纹布满锤头透火橙柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素火橙光晕，三颗亮点。
subject.en: A forge master hammer filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. A huge squared black-iron head #3c3f46 bound with bands of forge-heart gold #e0a030, its rivets laid out like an ore vein and a fire jade set at the centre of one side; the striking face glows a warm ember red; the long iron-shod haft is rubbed bright, engravings cover the head with a fire-orange glow #f0a040, a one-pixel fire-orange halo runs along part of the outer outline, and three highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。炉心金箍与余火般发红的锤面是标志；比赤砧符纹战锤更大更金，与终器剑区分。

subject.zh: 一杆渊主脊骨枪，占满整条对角线，枪头在右上。枪杆是一节节相连的蓝黑椎骨#2a3440，枪头是一根带倒刺的长鳍棘；暗紫纹路#4a3a62密密爬过骨面，边缘绕一圈淡淡的暗雾；刻纹透稳定的澱紫柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素澱紫光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: An abyss-lord spine spear filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. The shaft is a chain of linked blue-black vertebrae #2a3440 and the head is a long barbed fin spine; dark purple veins #4a3a62 crawl thickly over the bone with a faint dark haze around the edges; engravings give a steady dusky purple glow, a one-pixel dusky purple halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。椎骨枪杆与倒刺鳍棘枪头是标志；重档澱纹加边缘暗雾，与千骨链枷的骨白区分。

subject.zh: 一本灰袍契书，合上的书，四分之三视角，封面朝左上。厚书裹着灰色旧袍布#8a8680，一条黑铁锁链交叉缠住书身，锁头挂在封面；书口满是极小点线纹；细细的暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过封面，透稳定的澱紫柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素澱紫光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A grey-robe pact codex, a closed book in three-quarter view, cover facing upper left. A thick book wrapped in a layer of old grey robe cloth #8a8680, a black-iron chain crossed around it with the lock hanging on the cover; the page edges are filled with tiny dot-and-line patterns; thin dark purple veins #4a3a62 creep over the cover with a steady dusky purple glow, a one-pixel dusky purple halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。灰袍布裹封与交叉锁链是标志；点线纹不能像字；中档澱纹只是细纹，不要整本发紫。

subject.zh: 一杆天裂翼枪，占满整条对角线，枪头在右上。黑铁长枪头#3c3f46从中间裂成两股参差的尖叉，像一道撕开的天缝；枪头根部收着一对皮膜翼骨；杆上缠几条被风撕碎的旧布条；刻纹布满枪头，透稳定的浅青柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A sky-rift wing spear filling the whole diagonal, head at upper right. A long black-iron spearhead #3c3f46 split down the middle into two jagged prongs like a torn seam in the sky; a pair of folded membrane wing bones sits at its base; a few old cloth strips shredded by wind are wound on the shaft; engravings cover the head with a steady pale-cyan glow, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。从中间裂成两股的参差枪头与翼骨是标志；与三叉戟和普通长枪区分。

subject.zh: 一面灯灭塔盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。高大的白钢塔盾#c8ccd4包金边，盾面中央浮雕一圈光环，光环发黑熄灭，蒙着一层烟熏；盾面满是刮擦，边框刻纹透出稳定的浅青柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A lightless tower shield in front-facing three-quarter view, tilted slightly from above, face toward the viewer. A tall white steel tower shield #c8ccd4 edged in gold, a halo in relief at the centre of its face gone black and dead under a layer of soot; the face is covered in scrapes, engravings along the frame give a steady pale-cyan glow, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。盾心光环浮雕必须暗黑无光，光只在边框；不用神光白金，与白冕作亮环盾区分。

subject.zh: 一把统一剑，占满整条对角线，剑尖在右上。宽长的精钢双手剑身#a8b0bc，金色护手#d8a840向两侧展开七根放射尖芒，像一顶冠；柄首一枚圆形几何国玺纹章；握处磨亮，刻纹布满剑身透稳定的浅青柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素浅青光晕，三颗亮点。
subject.en: A unification sword filling the whole diagonal, point at upper right. A broad long fine-steel two-handed blade #a8b0bc whose gold crossguard #d8a840 spreads into seven radiating spikes like a crown; the pommel carries a round geometric state-seal crest; the grip is worn bright, engravings cover the blade with a steady pale-cyan glow, a one-pixel pale-cyan halo runs along part of the outer outline, and three highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。七芒冠形金护手是标志；国宝气派但不用神光白金；与试锋之刃的锯齿刃区分。

subject.zh: 一根蝗王骨杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。灰黄骨杖#b8a888，杖头是一颗巨大的蝗虫头骨，两根长触须后弯，下垂一串翅形骨片；暗紫纹路#4a3a62密爬骨面，边缘绕淡淡暗雾，透稳定的澱紫柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素澱紫光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A locust-king bone staff at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A grey-yellow bone shaft #b8a888 topped by a huge locust skull with two long antennae curving back and a string of wing-shaped bone chips hanging below; dark purple veins #4a3a62 crawl densely over the bone with a faint dark haze around the edges and a steady dusky purple glow, a one-pixel dusky purple halo runs along part of the outer outline, and two highlight pixels.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。蝗虫头骨与长触须杖头是标志；重档澱纹加暗雾，与兽王角杖区分。

subject.zh: 一顶余烬门守皮兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。烟熏炭褐皮革#4e4038滚余烬橙边#d06a30，门扉金细框的拱门形铜扣（余烬门守徽记）；帽檐前沿压成门楣般的平直硬边，徽记钉在额前，多道刻纹顺帽缝走，透极淡余烬橙微光#f0a040。
subject.en: A leather hood of the Ember Door Warden set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Smoke-darkened charcoal-brown leather #4e4038 piped with ember-orange edging #d06a30, and an arch-door copper buckle framed in a thin line of gate gold (the shared Ember Door Warden emblem) riveted at the brow; the front brim is pressed into a flat stiff edge like a door lintel, and several engraved lines follow the seams with a very faint ember-orange glow #f0a040.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。余烬门守共用锚：炭褐皮、余烬橙滚边、门扉金细框拱门铜扣；门楣式平直帽檐是本件辨识点。

subject.zh: 一只余烬门守皮手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。烟熏炭褐皮革#4e4038滚余烬橙边#d06a30，门扉金细框的拱门形铜扣（余烬门守徽记）；徽记缝在手背，护腕翻口像一截短门框，指尖熏得更黑，刻纹顺指骨走，透极淡余烬橙微光。
subject.en: A single leather glove of the Ember Door Warden set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Smoke-darkened charcoal-brown leather #4e4038 piped with ember-orange edging #d06a30, and an arch-door copper buckle framed in a thin line of gate gold (the shared Ember Door Warden emblem) sewn on the back of the hand; the turned-back cuff is shaped like a short door frame, the fingertips are scorched darker, and engraved lines run along the knuckles with a very faint ember-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。门框形翻口护腕与熏黑指尖是辨识点；门扉金只用在徽记的细框上，不做主色。

subject.zh: 一只余烬门守皮靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。烟熏炭褐皮革#4e4038滚余烬橙边#d06a30，门扉金细框的拱门形铜扣（余烬门守徽记）；高筒软靴，徽记扣住筒侧斜绑带，鞋头包一片灰烬色硬革，刻纹顺靴筒走，透极淡余烬橙微光。
subject.en: A single leather boot of the Ember Door Warden set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Smoke-darkened charcoal-brown leather #4e4038 piped with ember-orange edging #d06a30, and an arch-door copper buckle framed in a thin line of gate gold (the shared Ember Door Warden emblem) fastening a diagonal strap on the tall soft shaft; the toe is capped with ash-grey hardened leather, and engraved lines run down the shaft with a very faint ember-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。斜绑带上的徽记扣与灰烬色包头是辨识点；高筒软皮靴，不要画成板甲靴。

subject.zh: 一只余烬门守信物小皮囊，居中，上方带一小段系绳。烟熏炭褐皮革#4e4038滚余烬橙边#d06a30，门扉金细框的拱门形铜扣（余烬门守徽记）；囊口由徽记扣住，拱门形门洞里露出一粒暗红余烬，透出极淡余烬橙微光，囊面刻纹顺缝走。
subject.en: A small leather token pouch of the Ember Door Warden set, centered, with a short loop of cord above. Smoke-darkened charcoal-brown leather #4e4038 piped with ember-orange edging #d06a30, and an arch-door copper buckle framed in a thin line of gate gold (the shared Ember Door Warden emblem) closing the mouth; a single dark red ember shows through the arched opening with a very faint ember-orange glow, and engraved lines follow the seams of the pouch.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。门洞里那粒暗红余烬是信物核心，光要很淡；整体是小皮囊，不是灯或香炉。

subject.zh: 一顶水道行者皮兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。涂蜡的暗苔褐皮革#4a4630泛着湿光，一枚圆形栅格纹铜扣#c87a48（水道行者共用徽记）；兜帽下缘连一块遮住口鼻的皮面罩，徽记扣在面罩侧边，多道刻纹顺帽缝走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A leather hood of the Waterway Walker set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Waxed dark moss-brown leather #4a4630 with a damp sheen, and a round grate-patterned copper buckle #c87a48 (the shared Waterway Walker emblem) fastened at the side of a leather mask that hangs from the hood's lower edge over the mouth and nose; several engraved lines follow the seams with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。遮口鼻的皮面罩是辨识点；皮色与圆栅格铜扣须与腿件水道长靴式护腿一致。

subject.zh: 一件水道行者皮甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。涂蜡的暗苔褐皮革#4a4630泛着湿光，一枚圆形栅格纹铜扣#c87a48（水道行者共用徽记）；徽记扣在胸前斜带上，肩头一片涂蜡短披肩，下摆沾着干泥，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A leather jerkin of the Waterway Walker set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Waxed dark moss-brown leather #4a4630 with a damp sheen, and a round grate-patterned copper buckle #c87a48 (the shared Waterway Walker emblem) on a diagonal chest strap; a short waxed capelet over the shoulders, dried mud along the hem, and engraved lines along the seams with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。胸前斜带上的栅格铜扣与肩头短披肩是辨识点；不要加晶刺，也不要加紫色。

subject.zh: 一只水道行者皮手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。涂蜡的暗苔褐皮革#4a4630泛着湿光，一枚圆形栅格纹铜扣#c87a48（水道行者共用徽记）；手背加一片带铆钉的厚皮护片，徽记扣在长护腕上，指节一道锈色旧痕，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single leather glove of the Waterway Walker set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Waxed dark moss-brown leather #4a4630 with a damp sheen, and a round grate-patterned copper buckle #c87a48 (the shared Waterway Walker emblem) on the long cuff; a riveted thick leather plate over the back of the hand, one rust-colored old scuff across the knuckles, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手背铆钉厚皮护片与长护腕铜扣是辨识点；皮色同套统一，锈痕只画一道。

subject.zh: 一顶霜骨守夜闭面盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。覆着薄霜的旧精钢板#a8b0bc，骨白包边#ddd8c4，嵌竖缝的菱形骨片（霜骨守夜徽记）；徽记嵌在额心，面甲一道横向窥缝，盔顶一条低矮骨脊，刻纹顺盔走，透极淡冰蓝微光#a0d0f0。
subject.en: A closed helm of the Frostbone Night Watch set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Old bright-steel plate #a8b0bc under a thin coat of frost, bone-white trim #ddd8c4, and a diamond-shaped bone plaque with a vertical slit (the shared Frostbone Night Watch emblem) set at the brow; a single horizontal eye slit in the visor, a low bone ridge along the crown, and engraved lines with a very faint ice-blue glow #a0d0f0.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盔顶骨脊与额心竖缝菱形骨片是辨识点；霜只是薄薄一层白，不要画成冰块。

subject.zh: 一副霜骨守夜胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。覆着薄霜的旧精钢板#a8b0bc，骨白包边#ddd8c4，嵌竖缝的菱形骨片（霜骨守夜徽记）；徽记居胸板正中，肩甲叠三层像骨节，左肋一道焦黑痕，刻纹透极淡冰蓝微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the Frostbone Night Watch set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Old bright-steel plate #a8b0bc under a thin coat of frost, bone-white trim #ddd8c4, and a diamond-shaped bone plaque with a vertical slit (the shared Frostbone Night Watch emblem) at the center of the chest; pauldrons stacked in three layers like bone joints, a blackened scorch mark on the left ribs, and engraved lines with a very faint ice-blue glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。三层骨节肩甲与左肋焦痕是辨识点；与灰墙胸甲区分：没有毛皮领，没有灰横条。

subject.zh: 一对霜骨守夜腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。覆着薄霜的旧精钢板#a8b0bc，骨白包边#ddd8c4，嵌竖缝的菱形骨片（霜骨守夜徽记）；徽记缀在腰带扣上，膝甲是一块圆凸的骨形护膝，腿甲侧缘挂着细冰凌，刻纹顺腿走，透极淡冰蓝微光#a0d0f0。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Frostbone Night Watch set, front view, both legs side by side. Old bright-steel plate #a8b0bc under a thin coat of frost, bone-white trim #ddd8c4, and a diamond-shaped bone plaque with a vertical slit (the shared Frostbone Night Watch emblem) on the belt buckle; rounded bone-shaped knee cops, small icicles hanging from the outer edges, and engraved lines with a very faint ice-blue glow #a0d0f0.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。圆凸骨形护膝与侧缘细冰凌是辨识点；两条腿对称并列，冰凌要小。

subject.zh: 一只霜骨守夜板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。覆着薄霜的旧精钢板#a8b0bc，骨白包边#ddd8c4，嵌竖缝的菱形骨片（霜骨守夜徽记）；徽记嵌在手背，指节排一列小骨钉，护腕口结一圈白霜，刻纹顺甲片走，透极淡冰蓝微光。
subject.en: A single plate gauntlet of the Frostbone Night Watch set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Old bright-steel plate #a8b0bc under a thin coat of frost, bone-white trim #ddd8c4, and a diamond-shaped bone plaque with a vertical slit (the shared Frostbone Night Watch emblem) on the back of the hand; a row of small bone studs over the knuckles, a ring of white frost at the cuff, and engraved lines with a very faint ice-blue glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。指节一列小骨钉是辨识点；骨白与钢灰两色为主，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一顶守卷人高顶软帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。褪色墨蓝厚呢#2e3a52镶旧书页黄边#d8c8a0，对开书页形钟铜扣（守卷人徽记）；两侧垂下长护耳，徽记别在帽前，旁插一支细骨笔，织纹顺帽身走，透极淡浅青微光#a8e0d8。
subject.en: A tall soft cap of the Archive Keeper set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Faded ink-blue heavy wool #2e3a52 trimmed in old page yellow #d8c8a0, with a bronze clasp shaped like an open pair of pages (the shared Archive Keeper emblem) pinned at the front; long earflaps hang at both sides, a thin bone stylus is tucked beside the clasp, and woven lines run up the cap with a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e0d8.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两侧长护耳与细骨笔是辨识点；墨蓝配书页黄，与录袍的深青灰点线纹区分。

subject.zh: 一件守卷人长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。褪色墨蓝厚呢#2e3a52镶旧书页黄边#d8c8a0，对开书页形钟铜扣（守卷人徽记）；徽记扣住胸前斜绶带，宽大袖口积满灰白尘，织纹顺衣褶下行，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A long robe of the Archive Keeper set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Faded ink-blue heavy wool #2e3a52 trimmed in old page yellow #d8c8a0, with a bronze clasp shaped like an open pair of pages (the shared Archive Keeper emblem) fastening a diagonal sash across the chest; the wide cuffs are thick with grey-white dust, and woven lines run down the folds with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。积满灰尘的宽袖口是辨识点，灰要看得出来；整件是布袍，不加甲片。

subject.zh: 一只守卷人布手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。褪色墨蓝厚呢#2e3a52镶旧书页黄边#d8c8a0，对开书页形钟铜扣（守卷人徽记）；半指款式，露出的指尖染着墨黑，徽记缝在腕带上，掌缘磨得起毛，织纹顺指走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single cloth glove of the Archive Keeper set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Faded ink-blue heavy wool #2e3a52 trimmed in old page yellow #d8c8a0, with a bronze clasp shaped like an open pair of pages (the shared Archive Keeper emblem) sewn on the wrist strap; fingerless, the bare fingertips stained ink-black, the palm edge worn fuzzy, and woven lines along the fingers with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。半指手套加墨黑指尖是辨识点；是布手套，不要画成皮革或金属。

subject.zh: 一枚守卷人信物小书，居中，上方带一小段系绳。褪色墨蓝厚呢#2e3a52镶旧书页黄边#d8c8a0，对开书页形钟铜扣（守卷人徽记）；拇指大的合页小书，封皮就是这种呢料，正面压着徽记，书脊包铜，书口透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A tiny book token of the Archive Keeper set, centered, with a short loop of cord above. Faded ink-blue heavy wool #2e3a52 trimmed in old page yellow #d8c8a0, with a bronze clasp shaped like an open pair of pages (the shared Archive Keeper emblem); a thumb-sized closed book bound in that wool with the emblem pressed on its cover, a bronze-capped spine, and page edges showing a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。整体是拇指大的小书挂件，不是普通书本；封面徽记与微光书口是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一顶殉光闭面盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。带细冰裂釉的瓷白板甲#efe8da，暖金镶边#d0a850，光环中竖一道金线的圆徽（殉光徽记）；徽记嵌在额前，盔顶一圈低矮的金色光环冠，面甲一道丁字形窥缝，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A closed helm of the Martyr's Light set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Porcelain-white plate #efe8da with a fine crackle glaze, warm gold trim #d0a850, and a round badge of a halo crossed by one vertical gold line (the shared Martyr's Light emblem) set at the brow; a low golden halo ring crowns the helm, the visor has a narrow T-shaped eye slit, and engraved lines carry a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。纯净白瓷与金，绝不加紫色或暗纹；光环冠与细冰裂釉是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一对殉光腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。带细冰裂釉的瓷白板甲#efe8da，暖金镶边#d0a850，光环中竖一道金线的圆徽（殉光徽记）；徽记缀在腰甲中央，膝甲是两枚金边圆瓷盘，腿侧各垂一片白布裙片，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Martyr's Light set, front view, both legs side by side. Porcelain-white plate #efe8da with a fine crackle glaze, warm gold trim #d0a850, and a round badge of a halo crossed by one vertical gold line (the shared Martyr's Light emblem) at the center of the waist plate; gold-rimmed round porcelain discs as knee cops, a white cloth tasset hanging at each side, and engraved lines with a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。金边圆瓷盘护膝是辨识点；全件只有白瓷与金，不加紫，不加锈。

subject.zh: 一只殉光板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。带细冰裂釉的瓷白板甲#efe8da，暖金镶边#d0a850，光环中竖一道金线的圆徽（殉光徽记）；徽记嵌在手背圆板上，每节指甲片套一道细金箍，护腕外翻成瓣形，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A single plate gauntlet of the Martyr's Light set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Porcelain-white plate #efe8da with a fine crackle glaze, warm gold trim #d0a850, and a round badge of a halo crossed by one vertical gold line (the shared Martyr's Light emblem) on a round plate at the back of the hand; each finger segment ringed with a thin gold band, a petal-shaped flared cuff, and engraved lines with a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。指节细金箍与瓣形护腕是辨识点；与白冕誓铠护手区分：暖金冰裂瓷，没有浅蓝与银。

subject.zh: 一只殉光板甲靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。带细冰裂釉的瓷白板甲#efe8da，暖金镶边#d0a850，光环中竖一道金线的圆徽（殉光徽记）；徽记嵌在脚踝外侧，靴尖包金，脚背叠三片瓷甲，刻纹顺靴走，透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A single plate sabaton of the Martyr's Light set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Porcelain-white plate #efe8da with a fine crackle glaze, warm gold trim #d0a850, and a round badge of a halo crossed by one vertical gold line (the shared Martyr's Light emblem) on the outer ankle; a gold-capped toe, three overlapping porcelain plates over the instep, and engraved lines with a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。金包靴尖与脚背三层瓷甲是辨识点；保持纯白瓷与金，不画任何紫或暗斑。

subject.zh: 一顶红砾斗士锁子头巾配半盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。暗铁锁子甲#4a4e55缀红砾色皮边#a04a32，刻梯级横纹的铜方牌（红砾斗士徽记）；露脸开口宽大，徽记钉在半盔额前，护颈锁片垂到肩，环缝里嵌着红砂，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A mail coif with an open half-helm of the Red Gravel Pit Fighter set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Dark iron chainmail #4a4e55 edged with red-gravel leather #a04a32, and a copper square plaque engraved with ladder-like rungs (the shared Red Gravel Pit Fighter emblem) riveted at the brow of the half-helm; a wide open face, a mail neck guard falling to the shoulders, red grit lodged between the rings, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。梯级横纹铜方牌是全套标记；锁环缝里的红砂与宽大露脸开口是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一件红砾斗士锁子短衫，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。暗铁锁子甲#4a4e55缀红砾色皮边#a04a32，刻梯级横纹的铜方牌（红砾斗士徽记）；只有左肩一块厚护肩，右肩裸露，徽记挂在胸前，环缝嵌红砂，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A short mail shirt of the Red Gravel Pit Fighter set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Dark iron chainmail #4a4e55 edged with red-gravel leather #a04a32, and a copper square plaque engraved with ladder-like rungs (the shared Red Gravel Pit Fighter emblem) hanging on the chest; one heavy pauldron on the left shoulder only, the right shoulder bare, red grit in the rings, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。只护左肩的不对称造型是辨识点；锁甲是暗铁色，红只在皮边与砂粒上。

subject.zh: 一对红砾斗士锁子裙甲，正面，两条腿并列。暗铁锁子甲#4a4e55缀红砾色皮边#a04a32，刻梯级横纹的铜方牌（红砾斗士徽记）；分片锁裙垂到膝，徽记缀在腰带上，膝下缠交叉红皮绑带，环缝嵌红砂，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of mail leg guards of the Red Gravel Pit Fighter set, front view, both legs side by side. Dark iron chainmail #4a4e55 edged with red-gravel leather #a04a32, and a copper square plaque engraved with ladder-like rungs (the shared Red Gravel Pit Fighter emblem) on the belt; a split mail skirt falling to the knees, crossed red leather bindings below the knees, red grit in the rings, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。分片锁裙加膝下交叉红绑带是辨识点；两腿并列，不要画成长袍。

subject.zh: 一只红砾斗士锁子手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。暗铁锁子甲#4a4e55缀红砾色皮边#a04a32，刻梯级横纹的铜方牌（红砾斗士徽记）；指节一排短铁钉，手背缀徽记，护腕缠红皮带，环缝嵌红砂，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single mail glove of the Red Gravel Pit Fighter set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Dark iron chainmail #4a4e55 edged with red-gravel leather #a04a32, and a copper square plaque engraved with ladder-like rungs (the shared Red Gravel Pit Fighter emblem) on the back of the hand; a row of short iron studs over the knuckles, red leather wrapped around the wrist, red grit in the rings, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。指节短铁钉是斗拳用的辨识点；与猎王手套区分：没有骨片与彩绳。

subject.zh: 一顶深炉守炉人方盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。炉渣灰方厚板甲#55545a，苍白铆钉排成矿纹#c8c4b8，方框套三角炉口的铁徽（守炉人徽记）；面前一块护目栅格，徽记嵌在额心，暗紫细纹#4a3a62爬过盔面，纹槽透极淡澱紫微光。
subject.en: A square helm of the Deep Forge Warden set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Slag-grey thick square plate #55545a with pale rivets laid out like ore veins #c8c4b8, and an iron badge of a triangular furnace mouth inside a square frame (the shared Deep Forge Warden emblem) set at the brow; a grille of eye bars across the face, fine dark purple veins #4a3a62 creeping over the helm, and a very faint dian-purple glow in the grooves.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。中档澱纹只是细细暗紫纹路，不加暗雾；护目栅格与苍白矿纹铆钉是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一副深炉守炉人胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。炉渣灰方厚板甲#55545a，苍白铆钉排成矿纹#c8c4b8，方框套三角炉口的铁徽（守炉人徽记）；护心是带栅孔的炉门形板，徽记在上，暗紫细纹爬过板面，纹槽透极淡澱紫微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the Deep Forge Warden set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Slag-grey thick square plate #55545a with pale rivets laid out like ore veins #c8c4b8, and an iron badge of a triangular furnace mouth inside a square frame (the shared Deep Forge Warden emblem); the heart guard is a vented furnace-hatch plate with the emblem above it, fine dark purple veins creep over the plate, and the grooves hold a very faint dian-purple glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。护心的栅孔炉口板是辨识点，不镶火玉；与深锤终炉的黑铁炉心金区分。

subject.zh: 一只深炉守炉人板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。炉渣灰方厚板甲#55545a，苍白铆钉排成矿纹#c8c4b8，方框套三角炉口的铁徽（守炉人徽记）；指节甲片宽厚如砖，徽记嵌在护腕，暗紫细纹爬过手背，纹槽透极淡澱紫微光。
subject.en: A single plate gauntlet of the Deep Forge Warden set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Slag-grey thick square plate #55545a with pale rivets laid out like ore veins #c8c4b8, and an iron badge of a triangular furnace mouth inside a square frame (the shared Deep Forge Warden emblem) on the cuff; knuckle plates wide and thick as bricks, fine dark purple veins creeping across the back of the hand, and a very faint dian-purple glow in the grooves.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。砖块般的厚指节甲与苍白矿纹铆钉是辨识点；手背没有铭板，与契约名护手区分。

subject.zh: 一只深炉守炉人板甲靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。炉渣灰方厚板甲#55545a，苍白铆钉排成矿纹#c8c4b8，方框套三角炉口的铁徽（守炉人徽记）；靴头方正如铁砧，徽记嵌在踝甲，暗紫细纹爬过靴面，纹槽透极淡澱紫微光。
subject.en: A single plate boot of the Deep Forge Warden set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Slag-grey thick square plate #55545a with pale rivets laid out like ore veins #c8c4b8, and an iron badge of a triangular furnace mouth inside a square frame (the shared Deep Forge Warden emblem) on the ankle plate; a toe as square as an anvil, fine dark purple veins creeping over the boot, and a very faint dian-purple glow in the grooves.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。方如铁砧的靴头是辨识点；暗紫纹细而少，整体仍以炉渣灰为主。

subject.zh: 一顶角冠亲卫大盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。宽大的古旧黑铁板甲#3c3f46，褪色暗红漆#7a2a2a，三根弯角组成的冠形徽（角冠亲卫徽记）；盔侧伸出一对向后弯的粗角，徽记嵌在额前，漆面剥落露出铁色，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A great helm of the Horncrown Guard set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Broad, ancient black-iron plate #3c3f46 with faded dark red lacquer #7a2a2a, and a crown-shaped badge formed by three curved horns (the shared Horncrown Guard emblem) set at the brow; a pair of thick horns sweeping back from the sides, lacquer flaking off to show the iron, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一对后弯粗角是主轮廓，盔体要宽大；黑铁加褪红漆，与夜铁作的不反光多角盔区分。

subject.zh: 一副角冠亲卫胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。宽大的古旧黑铁板甲#3c3f46，褪色暗红漆#7a2a2a，三根弯角组成的冠形徽（角冠亲卫徽记）；胸板宽得出奇，两肩各竖一根短弯角，徽记居胸中，漆面剥落，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the Horncrown Guard set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Broad, ancient black-iron plate #3c3f46 with faded dark red lacquer #7a2a2a, and a crown-shaped badge formed by three curved horns (the shared Horncrown Guard emblem) at the center of the chest; an unusually wide breastplate, a short curved horn rising from each pauldron, flaking lacquer, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。超宽胸板与双肩短角是辨识点，体型明显大于人族胸甲；不加紫。

subject.zh: 一对角冠亲卫腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。宽大的古旧黑铁板甲#3c3f46，褪色暗红漆#7a2a2a，三根弯角组成的冠形徽（角冠亲卫徽记）；粗壮的大腿甲层层叠，膝甲前凸成一枚角尖，徽记缀在腰甲，漆面剥落，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Horncrown Guard set, front view, both legs side by side. Broad, ancient black-iron plate #3c3f46 with faded dark red lacquer #7a2a2a, and a crown-shaped badge formed by three curved horns (the shared Horncrown Guard emblem) on the waist plate; massive layered thigh plates, knee cops jutting forward into a horn point, flaking lacquer, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。膝甲前凸的角尖与粗壮层叠腿甲是辨识点；两腿并列，尺寸偏大。

subject.zh: 一只角冠亲卫板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。宽大的古旧黑铁板甲#3c3f46，褪色暗红漆#7a2a2a，三根弯角组成的冠形徽（角冠亲卫徽记）；手掌宽大，指尖甲片收成弯爪，徽记嵌在手背，漆面剥落，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single plate gauntlet of the Horncrown Guard set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Broad, ancient black-iron plate #3c3f46 with faded dark red lacquer #7a2a2a, and a crown-shaped badge formed by three curved horns (the shared Horncrown Guard emblem) on the back of the hand; an oversized hand, fingertip plates drawn into curved claws, flaking lacquer, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。弯爪指尖与超大手掌是辨识点；要比普通板甲护手宽一圈。

subject.zh: 一顶王胎兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。近黑酒红的厚丝布#2a1a24，暗紫纹路#4a3a62如血脉爬满，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，卵形环中一点的银徽（王胎徽记）；帽身像层层合拢的薄膜，帽尖垂向前额，徽记缀在眉心，纹路透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A hood of the Kingwomb set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Thick near-black wine-red silk #2a1a24 overrun by dark purple veins #4a3a62 like blood vessels, a faint dark haze around the edges, and a silver badge of a dot inside an egg-shaped ring (the shared Kingwomb emblem) at the brow; the hood is built of layered folds like closing membranes with its tip drooping over the forehead, and the veins give off a dian-purple glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。重档澱纹：暗紫血脉纹加边缘暗雾；层层薄膜状帽身是辨识点，不要画成普通布兜帽。

subject.zh: 一件王胎长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。近黑酒红的厚丝布#2a1a24，暗紫纹路#4a3a62如血脉爬满，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，卵形环中一点的银徽（王胎徽记）；高领裹住颈部，前襟像两片合拢的薄膜，徽记居胸口，纹路透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A long robe of the Kingwomb set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Thick near-black wine-red silk #2a1a24 overrun by dark purple veins #4a3a62 like blood vessels, a faint dark haze around the edges, and a silver badge of a dot inside an egg-shaped ring (the shared Kingwomb emblem) at the chest; a high collar wraps the neck, the front closes like two folding membranes, and the veins give off a dian-purple glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。高领与两片薄膜状前襟是辨识点；暗雾只在轮廓边缘一圈，袍身仍看得出酒红底色。

subject.zh: 一只王胎丝手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。近黑酒红的厚丝布#2a1a24，暗紫纹路#4a3a62如血脉爬满，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，卵形环中一点的银徽（王胎徽记）；手套贴身细长，指尖收尖，手背血脉纹最密，徽记缀在腕口，纹路透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A single silk glove of the Kingwomb set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Thick near-black wine-red silk #2a1a24 overrun by dark purple veins #4a3a62 like blood vessels, a faint dark haze around the edges, and a silver badge of a dot inside an egg-shaped ring (the shared Kingwomb emblem) at the wrist; slim and close-fitting with pointed fingertips, the veins densest across the back of the hand and glowing dian purple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。贴身细长、指尖收尖的丝手套；手背血脉纹最密是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一只王胎软靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。近黑酒红的厚丝布#2a1a24，暗紫纹路#4a3a62如血脉爬满，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，卵形环中一点的银徽（王胎徽记）；无硬底的软丝靴，靴筒层层缠裹，靴尖微翘，徽记缀在踝侧，纹路透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A single soft boot of the Kingwomb set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Thick near-black wine-red silk #2a1a24 overrun by dark purple veins #4a3a62 like blood vessels, a faint dark haze around the edges, and a silver badge of a dot inside an egg-shaped ring (the shared Kingwomb emblem) at the side of the ankle; a soft silk boot without a hard sole, its shaft wound in layers, the toe slightly upturned, and the veins glowing dian purple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。层层缠裹的软筒与微翘靴尖是辨识点；不加金属件，只有银徽一处。

subject.zh: 一顶堕勇之伴闭面盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。暗银灰板甲#8a909a带墓苔青绿斑#5a7a68，立盾形银徽下压一道横基线（堕勇之伴徽记）；圆顶低平，面甲上一排细密透气孔，徽记嵌在额前，刻纹顺盔走，透极淡浅青微光#a8e0d8。
subject.en: A closed helm of the Fallen Hero's Companion set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Dark silver-grey plate #8a909a with patches of grave-moss green #5a7a68, and a silver badge of an upright shield resting on a horizontal base line (the shared Fallen Hero's Companion emblem) set at the brow; a low rounded crown, a row of fine breathing holes across the visor, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow #a8e0d8.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。立盾压基线的银徽像一座小碑，是全套标记；墓苔斑只几块，不要画成锈。

subject.zh: 一副堕勇之伴胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。暗银灰板甲#8a909a带墓苔青绿斑#5a7a68，立盾形银徽下压一道横基线（堕勇之伴徽记）；徽记居胸中，其上方一处旧纹章被凿平留下浅坑，宽大护肩，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the Fallen Hero's Companion set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Dark silver-grey plate #8a909a with patches of grave-moss green #5a7a68, and a silver badge of an upright shield resting on a horizontal base line (the shared Fallen Hero's Companion emblem) at the center of the chest; above it a shallow pit where an older crest was chiseled away, broad pauldrons, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。胸口被凿平的浅坑是辨识点，坑里不能有任何图案；暗银灰加几块墓苔绿。

subject.zh: 一对堕勇之伴腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。暗银灰板甲#8a909a带墓苔青绿斑#5a7a68，立盾形银徽下压一道横基线（堕勇之伴徽记）；徽记缀在腰甲中央，膝甲是一对小盾形护膝，腿甲下缘沾着干墓土，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Fallen Hero's Companion set, front view, both legs side by side. Dark silver-grey plate #8a909a with patches of grave-moss green #5a7a68, and a silver badge of an upright shield resting on a horizontal base line (the shared Fallen Hero's Companion emblem) at the center of the waist plate; small shield-shaped knee cops, dried grave soil along the lower edges, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。小盾形护膝是辨识点；与殉光腿甲区分：暗银灰带苔斑，不是白瓷金边。

subject.zh: 一只堕勇之伴板甲靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。暗银灰板甲#8a909a带墓苔青绿斑#5a7a68，立盾形银徽下压一道横基线（堕勇之伴徽记）；脚背甲片层层叠，徽记嵌在踝甲外侧，靴跟加一枚短刺，鞋底沾墓土，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single plate sabaton of the Fallen Hero's Companion set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Dark silver-grey plate #8a909a with patches of grave-moss green #5a7a68, and a silver badge of an upright shield resting on a horizontal base line (the shared Fallen Hero's Companion emblem) on the outer ankle plate; layered instep plates, a short spur at the heel, grave soil on the sole, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。靴跟短刺与层叠脚背甲是辨识点；保持暗银灰，不加紫，不加金。

subject.zh: 一顶渊主骸鳞盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。锁甲上层叠墨绿黑大鳞#1e2e34，鳞缘泛珠母冷光，暗紫纹路爬过鳞面，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，螺旋纹圆鳞徽（渊主骸鳞徽记）；盔顶一道鳍状鳞冠向后伸，徽记嵌在额前，纹槽透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A scale helm of the Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Large layered near-black deep-green scales #1e2e34 over mail, the scale edges catching a cold nacre sheen, dark purple veins crawling across the scales and a faint dark haze around the edges, with a round spiral-patterned scale badge (the shared Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale emblem) set at the brow; a fin-like crest of scales sweeps back over the crown, and the grooves glow dian purple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。重档澱纹：暗紫纹加边缘暗雾；鳍状鳞冠是辨识点，鳞片大而少，32 像素要数得清。

subject.zh: 一件渊主骸鳞甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。锁甲上层叠墨绿黑大鳞#1e2e34，鳞缘泛珠母冷光，暗紫纹路爬过鳞面，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，螺旋纹圆鳞徽（渊主骸鳞徽记）；胸前三片最大的鳞像弧形护板，徽记居中，纹槽透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A scale coat of the Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Large layered near-black deep-green scales #1e2e34 over mail, the scale edges catching a cold nacre sheen, dark purple veins crawling across the scales and a faint dark haze around the edges, with a round spiral-patterned scale badge (the shared Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale emblem) at the center; the three largest scales sit across the chest like curved guard plates, and the grooves glow dian purple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。胸前三片弧形巨鳞是辨识点；与亚龙鳞腿甲的青铜绿尖鳞区分：这里墨绿黑带珠母光。

subject.zh: 一对渊主骸鳞腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。锁甲上层叠墨绿黑大鳞#1e2e34，鳞缘泛珠母冷光，暗紫纹路爬过鳞面，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，螺旋纹圆鳞徽（渊主骸鳞徽记）；鳞片顺腿由大到小排下，膝头各一片尖长的鳍鳞，徽记缀在腰带，纹槽透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A pair of scale leg guards of the Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale set, front view, both legs side by side. Large layered near-black deep-green scales #1e2e34 over mail, the scale edges catching a cold nacre sheen, dark purple veins crawling across the scales and a faint dark haze around the edges, with a round spiral-patterned scale badge (the shared Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale emblem) on the belt; the scales shrink in size down the legs, a long pointed fin scale guards each knee, and the grooves glow dian purple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。膝头尖长鳍鳞与由大到小的鳞列是辨识点；两腿并列，暗雾只在外缘。

subject.zh: 一只渊主骸鳞手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。锁甲上层叠墨绿黑大鳞#1e2e34，鳞缘泛珠母冷光，暗紫纹路爬过鳞面，边缘一圈淡淡暗雾，螺旋纹圆鳞徽（渊主骸鳞徽记）；徽记是手背那片最大的圆鳞，指节覆小鳞片，指尖带短钩，纹槽透澱紫微光。
subject.en: A single scale glove of the Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Large layered near-black deep-green scales #1e2e34 over mail, the scale edges catching a cold nacre sheen, dark purple veins crawling across the scales and a faint dark haze around the edges, with a round spiral-patterned scale badge (the shared Abyss Lord Wreck-Scale emblem) as the largest scale on the back of the hand; small scales over the knuckles, short hooks at the fingertips, and the grooves glow dian purple.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手背最大的螺旋圆鳞就是徽记；指尖短钩是辨识点，不要画成长爪。

subject.zh: 一顶灰墙军官盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。灰钢板甲#7a7f88配褐色毛皮与绑带#6a4226，粗铆钉夹着一道宽灰白横条（灰墙徽记）；横条漆在可上掀的面甲上，盔顶一道低矮铁冠脊，颈后翻一圈毛皮，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: An officer's helm of the Greywall set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Grey steel plate #7a7f88 with brown fur and straps #6a4226, and a broad grey-white stripe between rows of heavy rivets (the shared Greywall emblem) painted across a lift-up visor; a low iron crest ridge along the crown, a roll of fur at the back of the neck, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。横条画在可掀面甲上、盔顶铁冠脊是军官盔辨识点；与前排重盔（侧面横条、宽护颊）区分。
