subject.zh: 一副灰墙军官胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。灰钢板甲#7a7f88配褐色毛皮与绑带#6a4226，粗铆钉夹着一道宽灰白横条（灰墙徽记）；横条横过胸板，领口一圈厚毛皮领，右肩甲钉着一块未打磨的补丁铁片，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: An officer's breastplate of the Greywall set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Grey steel plate #7a7f88 with brown fur and straps #6a4226, and a broad grey-white stripe between rows of heavy rivets (the shared Greywall emblem) running across the chest; a thick fur collar at the neck, an unpolished patch plate riveted onto the right pauldron, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。胸前横条与厚毛皮领是灰墙作语法；右肩补丁铁片是本件辨识点。

subject.zh: 一对灰墙腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。灰钢板甲#7a7f88配褐色毛皮与绑带#6a4226，粗铆钉夹着一道宽灰白横条（灰墙徽记）；横条漆在两块大腿甲上，膝甲用褐皮绑带扎紧，一侧膝甲是不打磨的修补片，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Greywall set, front view, both legs side by side. Grey steel plate #7a7f88 with brown fur and straps #6a4226, and a broad grey-white stripe between rows of heavy rivets (the shared Greywall emblem) painted on both thigh plates; knee cops tied on with brown leather straps, one of them an unpolished repair plate, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。大腿甲上的横条与褐皮绑带护膝是辨识点；修补片只在一侧膝头。

subject.zh: 一面灰墙鸢形盾，正面略带俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。灰钢板甲#7a7f88配褐色毛皮与绑带#6a4226，粗铆钉夹着一道宽灰白横条（灰墙徽记）；横条横贯盾面正中，盾缘包铁，下角一道裂口用粗铆钉补住，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A kite shield of the Greywall set, front three-quarter view from slightly above, face toward the viewer. Grey steel plate #7a7f88 with brown fur and straps #6a4226, and a broad grey-white stripe between rows of heavy rivets (the shared Greywall emblem) running across the middle of the shield face; an iron rim around the edge, a crack at the lower point patched with heavy rivets, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。鸢形盾面正中的灰白横条是辨识点；与军坊长垒塔盾（长方形、深红横带）区分。

subject.zh: 一顶十二军团军官盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88配深红罩布#7a2028，剑压圆环的铁徽，旁刻一排无字编号短痕（十二军团徽记）；盔顶一道横向深红鬃冠，护颊下垂，徽记嵌在额前，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: An officer's helm of the Twelfth Legion set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 with deep red tabard cloth #7a2028, and an iron badge of a sword laid over a ring beside a row of wordless tally notches (the shared Twelfth Legion emblem) set at the brow; a transverse deep red crest across the top, hanging cheek guards, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。横向深红鬃冠是辨识点，与卫兵长铁盔的竖短红缨区分；编号只用短刻痕，不能有数字。

subject.zh: 一件十二军团锁甲衫，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88配深红罩布#7a2028，剑压圆环的铁徽，旁刻一排无字编号短痕（十二军团徽记）；外罩及膝深红罩袍，徽记缝在胸前，双肩铁片肩甲，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A mail hauberk of the Twelfth Legion set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 with deep red tabard cloth #7a2028, and an iron badge of a sword laid over a ring beside a row of wordless tally notches (the shared Twelfth Legion emblem) sewn on the chest; a knee-length deep red surcoat over the mail, iron plate pauldrons on both shoulders, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。锁甲外罩深红及膝罩袍是辨识点；与军坊战法师长袍区分：看得到锁环与铁肩甲。

subject.zh: 一对十二军团锁子腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88配深红罩布#7a2028，剑压圆环的铁徽，旁刻一排无字编号短痕（十二军团徽记）；腰间垂一排深红皮条裙，膝头钉圆铁护膝，徽记缀在腰带扣，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of mail leg guards of the Twelfth Legion set, front view, both legs side by side. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 with deep red tabard cloth #7a2028, and an iron badge of a sword laid over a ring beside a row of wordless tally notches (the shared Twelfth Legion emblem) on the belt buckle; a fringe of deep red leather strips hanging from the waist, round iron knee cops, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。腰间深红皮条裙与圆铁护膝是辨识点；只用铁灰与深红两色。

subject.zh: 一只十二军团战靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88配深红罩布#7a2028，剑压圆环的铁徽，旁刻一排无字编号短痕（十二军团徽记）；锁子靴面外加铁片护胫，靴口翻一道深红布边，徽记嵌在护胫上，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single war boot of the Twelfth Legion set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 with deep red tabard cloth #7a2028, and an iron badge of a sword laid over a ring beside a row of wordless tally notches (the shared Twelfth Legion emblem) on the shin plate; a mail foot with an iron greave plate over the shin, a turned-down deep red cloth cuff, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。铁片护胫与深红翻口是辨识点；编号刻痕只是几道短竖线。

subject.zh: 一顶白冕誓铠骑士盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。亮白釉面板甲#f4f6fa，银镶边，浅蓝衬布#8ab0d8，三尖白冕形银徽（白冕誓铠徽记）；盔后衬一圈光环形银箍，面甲左右对称开两排细孔，徽记嵌在额前，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A knight's helm of the White Crown Vow set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Bright white glazed plate #f4f6fa, silver trim, pale blue lining cloth #8ab0d8, and a three-pointed white crown silver badge (the shared White Crown Vow emblem) set at the brow; a halo-shaped silver ring stands behind the helm, the visor has two symmetrical rows of fine holes, and engraved lines carry a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盔后光环银箍与浅蓝衬布是辨识点；与殉光盔区分：亮白银蓝，无冰裂釉、无暖金。

subject.zh: 一副白冕誓铠胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。亮白釉面板甲#f4f6fa，银镶边，浅蓝衬布#8ab0d8，三尖白冕形银徽（白冕誓铠徽记）；徽记居胸中，四周一圈对称的光环形誓纹，肩下垂浅蓝短披风，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the White Crown Vow set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Bright white glazed plate #f4f6fa, silver trim, pale blue lining cloth #8ab0d8, and a three-pointed white crown silver badge (the shared White Crown Vow emblem) at the center of the chest inside a symmetrical halo ring of oath lines; a short pale blue cape hangs from the shoulders, and engraved lines carry a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。光环形誓纹圈住白冕徽、浅蓝短披风是辨识点；誓纹是对称几何线，不像文字。

subject.zh: 一对白冕誓铠腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。亮白釉面板甲#f4f6fa，银镶边，浅蓝衬布#8ab0d8，三尖白冕形银徽（白冕誓铠徽记）；腰间垂两片浅蓝布裙，膝甲两侧伸出对称的扇形小翼片，徽记缀在腰甲中央，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the White Crown Vow set, front view, both legs side by side. Bright white glazed plate #f4f6fa, silver trim, pale blue lining cloth #8ab0d8, and a three-pointed white crown silver badge (the shared White Crown Vow emblem) at the center of the waist plate; two pale blue cloth tassets at the waist, symmetrical fan-shaped wings flaring from each knee cop, and engraved lines with a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。膝侧对称扇形翼片是辨识点；与殉光腿甲的金边圆瓷护膝区分。

subject.zh: 一只白冕誓铠护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。亮白釉面板甲#f4f6fa，银镶边，浅蓝衬布#8ab0d8，三尖白冕形银徽（白冕誓铠徽记）；喇叭形长护腕包银边，手背嵌徽记，指节镶一排浅蓝釉点，刻纹透极淡神光白金微光。
subject.en: A single gauntlet of the White Crown Vow set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Bright white glazed plate #f4f6fa, silver trim, pale blue lining cloth #8ab0d8, and a three-pointed white crown silver badge (the shared White Crown Vow emblem) on the back of the hand; a long flared cuff edged in silver, a row of pale blue enamel dots over the knuckles, and engraved lines with a very faint divine white-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。喇叭形长护腕与指节浅蓝釉点是辨识点；与殉光护手的暖金指箍区分。

subject.zh: 一件红牙轻皮甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。黑皮革#2a2426配赤红漆边#a02828，甲面斜刮痕都用红漆描过，弯牙形骨扣（红牙徽记）；无领无袖的紧身胸甲，徽记扣在左胸交叉皮带上，刻纹顺皮缝走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A light leather cuirass of the Red Fang set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Black leather #2a2426 with crimson lacquered edges #a02828, every diagonal scratch on its surface traced over in red lacquer, and a curved fang-shaped bone clasp (the shared Red Fang emblem) on the crossed straps over the left chest; collarless, sleeveless and close-fitting, with engraved lines along the seams and a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。红漆描过的斜刮痕是全套标记，要清楚；无领无袖的紧身形是本件辨识点。

subject.zh: 一对红牙皮护腿，正面，两条腿并列。黑皮革#2a2426配赤红漆边#a02828，甲面斜刮痕都用红漆描过，弯牙形骨扣（红牙徽记）；贴腿的长裤式护腿，大腿外侧各一片硬皮护板，徽记扣在腰带，刻纹顺皮缝走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of leather leggings of the Red Fang set, front view, both legs side by side. Black leather #2a2426 with crimson lacquered edges #a02828, every diagonal scratch on its surface traced over in red lacquer, and a curved fang-shaped bone clasp (the shared Red Fang emblem) on the belt; close-fitting trouser-style leggings with a hardened leather plate on the outside of each thigh, and engraved lines along the seams with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。大腿外侧硬皮护板是辨识点；黑底红边、刮痕描红，不加金属板甲。

subject.zh: 一只红牙皮手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。黑皮革#2a2426配赤红漆边#a02828，甲面斜刮痕都用红漆描过，弯牙形骨扣（红牙徽记）；露出指尖的短手套，指节缝一排硬皮垫，徽记扣在腕带上，刻纹顺皮缝走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single leather glove of the Red Fang set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Black leather #2a2426 with crimson lacquered edges #a02828, every diagonal scratch on its surface traced over in red lacquer, and a curved fang-shaped bone clasp (the shared Red Fang emblem) on the wrist strap; a short fingerless glove with a row of hardened leather pads over the knuckles, and engraved lines along the seams with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。露指短手套加指节硬皮垫是辨识点；与守卷人布质半指手套区分：黑皮红边。

subject.zh: 一只红牙皮靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。黑皮革#2a2426配赤红漆边#a02828，甲面斜刮痕都用红漆描过，弯牙形骨扣（红牙徽记）；及膝软靴，靴筒正面一道交叉红绑带，徽记扣在靴口，刻纹顺皮缝走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single leather boot of the Red Fang set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Black leather #2a2426 with crimson lacquered edges #a02828, every diagonal scratch on its surface traced over in red lacquer, and a curved fang-shaped bone clasp (the shared Red Fang emblem) at the top of the shaft; a knee-high soft boot with crossed red lacing down the front, and engraved lines along the seams with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。及膝软靴正面的交叉红绑带是辨识点；整套不配头盔，靴子保持轻便。

subject.zh: 一顶苍弦皮兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。苔绿鳞革#6a7a50缀青灰皮绳#6a7a80，不上漆的年轮纹圆木扣横穿一道细弦（苍弦徽记）；兜帽尖长后垂，帽檐缝一圈叶形皮片，徽记扣在颈侧，刻纹顺帽缝走，透极淡叶绿微光#7ac060。
subject.en: A leather hood of the Greenstring set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Moss-green scale leather #6a7a50 laced with blue-grey cord #6a7a80, and an unvarnished round wooden toggle carved with growth rings and crossed by a fine bowstring (the shared Greenstring emblem) at the side of the neck; a long pointed hood tip trailing back, a ring of leaf-shaped leather tabs around the rim, and engraved lines along the seams with a very faint leaf-green glow #7ac060.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。年轮木扣横穿细弦是全套标记；尖长后垂的兜帽与叶形帽檐是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一件苍弦皮甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。苔绿鳞革#6a7a50缀青灰皮绳#6a7a80，不上漆的年轮纹圆木扣横穿一道细弦（苍弦徽记）；右胸缝一块弧形护弦皮片，衣襟以皮绳交叉系紧，徽记居绳结处，刻纹透极淡叶绿微光。
subject.en: A leather jerkin of the Greenstring set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Moss-green scale leather #6a7a50 laced with blue-grey cord #6a7a80, and an unvarnished round wooden toggle carved with growth rings and crossed by a fine bowstring (the shared Greenstring emblem) at the knot where the front laces cross; a curved string-guard leather panel sewn on the right chest, and engraved lines with a very faint leaf-green glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。右胸弧形护弦皮片与交叉皮绳前襟是辨识点；不要画成倒木作的树皮背心。

subject.zh: 一对苍弦皮护腿，正面，两条腿并列。苔绿鳞革#6a7a50缀青灰皮绳#6a7a80，不上漆的年轮纹圆木扣横穿一道细弦（苍弦徽记）；轻薄贴腿，右腿外侧绑一只小刀鞘，膝头缝年轮纹圆皮片，徽记扣在腰带，刻纹透极淡叶绿微光。
subject.en: A pair of leather leggings of the Greenstring set, front view, both legs side by side. Moss-green scale leather #6a7a50 laced with blue-grey cord #6a7a80, and an unvarnished round wooden toggle carved with growth rings and crossed by a fine bowstring (the shared Greenstring emblem) on the belt; light and close-fitting, a small knife sheath strapped to the outside of the right leg, round ring-patterned leather patches on the knees, and engraved lines with a very faint leaf-green glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。右腿小刀鞘与膝头年轮圆皮片是辨识点；苔绿为主，不加金属。

subject.zh: 一只苍弦软皮靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。苔绿鳞革#6a7a50缀青灰皮绳#6a7a80，不上漆的年轮纹圆木扣横穿一道细弦（苍弦徽记）；软底贴脚，靴筒由皮绳螺旋缠到膝下，靴口缀一片叶形皮，徽记扣在踝侧，刻纹透极淡叶绿微光。
subject.en: A single soft leather boot of the Greenstring set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Moss-green scale leather #6a7a50 laced with blue-grey cord #6a7a80, and an unvarnished round wooden toggle carved with growth rings and crossed by a fine bowstring (the shared Greenstring emblem) at the side of the ankle; a soft close sole, cord wound in a spiral up the shaft to below the knee, a leaf-shaped leather tab at the top, and engraved lines with a very faint leaf-green glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。螺旋缠绕皮绳的靴筒是辨识点；鞋底软薄，不要画成硬底战靴。

subject.zh: 一顶炉约方盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。暗钢灰方厚板甲#5a5e66，红铜包边#b0603a，砧形铜徽下挂一块无字长方契约牌（炉约徽记）；盔形方正如倒扣的砧，护鼻宽厚，徽记嵌在额前，铆钉排成矿纹，刻纹透极淡火橙微光#f0a040。
subject.en: A square helm of the Forge Pact set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Dark steel-grey thick square plate #5a5e66 with red copper trim #b0603a, and an anvil-shaped copper badge with a blank rectangular pact plate hanging below it (the shared Forge Pact emblem) set at the brow; the helm is as square as an upturned anvil, with a broad thick nasal, rivets laid out like ore veins, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow #f0a040.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。倒扣砧形的方盔与砧徽下的空白契约牌是辨识点；契约牌上不能有字或数字。

subject.zh: 一副炉约胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。暗钢灰方厚板甲#5a5e66，红铜包边#b0603a，砧形铜徽下挂一块无字长方契约牌（炉约徽记）；徽记连契约牌挂在护心处，腰间束一条宽红铜带，铆钉排成矿纹，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the Forge Pact set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Dark steel-grey thick square plate #5a5e66 with red copper trim #b0603a, and an anvil-shaped copper badge with a blank rectangular pact plate hanging below it (the shared Forge Pact emblem) over the heart; a broad red copper band around the waist, rivets laid out like ore veins, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。护心处砧徽连空白契约牌是辨识点，不镶火玉；与深锤终炉胸甲的炉心金区分。

subject.zh: 一对炉约腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。暗钢灰方厚板甲#5a5e66，红铜包边#b0603a，砧形铜徽下挂一块无字长方契约牌（炉约徽记）；大腿甲方正厚重，膝甲是一块方砧形厚板，徽记缀在腰甲，铆钉排成矿纹，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Forge Pact set, front view, both legs side by side. Dark steel-grey thick square plate #5a5e66 with red copper trim #b0603a, and an anvil-shaped copper badge with a blank rectangular pact plate hanging below it (the shared Forge Pact emblem) on the waist plate; heavy square thigh plates, knee cops shaped like small square anvils, rivets laid out like ore veins, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。方砧形护膝是辨识点；颜色是暗钢灰加红铜，不用黑铁与炉心金。

subject.zh: 一只炉约板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。暗钢灰方厚板甲#5a5e66，红铜包边#b0603a，砧形铜徽下挂一块无字长方契约牌（炉约徽记）；徽记竖挂在护腕外侧，手背是一整块方板，指节铆钉排成矿纹，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A single plate gauntlet of the Forge Pact set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Dark steel-grey thick square plate #5a5e66 with red copper trim #b0603a, and an anvil-shaped copper badge with a blank rectangular pact plate hanging below it (the shared Forge Pact emblem) hanging upright on the outside of the cuff; the back of the hand is one solid square plate, knuckle rivets laid out like ore veins, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。契约牌挂在护腕外侧而不在手背，与契约名护手的手背钟铜铭板区分。

subject.zh: 一顶铃队圆皮帽，尺寸偏小，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。浅奶褐净革#c8a878滚深苔绿边#4e6a3e，圆环下挂一只钟铜小铃#b08840（铃队徽记）；帽顶圆润，两侧垂短护耳，徽记挂在帽顶正中，刻纹顺帽缝走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A small round leather cap of the Bell Team set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Pale cream-brown fine leather #c8a878 piped with deep moss green #4e6a3e, and a small bell-bronze bell #b08840 hanging from a ring (the shared Bell Team emblem) at the very top of the crown; a rounded crown, short earflaps at both sides, and engraved lines along the seams with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。帽顶正中挂一只小铃是辨识点；尺寸偏小、圆润，与守卷人的高顶软帽区分。

subject.zh: 一件小号铃队短皮甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。浅奶褐净革#c8a878滚深苔绿边#4e6a3e，圆环下挂一只钟铜小铃#b08840（铃队徽记）；斜挎一条插短弩矢的皮带，徽记挂在带扣，下摆两只圆角小袋，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A small-sized short leather jerkin of the Bell Team set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Pale cream-brown fine leather #c8a878 piped with deep moss green #4e6a3e, and a small bell-bronze bell #b08840 hanging from a ring (the shared Bell Team emblem) on the buckle of a diagonal bandolier stuck with short crossbow bolts; two round-cornered pockets at the hem, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。斜挎弩矢带是辨识点；只有两只小袋，与铃路百袋背心（满襟口袋）区分。

subject.zh: 一只铃队皮手套，尺寸偏小，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。浅奶褐净革#c8a878滚深苔绿边#4e6a3e，圆环下挂一只钟铜小铃#b08840（铃队徽记）；手背缝一只扣盖小袋，徽记挂在腕口，食指加一块护弦硬皮，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single small-sized leather glove of the Bell Team set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Pale cream-brown fine leather #c8a878 piped with deep moss green #4e6a3e, and a small bell-bronze bell #b08840 hanging from a ring (the shared Bell Team emblem) at the wrist; a tiny flap pocket sewn on the back of the hand, a hardened leather guard on the index finger, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手背扣盖小袋与腕口小铃是辨识点；手套偏小偏圆。

subject.zh: 一只铃队信物铃，居中，上方带一小段深苔绿系带。浅奶褐净革#c8a878滚深苔绿边#4e6a3e，圆环下挂一只钟铜小铃#b08840（铃队徽记）；信物是放大的徽记铃，挂在一片净革皮扣下，铃肩一圈压印麦粒纹，铃口刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A token bell of the Bell Team set, centered, with a short deep moss-green ribbon above. Pale cream-brown fine leather #c8a878 piped with deep moss green #4e6a3e, and a small bell-bronze bell #b08840 hanging from a ring (the shared Bell Team emblem); the token is that emblem bell enlarged, hung beneath a fine-leather tab, with a band of pressed grain-kernel marks around the shoulder and engraved lines at the mouth glowing a very faint pale cyan.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。铃肩麦粒压纹是辨识点；与驿卒铜铃（门形镂空、旧铜色）区分，这里是钟铜圆铃。

subject.zh: 一顶猎王锁子头巾，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88缀白骨片#d8ccb0，缠赭红与青绿两色彩绳，三道并列爪痕的骨牌（猎王徽记）；额顶伸出一对缠彩绳的短兽角，徽记垂在眉心，刻纹顺骨片走，透极淡叶绿微光#7ac060。
subject.en: A mail coif of the Hunt King set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 sewn with white bone plates #d8ccb0, wrapped in ochre-red and teal-green cords, and a bone plaque with three parallel claw marks (the shared Hunt King emblem) hanging at the brow; a pair of short cord-wrapped beast horns rises from the forehead, and engraved lines along the bone plates carry a very faint leaf-green glow #7ac060.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。缠彩绳的短兽角是辨识点；与角冠亲卫的黑铁大盔粗角区分，这里是锁子头巾。

subject.zh: 一件猎王锁甲衫，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88缀白骨片#d8ccb0，缠赭红与青绿两色彩绳，三道并列爪痕的骨牌（猎王徽记）；双肩披一圈灰褐兽毛，胸前骨片排成鳞状，徽记挂在正中，刻纹透极淡叶绿微光。
subject.en: A mail shirt of the Hunt King set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 sewn with white bone plates #d8ccb0, wrapped in ochre-red and teal-green cords, and a bone plaque with three parallel claw marks (the shared Hunt King emblem) hanging at the center; a mantle of grey-brown beast fur over the shoulders, bone plates laid like scales across the chest, and engraved lines with a very faint leaf-green glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。披肩兽毛与胸前鳞状骨片是辨识点；彩绳只两色，不要五颜六色。

subject.zh: 一对猎王锁子腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88缀白骨片#d8ccb0，缠赭红与青绿两色彩绳，三道并列爪痕的骨牌（猎王徽记）；腰间垂一排骨片流苏，膝头各绑一块弧形大骨，徽记缀在腰带，彩绳缠住小腿，刻纹透极淡叶绿微光。
subject.en: A pair of mail leg guards of the Hunt King set, front view, both legs side by side. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 sewn with white bone plates #d8ccb0, wrapped in ochre-red and teal-green cords, and a bone plaque with three parallel claw marks (the shared Hunt King emblem) on the belt; a fringe of bone pieces at the waist, a large curved bone strapped over each knee, cords wound around the shins, and engraved lines with a very faint leaf-green glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。膝头弧形大骨与腰间骨片流苏是辨识点；两腿并列。

subject.zh: 一只猎王锁子手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。铁灰锁甲#7a7f88缀白骨片#d8ccb0，缠赭红与青绿两色彩绳，三道并列爪痕的骨牌（猎王徽记）；手背钉三片并排的弯骨，腕口翻一圈短兽毛，徽记挂在护腕彩绳上，刻纹透极淡叶绿微光。
subject.en: A single mail glove of the Hunt King set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Iron-grey mail #7a7f88 sewn with white bone plates #d8ccb0, wrapped in ochre-red and teal-green cords, and a bone plaque with three parallel claw marks (the shared Hunt King emblem) hanging from the corded cuff; three curved bones riveted side by side on the back of the hand, a roll of short beast fur at the wrist, and engraved lines with a very faint leaf-green glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手背三片并排弯骨是辨识点；与红砾斗士手套的指节短铁钉区分。

subject.zh: 一顶录袍四角软帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。织满细点线纹的深青灰呢#3a4a58，银、橙、冰蓝三色学派窄带，嵌浅青录晶的菱形银扣（录袍徽记）；帽顶方平四角微翘，三色窄带绕帽一圈，徽记嵌在额前，点线纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A four-cornered soft cap of the Scriptrobe set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Deep slate-teal wool #3a4a58 woven all over with tiny dot-and-line patterns, a narrow school band in silver, orange and ice blue, and a diamond-shaped silver clasp set with a pale cyan record crystal (the shared Scriptrobe emblem) at the brow; a flat square top with slightly upturned corners, the tricolor band circling the cap, and the dot-line weave glowing a very faint pale cyan.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。方平四角帽顶与三色窄带是辨识点；点线纹只是细点和短线，不能像文字。

subject.zh: 一件录袍长袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。织满细点线纹的深青灰呢#3a4a58，银、橙、冰蓝三色学派窄带，嵌浅青录晶的菱形银扣（录袍徽记）；三色窄带镶在两只袖口，前襟徽记下垂两条细长飘带，点线纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A long robe of the Scriptrobe set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Deep slate-teal wool #3a4a58 woven all over with tiny dot-and-line patterns, a narrow school band in silver, orange and ice blue, and a diamond-shaped silver clasp set with a pale cyan record crystal (the shared Scriptrobe emblem) at the front; the tricolor band trims both cuffs, two long thin streamers hang below the clasp, and the weave glows a very faint pale cyan.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。袖口三色带与徽记下两条细飘带是辨识点；与守卷人长袍区分：深青灰点线纹，不积灰。

subject.zh: 一条录袍长裤，正面，两条腿并列。织满细点线纹的深青灰呢#3a4a58，银、橙、冰蓝三色学派窄带，嵌浅青录晶的菱形银扣（录袍徽记）；宽松的布裤，裤脚收紧，外侧各一道三色窄带直落到底，徽记扣在腰带，点线纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A pair of cloth trousers of the Scriptrobe set, front view, both legs side by side. Deep slate-teal wool #3a4a58 woven all over with tiny dot-and-line patterns, a narrow school band in silver, orange and ice blue, and a diamond-shaped silver clasp set with a pale cyan record crystal (the shared Scriptrobe emblem) on the belt; loose trousers gathered at the ankles, a tricolor band running straight down the outside of each leg, and the weave glowing a very faint pale cyan.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两腿外侧直落的三色窄带是辨识点；是宽松布裤，不要画成裙或护腿甲。

subject.zh: 一只录袍布手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。织满细点线纹的深青灰呢#3a4a58，银、橙、冰蓝三色学派窄带，嵌浅青录晶的菱形银扣（录袍徽记）；修长的薄手套，手背嵌徽记，腕口缠一道三色窄带，指尖沾一点浅青晶墨，点线纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single cloth glove of the Scriptrobe set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Deep slate-teal wool #3a4a58 woven all over with tiny dot-and-line patterns, a narrow school band in silver, orange and ice blue, and a diamond-shaped silver clasp set with a pale cyan record crystal (the shared Scriptrobe emblem) on the back of the hand; a slim thin glove with the tricolor band around the wrist, a touch of pale cyan crystal ink on the fingertips, and the weave glowing a very faint pale cyan.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。手背录晶菱形扣与指尖浅青晶墨是辨识点；与守卷人墨黑指尖的半指手套区分。

subject.zh: 一顶晶背炉锁子盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。铁灰锁子甲#7a7f88，关键处嵌菱形褐甲壳片#7a5a3a，片脊一道灰白晶棱（晶背炉徽记）；铁半盔下垂锁子护颈，盔顶脊线就是一整片带晶棱的甲壳，刻纹顺甲壳走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A mail helm of the Crystalback Forge set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Iron-grey chainmail #7a7f88 with diamond-shaped brown carapace plates #7a5a3a set at key points, each with a grey-white crystal ridge along its spine (the shared Crystalback Forge emblem); an iron half-helm over a hanging mail neck guard, its crest formed by one whole carapace plate with a crystal ridge, and engraved lines along the carapace with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一个图标通用三阶版本；盔顶整片带晶棱的甲壳是辨识点，晶棱灰白，不加紫。

subject.zh: 一件晶背炉锁子甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。铁灰锁子甲#7a7f88，关键处嵌菱形褐甲壳片#7a5a3a，片脊一道灰白晶棱（晶背炉徽记）；双肩各扣一片大甲壳护肩，胸口一片菱形甲壳护心，刻纹顺甲壳走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A mail hauberk of the Crystalback Forge set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Iron-grey chainmail #7a7f88 with diamond-shaped brown carapace plates #7a5a3a set at key points, each with a grey-white crystal ridge along its spine (the shared Crystalback Forge emblem); a large carapace pauldron buckled on each shoulder, a diamond carapace plate over the heart, and engraved lines along the carapace with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。三阶版本共用一个图标；双肩大甲壳与胸口菱形护心是辨识点，甲壳保持自然褐色。

subject.zh: 一只晶背炉锁子手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。铁灰锁子甲#7a7f88，关键处嵌菱形褐甲壳片#7a5a3a，片脊一道灰白晶棱（晶背炉徽记）；手背一片菱形甲壳护板，指节缀小甲壳片，护腕内侧一枚小锤形匠记，刻纹透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single mail glove of the Crystalback Forge set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Iron-grey chainmail #7a7f88 with diamond-shaped brown carapace plates #7a5a3a set at key points, each with a grey-white crystal ridge along its spine (the shared Crystalback Forge emblem); a diamond carapace plate on the back of the hand, small carapace scales over the knuckles, a tiny hammer-shaped maker's mark on the cuff, and engraved lines with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。三阶版本共用一个图标；手背菱形甲壳与护腕小锤匠记是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一只晶背炉战靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。铁灰锁子甲#7a7f88，关键处嵌菱形褐甲壳片#7a5a3a，片脊一道灰白晶棱（晶背炉徽记）；锁子靴筒，护胫是一长片带晶棱的甲壳，靴头包铁，刻纹顺甲壳走，透极淡浅青微光。
subject.en: A single war boot of the Crystalback Forge set, three-quarter front-side view, toe toward lower left. Iron-grey chainmail #7a7f88 with diamond-shaped brown carapace plates #7a5a3a set at key points, each with a grey-white crystal ridge along its spine (the shared Crystalback Forge emblem); a mail shaft, a long carapace greave with a crystal ridge down the shin, an iron-capped toe, and engraved lines along the carapace with a very faint pale cyan glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。三阶版本共用一个图标；长条晶棱甲壳护胫是辨识点，晶棱只是一道灰白亮线。

subject.zh: 一顶深锤终炉方盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。方正厚重的黑铁板甲#3c3f46，炉心金包边#e0a030，锤形金框嵌一颗暗红火玉（深锤终炉徽记）；方正闭面盔，额前伸出一道厚帽檐，护颊方厚垂到下颌，徽记嵌在帽檐上，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A square helm of the Deephammer Endforge set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Square, heavy black-iron plate #3c3f46 with forgeheart-gold trim #e0a030, and a hammer-shaped gold frame set with a dark red fire jade (the shared Deephammer Endforge emblem) on the brim; a square closed helm with a thick brim jutting over the brow, square heavy cheek guards reaching the jaw, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。厚帽檐与方厚护颊是辨识点；黑铁为主、炉心金只做包边，与通体炉心金手甲区分。

subject.zh: 一副深锤终炉胸甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。方正厚重的黑铁板甲#3c3f46，炉心金包边#e0a030，锤形金框嵌一颗暗红火玉（深锤终炉徽记）；徽记镶在护心正中，铆钉沿胸板排成矿纹，双肩方甲叠两层，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A breastplate of the Deephammer Endforge set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Square, heavy black-iron plate #3c3f46 with forgeheart-gold trim #e0a030, and a hammer-shaped gold frame set with a dark red fire jade (the shared Deephammer Endforge emblem) at the heart; rivets laid out like ore veins across the chest, square pauldrons stacked in two layers, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。护心的锤形金框火玉是辨识点；与守炉人胸甲的炉口栅板、炉约胸甲的契约牌区分。

subject.zh: 一对深锤终炉腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。方正厚重的黑铁板甲#3c3f46，炉心金包边#e0a030，锤形金框嵌一颗暗红火玉（深锤终炉徽记）；大腿甲方厚，膝甲各镶一粒小火玉，铆钉排成矿纹，徽记缀在腰甲中央，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A pair of plate leg guards of the Deephammer Endforge set, front view, both legs side by side. Square, heavy black-iron plate #3c3f46 with forgeheart-gold trim #e0a030, and a hammer-shaped gold frame set with a dark red fire jade (the shared Deephammer Endforge emblem) at the center of the waist plate; heavy square thigh plates, a small fire jade set in each knee cop, rivets laid out like ore veins, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。两只膝甲各一粒小火玉是辨识点；不要把甲画成通体金色。

subject.zh: 一只深锤终炉板甲护手，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。方正厚重的黑铁板甲#3c3f46，炉心金包边#e0a030，锤形金框嵌一颗暗红火玉（深锤终炉徽记）；徽记嵌在长护腕外侧，手背黑铁方板镶金边，指节排矿纹铆钉，刻纹透极淡火橙微光。
subject.en: A single plate gauntlet of the Deephammer Endforge set, back of the hand facing out, fingers toward upper right. Square, heavy black-iron plate #3c3f46 with forgeheart-gold trim #e0a030, and a hammer-shaped gold frame set with a dark red fire jade (the shared Deephammer Endforge emblem) on the outside of the long cuff; a gold-edged black-iron square plate over the back of the hand, ore-vein rivets over the knuckles, and engraved lines with a very faint fire-orange glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。火玉在护腕外侧而不在手背中央，主色黑铁；与炉心金手甲、契约名护手区分。

subject.zh: 一顶千门旗锁子盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。铁灰与门铜#9a7840锁环交错，几种手法拼成，拱门形徽记透门扉金#f0d890（千门旗徽记）；门铜半盔连锁子护颈，盔脊由三段不同金属拼铆，额前拱门形护额板嵌徽记，刻纹透极淡门扉金微光。
subject.en: A mail helm of the Thousand Gates Banner set, three-quarter front-side view facing lower left. Iron-grey and gate-bronze #9a7840 rings interlaced, pieced together by several different hands, and an arch-door emblem glowing gate gold #f0d890 (the shared Thousand Gates Banner emblem); a gate-bronze half-helm over a mail neck guard, its crest riveted from three different metals, the emblem set in an arch-shaped brow plate, and engraved lines with a very faint gate-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。布、皮、锁、板四版本共用此图标，画成锁甲版；三段拼铆盔脊与拱门护额板是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一件千门旗锁子甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。铁灰与门铜#9a7840锁环交错，几种手法拼成，拱门形徽记透门扉金#f0d890（千门旗徽记）；外罩一面短旗式罩布，正中是徽记，两肩甲片一铜一铁，刻纹透极淡门扉金微光。
subject.en: A mail hauberk of the Thousand Gates Banner set, front view from slightly above, as if on an invisible mannequin, shoulders at top. Iron-grey and gate-bronze #9a7840 rings interlaced, pieced together by several different hands, and an arch-door emblem glowing gate gold #f0d890 (the shared Thousand Gates Banner emblem) at the center of a short banner-like tabard; one pauldron bronze and the other iron, and engraved lines with a very faint gate-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。布、皮、锁、板四版本共用此图标，画成锁甲版；旗式罩布与一铜一铁肩甲是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一对千门旗锁子腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。铁灰与门铜#9a7840锁环交错，几种手法拼成，拱门形徽记透门扉金#f0d890（千门旗徽记）；两腿锁环编法各不相同，膝头是一对小拱门形护膝，徽记缀在腰带，刻纹透极淡门扉金微光。
subject.en: A pair of mail leg guards of the Thousand Gates Banner set, front view, both legs side by side. Iron-grey and gate-bronze #9a7840 rings interlaced, pieced together by several different hands, and an arch-door emblem glowing gate gold #f0d890 (the shared Thousand Gates Banner emblem) on the belt; each leg woven in a different ring pattern, small arch-shaped knee cops, and engraved lines with a very faint gate-gold glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。布、皮、锁、板四版本共用此图标，画成锁甲版；两腿编法不同与拱门形护膝是辨识点。

subject.zh: 一面千门旗信物小旗，居中，上方带一小段系绳。铁灰与门铜#9a7840锁环交错，几种手法拼成，拱门形徽记透门扉金#f0d890（千门旗徽记）；巴掌大的燕尾小旗挂在短杆上，旗面由几块不同布料拼成，正中是徽记，杆头套一串铜铁交错的小环。
subject.en: A small banner token of the Thousand Gates Banner set, centered, with a short loop of cord above. Iron-grey and gate-bronze #9a7840 rings interlaced, pieced together by several different hands, and an arch-door emblem glowing gate gold #f0d890 (the shared Thousand Gates Banner emblem) at the center; a palm-sized swallow-tailed pennant on a short rod, its field pieced from several different fabrics, with a string of interlaced bronze and iron rings at the rod's head.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。燕尾小旗由几块布拼成、杆头铜铁小环是辨识点；整体是小挂件，不要画成大旗。

subject.zh: 一捆征召兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件本色粗布袍#d8c8a8叠成软包，两条皮带交叉扎紧；一杆木杆铁头长枪斜插在包上，枪头是小小的铁叶#7a7f88；包侧挂一块空白木签。素面实用，不加刻纹与发光。
subject.en: A bundled levy kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: an undyed coarse cloth robe #d8c8a8 folded into a soft pack and bound tight with two crossed leather straps; a wooden-shafted spear with a small iron leaf head #7a7f88 is thrust slantwise through the pack; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Plain and practical, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。最低档：布袍软包加小铁头木枪，最朴素；与民兵套的皮甲包区分。

subject.zh: 一捆民兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：一副中褐皮甲#8a5a34叠成方包，两条皮带交叉捆紧；一杆长枪斜插在包上，枪头是修长的铁叶，枪颈套一只铁环；包侧挂一块空白木签。只用材料本色，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled militia kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a set of mid-brown leather armour #8a5a34 folded into a square pack and bound with two crossed leather straps; a spear with a long slim iron leaf head and an iron ring at its neck is thrust slantwise through the pack; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Natural material colours only, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。皮甲方包加长叶枪头；与征召兵的布袍和长枪民兵的木圆盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆长枪民兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：中褐皮甲#8a5a34叠成方包，正面绑着一面木圆盾，盾面刷一道灰色横条，盾边钉几颗粗大铆钉；一杆长枪斜插过包；灰褐皮带交叉扎紧，包侧挂一块空白木签。灰墙作的粗朴，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled spear-militia kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: mid-brown leather armour #8a5a34 folded into a square pack with a wooden round shield strapped to its front, a grey horizontal stripe brushed across the shield and a few heavy rivets around its rim; a spear is thrust slantwise through the pack; grey-brown straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Rough greywall style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。包前木圆盾上的灰横条是灰墙作标志；与民兵套的无盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆长弓民兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：中褐皮甲#8a5a34叠成方包，两条皮带交叉扎紧；一张素木乡勇长弓#8a6040斜插在包上，弓弦松着；皮带下别一把短铁匕首；包侧挂一块空白木签。朴素廉价，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled longbow-militia kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: mid-brown leather armour #8a5a34 folded into a square pack bound with two crossed leather straps; a plain wooden rustic longbow #8a6040 with its string slack is thrust slantwise through the pack, and a short iron dagger is tucked under a strap; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Plain and cheap, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。主武器是松弦长弓，不是枪；与猎手队的深色橡心弓与毛皮区分。

subject.zh: 一捆猎手队军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成方包，边缘压线，包口翻出一圈毛皮；一张深褐橡心长弓#6a4628斜插在包上，两梢套灰角片；皮带下别一把精钢匕首#a8b0bc；包侧挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled hunters kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 with stitched edges folded into a square pack, a ring of fur turned out at its mouth; a dark brown oakheart longbow #6a4628 with grey horn tips is thrust slantwise through the pack, and a steel dagger #a8b0bc is tucked under a strap; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。深色橡心弓加灰角梢与毛皮翻边；与长弓民兵的素木弓和中褐皮甲区分。

subject.zh: 一捆圣誓狂信徒军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件近白细布法袍#ece6d8草草叠起，用褪色黄绳与皮带交叉捆住，袍角缝一块粗糙的放射纹布章；一柄精钢钉锤#a8b0bc斜插在包上，锤头一圈短钉；包侧挂一块空白木签。配给货，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled zealot kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a near-white fine cloth robe #ece6d8 folded hastily and bound with a faded yellow cord and a leather strap crossed over it, a crude radiating-pattern cloth patch sewn on one corner; a steel spiked mace #a8b0bc with a ring of short spikes on its head is thrust slantwise through the pack; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Issued gear, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。白布袍加钉锤、无护甲；叠得潦草显出装备差，与战地神官的锁甲香炉区分。

subject.zh: 一捆城卫军械，正面四分之三俯视：亮钢灰锁子甲#a8b0bc叠成方包，锁头巾叠在包顶；正面绑一面精钢圆盾，盾心压一枚锤形印；一把精钢短剑斜插过包，剑格方正；整齐的深褐皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled city-guard kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bright steel-grey mail #a8b0bc folded into a square pack with a mail coif folded on top; a steel round shield with a hammer-shaped stamp on its boss is strapped to the front; a steel short sword with a square guard is thrust slantwise through the pack; neat dark brown straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。锁甲包、锁头巾、盾心锤形印是河谷行会作标志；与门扉护卫套的门形徽记区分。

subject.zh: 一捆门扉护卫军械，正面四分之三俯视：亮钢灰锁子甲#a8b0bc叠成方包，锁头巾在顶；正面绑一面精钢圆盾，盾心是铜铁两色拼铆的门形徽记；一把精钢短剑斜插过包；深蓝皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled company-guard kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bright steel-grey mail #a8b0bc folded into a square pack with the coif on top; a steel round shield is strapped to the front, its boss a door-shaped emblem riveted in two tones of copper and iron; a steel short sword is thrust slantwise through the pack; dark blue straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。组件同城卫，靠铜铁拼铆的门形盾徽与深蓝皮带区分；不发门扉金光。

subject.zh: 一捆边境游骑军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成方包，包顶扣一顶硬革圆帽；一柄长柄骑兵斧斜插过包，斧刃窄而弯；包后横绑一张劲弩，只露出两端弩臂；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled border-rider kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a square pack with a round hardened leather cap on top; a long-hafted cavalry axe with a narrow curved blade is thrust slantwise through the pack; a stout crossbow is lashed crosswise behind the pack with only its two arms showing; crossed straps bind it all and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。窄弯刃骑兵斧加包后露出的弩臂是标志；与狂战士的双刃巨斧区分。

subject.zh: 一捆兽人战士军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成大方包，正面绑一面精钢圆盾#a8b0bc；一柄胡须斧斜插过包，斧刃下缘长长垂成钩；皮带交叉扎紧，结上系一段赭红部族绳，挂一块空白木签。体量粗大，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled orc-warrior kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a large square pack with a steel round shield #a8b0bc strapped to its front; a bearded axe whose blade hangs down in a long hook is thrust slantwise through the pack; crossed straps bind it, an ochre-red tribal cord is tied on the knot, and a blank wooden tag hangs from it. Bulky, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。下缘垂钩的胡须斧是辨识点；比人族套更粗大，与车阵护卫的枪与小圆盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆萨满军械，正面四分之三俯视：亮钢灰锁子甲#a8b0bc叠成方包，皮带交叉扎紧；一根深褐橡心木杖#6a4628斜插在包上，杖头嵌一块蜜黄色的大琥珀#d89a30；杖身缠彩绳、缀几片骨片；包侧挂一块空白木签。骨角作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled shaman kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bright steel-grey mail #a8b0bc folded into a square pack bound with crossed straps; a dark brown oakheart staff #6a4628 with a large honey-yellow lump of amber #d89a30 set in its head is thrust slantwise through the pack, its shaft wound with coloured cords and hung with a few bone chips; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Bone-and-horn style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。杖头蜜黄琥珀是辨识点，琥珀不发光；与夜魔施法者的黑曜杖区分。

subject.zh: 一捆军团方阵军械，正面四分之三俯视：近黑蓝灰的黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成方包，包后立一面长方黑铁塔盾，盾缘有无字编号刻痕，包顶扣一顶黑铁盔；一杆长枪斜插过包；深红皮带#7a2a2a交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。式样统一，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled legion-phalanx kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: near-black blue-grey black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a square pack, a rectangular black-iron tower shield standing behind it with unlettered tally notches on its rim, and a black-iron helmet on top; a long spear is thrust slantwise through the pack; deep red straps #7a2a2a cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Uniform pattern, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。军坊作铁灰深红：长枪加长方塔盾；与灰墙重步兵的剑与灰横条区分。

subject.zh: 一捆灰墙重步兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁胸甲与腿甲#3c3f46叠成厚包，包口一圈毛皮，包顶扣黑铁盔；包后立一面黑铁塔盾，盾面一道灰白横条，粗大铆钉；一把黑铁剑斜插过包；灰褐皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled greywall-infantry kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron breastplate and legplates #3c3f46 folded into a thick pack with a ring of fur at its mouth and a black-iron helmet on top; a black-iron tower shield with a grey-white horizontal stripe and heavy rivets stands behind it; a black-iron sword is thrust slantwise through the pack; grey-brown straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。塔盾灰横条加毛皮是灰墙作标志；主武器是剑，与军团方阵的长枪区分。

subject.zh: 一捆战地神官军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成方包，外罩一块镶银边的白布；一柄黑铁钉锤斜插过包；皮带上挂一只黑铁小香炉，炉盖开着对称的放射孔；白皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。白冕作的白与金，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled war-priest kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a square pack covered by a white cloth edged in silver; a black-iron spiked mace is thrust slantwise through the pack; a small black-iron censer with symmetrical radiating holes in its lid hangs from a strap; white straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. White-crown white and gold, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。挂在包上的黑铁香炉是辨识点；白布银边，不发神光；与狂信徒的白布袍区分。

subject.zh: 一捆翼魔游骑军械，正面四分之三俯视：暗灰褐的澱兽皮甲#4a4440叠成轻薄的包，皮面散着几处灰中带紫的斑点；一杆灰皮木杆黑铁长枪斜插过包，枪头多角带倒钩；黑红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。不反光，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled wing-fiend kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark grey-brown dian-beast hide armour #4a4440 folded into a light thin pack, a few purple-tinged grey spots scattered on the hide; a black-iron spear on an ashbark shaft with a many-angled barbed head is thrust slantwise through the pack; black-and-red straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No shine, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。轻澱纹只有几处灰紫斑；多角倒钩枪头，与夜魔刺客的双锋匕区分。

subject.zh: 一捆铁蹄重骑军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁胸甲、腿甲、盔与战靴#3c3f46叠在一叠折起的黑铁马铠上，包顶扣一块马面甲；一杆重骑长枪斜插过包；深红皮带#7a2a2a交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。军坊作，式样统一，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled ironhoof heavy-cavalry kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron breastplate, legplates, helmet and war boots #3c3f46 stacked on a folded black-iron horse barding, with a horse face plate on top; a heavy cavalry lance is thrust slantwise through the pack; deep red straps #7a2a2a cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Uniform military-workshop pattern, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。包顶的马面甲是辨识点，体量最大；与王室骑士的蓝银鸢盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆帝国战法师军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件深红丝法袍#8a2a30叠成软包，袍面一道柔光高光，边缘镶铁灰滚边；一根学士录杖斜插在包上，杖头嵌一枚浅青小晶；皮带上挂一盏尖顶黑曜小灯#1e1a22；挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled imperial battle-mage kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a deep red silk robe #8a2a30 folded into a soft pack with one soft silk highlight and an iron-grey trim; a scholar's record wand with a small pale-cyan crystal in its head is thrust slantwise through the pack; a small pointed obsidian lamp #1e1a22 hangs from a strap, beside a blank wooden tag. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。深红丝袍加录杖与黑曜灯；晶石不发光；与夜魔施法者的蓝黑袍区分。

subject.zh: 一捆圣骑士军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁胸甲、腿甲与盔#3c3f46叠成厚包，甲缘镶银边；包后立一面白漆鸢盾，盾面金色对称光环纹；一柄法冠形锤头的战锤斜插过包；白皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled paladin kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron breastplate, legplates and helmet #3c3f46 folded into a thick pack with silver-edged rims; a white-lacquered kite shield with a symmetrical gold halo pattern stands behind it; a warhammer with a mitre-shaped head is thrust slantwise through the pack; white straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。法冠形锤头与白漆金环鸢盾是辨识点；金环是漆纹不发光，与王室骑士套区分。

subject.zh: 一捆矮人重步兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：方正厚重的黑铁胸甲#3c3f46与腿甲叠成矮宽的包，护心镶一粒红火玉；包后立一面方形塔盾，铆钉排成矿纹；一柄黑铁钉锤斜插过包，包顶扣一顶方盔；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled dwarf heavy-infantry kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a square, heavy black-iron breastplate #3c3f46 folded with its legplates into a low wide pack, a red fire jade set on its heart guard; a square tower shield with rivets laid out like an ore vein stands behind it; a black-iron spiked mace is thrust slantwise through the pack and a square helmet sits on top; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。矮宽的方正包、矿纹铆钉与护心火玉是深锤作标志；与战锤老兵的大锤无盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆鬼人重步兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁胸甲#3c3f46叠成宽大的包，包顶扣一顶生着两枚短角的黑铁盔；一柄多角的黑铁大斧斜插过包，斧脊刻角位刻痕；暗红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。黑红配色，不反光，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled oni heavy-infantry kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a black-iron breastplate #3c3f46 folded into a broad pack with a black-iron helmet bearing two short horns on top; a many-angled black-iron greataxe with horn-rank notches on its spine is thrust slantwise through the pack; dark red straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Black and red, no shine, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。双短角盔与多角大斧是辨识点；与澱猎人的浅色净革包区分。

subject.zh: 一捆夜魔施法者军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件蓝黑丝法袍#2a2e40叠成软包，袍面一道柔光高光；一根灰皮木杖#8a8680斜插在包上，杖头嵌一片尖棱黑曜石#1e1a22；黑红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。不反光，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled night-caster kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a blue-black silk robe #2a2e40 folded into a soft pack with one soft silk highlight; an ashbark staff #8a8680 with a sharp-edged shard of obsidian #1e1a22 in its head is thrust slantwise through the pack; black-and-red straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No shine, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。黑曜尖棱杖头加蓝黑丝袍；与帝国战法师的深红袍和黑曜灯区分。

subject.zh: 一捆精灵长弓手军械，正面四分之三俯视：青铜绿细鳞的鳞革甲#6a7a50叠成方包；一张不上漆的红褐林紫杉长弓#9a4a3a斜插在包上，木纹清晰；苔绿皮带交叉扎紧，结上缠一段青灰细绳，挂一块空白木签。倒木作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled elven longbow kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bronze-green fine-scale leather armour #6a7a50 folded into a square pack; an unlacquered red-brown forest-yew longbow #9a4a3a with clear wood grain is thrust slantwise through it; moss-green straps cross over the pack with a blue-grey cord wound on the knot, and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Fallen-wood style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。不上漆的紫杉长弓加绿鳞革包；与守林卫的月银细刃、猎手队的深色弓区分。

subject.zh: 一捆红牙军军械，正面四分之三俯视：不反光的夜铁胸甲#26232a叠成方包，泛暗红光泽#8a3030，肩部缀一排红漆兽牙；一把宽厚的夜铁大剑斜插过包；暗红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。不配头盔，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled red-fang army kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a non-reflective night-iron breastplate #26232a with a dark red sheen #8a3030 folded into a square pack, a row of red-lacquered fangs along its shoulder; a broad heavy night-iron greatsword is thrust slantwise through the pack; dark red straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No helmet, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。夜铁大剑加肩部红漆兽牙，不带头盔；与鬼人重步兵的双角盔大斧区分。

subject.zh: 一捆王室骑士军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁胸甲、腿甲、盔与战靴#3c3f46叠成整齐的厚包；包后立一面深蓝鸢盾，银边，盾心压一枚锤形印；一杆骑士长枪斜插过包；合身的深蓝皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled royal-knight kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron breastplate, legplates, helmet and boots #3c3f46 folded into a neat thick pack; a deep blue kite shield edged in silver with a hammer-shaped stamp on its centre stands behind it; a knight's lance is thrust slantwise through the pack; well-fitted deep blue straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。深蓝银边鸢盾与锤形印是河谷行会作标志；与圣骑士的白漆金环鸢盾、铁蹄重骑的马面甲区分。

subject.zh: 一捆攻城工兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成方包；一柄长柄黑铁锤斜插过包，锤头一端方平、一端是撬镐；深红皮带#7a2a2a交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签，包缘有无字编号刻痕。军坊作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled siege-engineer kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a square pack; a long-hafted black-iron hammer, one end of its head square and flat and the other a prying pick, is thrust slantwise through the pack; deep red straps #7a2a2a cross over it, a blank wooden tag hangs from them, and unlettered tally notches mark the pack edge. Military-workshop style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。方头带撬镐的长柄锤是辨识点；比战锤老兵的大锤细长，军坊作深红皮带。

subject.zh: 一捆守林卫军械，正面四分之三俯视：青铜绿细鳞的鳞革甲#6a7a50叠成方包，包缘露出不上漆的木扣；一把冷白月银细刃#e0e8f0斜插过包，刃身细长微弯，带一抹浅蓝；苔绿皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。倒木作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled forest-warden kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bronze-green fine-scale leather armour #6a7a50 folded into a square pack with unlacquered wooden toggles at its edge; a slender, slightly curved cold-white moon-silver blade #e0e8f0 with a touch of light blue is thrust slantwise through the pack; moss-green straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Fallen-wood style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。月银细刃冷白带浅蓝、不发光；与精灵长弓手的紫杉弓区分。

subject.zh: 一捆角兽骑兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：厚实的灰褐角兽皮甲#7a5a40叠成方包，带粗毛边，两角缀短角片；一杆黑铁长枪斜插过包，枪尾缠彩绳；皮带交叉扎紧，结上系红黄靛三色绳，挂一块空白木签。骨角作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled hornbeast-rider kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: thick grey-brown hornbeast hide armour #7a5a40 folded into a square pack with a coarse hairy edge and short horn plates on two corners; a black-iron lance with coloured cords wound round its butt is thrust slantwise through the pack; crossed straps bind it, red, yellow and indigo cords are tied on the knot, and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Bone-and-horn style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。粗毛边角兽皮包与三色彩绳是辨识点；与铁蹄重骑的黑铁马铠包区分。

subject.zh: 一捆岩掌重战士军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成方包，甲面缀几片骨片；一柄巨大的黑铁锤斜插过包，锤头粗如石墩，用彩绳缠住锤颈；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签和一枚熊爪。骨角作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled rock-palm brute kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a square pack with a few bone plates sewn on; a huge black-iron maul with a head as thick as a stone block, its neck wound with coloured cord, is thrust slantwise through the pack; crossed straps bind it, and a blank wooden tag and a bear claw hang from them. Bone-and-horn style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。石墩般的巨锤头与彩绳缠颈、熊爪是辨识点；与深锤作方正大锤区分。

subject.zh: 一捆斑影斥候军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成小包，皮面印着暗褐豹斑，一双硬革软靴绑在包顶；包前扣着一副精钢指虎#a8b0bc；暗色彩绳缠住交叉的皮带，挂一块空白木签。哑光，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled spot-shadow scout kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 printed with dull dark-brown leopard spots folded into a small pack, a pair of soft hardened leather boots tied on top; a pair of steel knuckle-dusters #a8b0bc is buckled to the front of the pack; dark coloured cords are wound on the crossed straps and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Matte, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。没有长兵器，包前的指虎是主武器；豹斑要暗，与遗民斥候的匕首区分。

subject.zh: 一捆狂战士军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226胡乱叠成一包，皮面抹一道赭红战纹；一柄双刃巨斧斜插过包，两面斧刃宽大对称；粗皮带交叉勒紧，挂一块空白木签。粗犷，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled berserker kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 roughly folded into a pack with an ochre-red war stripe smeared across the leather; a great double-bladed axe with two broad symmetrical blades is thrust slantwise through the pack; heavy straps cross tight over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Rugged, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。对称双刃巨斧是辨识点，不加澱纹；与边境游骑的窄弯骑兵斧区分。

subject.zh: 一捆重弩手军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成矮宽方包；一张破甲重弩压在包上，弩臂横在上方，弩身斜向右下，侧面带绞盘；包缘铆钉排成矿纹；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。深锤作方正厚重，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled dwarf arbalest kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a low wide square pack; a heavy armour-piercing crossbow with a winch on its side lies on the pack, arms across the top and stock slanting to the lower right; the pack edge has rivets laid out like an ore vein; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Deep-hammer square and heavy, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。带绞盘的重弩横压包上；与半身人弩手的小劲弩与圆包区分。

subject.zh: 一捆战锤老兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：方正的黑铁胸甲#3c3f46叠成厚包，护心镶一粒火玉，包顶扣一顶方盔；一柄双手大锤斜插过包，锤头方正厚重，侧面铆钉排成矿纹；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled hammer-veteran kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a squared black-iron breastplate #3c3f46 folded into a thick pack with a fire jade on its heart guard and a square helmet on top; a two-handed warhammer with a square heavy head, the rivets on its side laid out like an ore vein, is thrust slantwise through the pack; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。方正双手大锤加方盔，没有盾；与矮人重步兵的钉锤塔盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆半身人弩手军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成圆鼓鼓的小包，外侧缝着好几个口袋，挂一只小钟铜铃#b08840；一张短小的劲弩压在包顶，弩臂横在上方；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。尺寸偏小，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled halfling crossbow kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a round, plump small pack with several pockets sewn on its sides and a small bronze bell #b08840 hanging from it; a short stout crossbow lies on top, arms across; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Small sized, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。圆鼓小包、多口袋与小铃是铃路作标志；整体比别的套小一号。

subject.zh: 一捆车阵护卫军械，正面四分之三俯视：亮钢灰锁子甲#a8b0bc叠成圆润的小包，正面绑一面边缘圆滑的精钢小圆盾，盾边挂一只小铃；一杆精钢长枪斜插过包；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。铃路作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled wagon-guard kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bright steel-grey mail #a8b0bc folded into a rounded small pack with a smooth-rimmed little steel round shield strapped to the front, a small bell hanging from its rim; a steel spear is thrust slantwise through the pack; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. Bell-road style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。圆润小盾挂小铃加长枪；与城卫的短剑锁头巾、半身人弩手的弩区分。

subject.zh: 一捆蛇人伏兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑褐硬革甲#3a2e28叠成窄包，皮面压着细鳞纹；一把反刃短刀斜插过包，刀身向内弯成镰形，黑钢不反光；暗红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled serpent-ambusher kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-brown hardened leather armour #3a2e28 stamped with a fine scale pattern folded into a narrow pack; a reverse-edged short knife whose blade curves inward like a sickle, black steel with no shine, is thrust slantwise through the pack; dark red straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。向内弯的反刃短刀是辨识点；不画毒瓶，与夜魔刺客的双锋匕区分。

subject.zh: 一捆夜魔刺客军械，正面四分之三俯视：哑光的暗灰褐澱兽皮甲#3e3836叠成窄包，皮面散着几处灰中带紫的斑点；一把黑铁双锋匕斜插过包，刃根嵌一片黑曜石；黑红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。不反光，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled night-assassin kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: matte dark grey-brown dian-beast hide armour #3e3836 folded into a narrow pack, a few purple-tinged grey spots scattered on the hide; a straight black-iron double-edged dagger with a sliver of obsidian set at its root is thrust slantwise through the pack; black-and-red straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No shine, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。直刃双锋匕加黑曜刃根；轻澱纹只几处斑，与翼魔游骑的长枪区分。

subject.zh: 一捆灰烬民兵军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成方包，外面裹一条灰烬色布巾#7a7670；一杆精钢长枪斜插过包；皮带上钉一枚铜铁两色拼成的门形小徽；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled ash-militia kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a square pack and wrapped in an ash-grey scarf #7a7670; a steel spear is thrust slantwise through the pack; a small door-shaped badge pieced from copper and iron is nailed to a strap; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。灰布巾与门形小徽是辨识点；不发门扉金光，与门扉护卫的锁甲圆盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆遗民斥候军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成小包，一双硬革靴绑在包顶；一把精钢匕首#a8b0bc斜插过包，柄缠深蓝皮条；皮带扣是铜铁两色拼成的门形扣；挂一块空白木签。门扉作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled remnant-scout kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a small pack with a pair of hardened leather boots tied on top; a steel dagger #a8b0bc with a dark blue leather-wrapped grip is thrust slantwise through the pack; the strap buckle is a door shape pieced from copper and iron; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Gate-house style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。匕首加门形皮带扣；与斑影斥候的指虎豹斑区分。

subject.zh: 一捆执钥人护卫军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成方包；包后立一面灰烬色黑铁塔盾，盾心镂空出一个拱门形窗洞，旧铁片与新铆钉拼在一起；一把黑铁剑斜插过包；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled keyholder-guard kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a square pack; an ash-coloured black-iron tower shield stands behind it with an arch-shaped window cut through its centre, old iron plates pieced together with new rivets; a black-iron sword is thrust slantwise through the pack; crossed straps bind it and a blank wooden tag hangs from them. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。塔盾上的拱门窗洞是辨识点，不发门扉金光；与灰墙重步兵的灰横条塔盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆澱猎人军械，正面四分之三俯视：浅奶褐的净革甲#c8a878叠成方包，一双净革靴绑在包顶；一柄宽厚的黑铁大斧斜插过包；皮带上钉一枚铜铁拼成的门形小徽；挂一块空白木签。净革干净，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled dian-hunter kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: pale cream-brown purified leather armour #c8a878 folded into a square pack with a pair of purified leather boots tied on top; a broad heavy black-iron greataxe is thrust slantwise through the pack; a small door-shaped badge pieced from copper and iron is nailed to a strap; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Clean leather, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。浅色净革是辨识点，绝不加紫；与鬼人重步兵的黑红大斧区分。

subject.zh: 一副粗皮马鞍，侧面四分之三：中褐粗皮#8a5a34蒙在木鞍架#8a6040上，前后鞍桥露出木头；两侧各挂一只用麻绳扎口的小鞍袋，粗针脚明显；一副麻绳与皮条编的简单辔头搭在鞍桥上。最粗朴的一档，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A rough leather saddle in side three-quarter view: mid-brown rough hide #8a5a34 stretched over a wooden saddle tree #8a6040, the wood showing at the pommel and cantle; a small saddlebag tied shut with hemp cord hangs on each side, its coarse stitching visible; a simple bridle of hemp rope and leather strips is draped over the pommel. The plainest tier, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。木鞍架外露、麻绳扎袋与麻绳辔头显出最低档；与硬革鞍袋的钟铜扣区分。

subject.zh: 一副硬革马鞍，侧面四分之三：深褐硬革#6a4226鞍面边缘压线，鞍桥包硬革；两侧各挂一只方正的鞍袋，袋盖扣着钟铜扣#b08840；钟铜马镫，辔头带钟铜圆环，搭在鞍桥上。做工整齐，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A hardened leather saddle in side three-quarter view: a dark brown hardened leather seat #6a4226 with pressed edge lines and leather-covered pommel and cantle; a squared saddlebag hangs on each side with bronze buckles #b08840 on the flaps; bronze stirrups, and a bridle with bronze rings draped over the pommel. Neatly made, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。深褐硬革加钟铜扣件与镫；每侧一只方鞍袋，与净革鞍袋的两层袋区分。

subject.zh: 一副净革马鞍，侧面四分之三：浅奶褐净革#c8a878鞍面，双线缝得细密；两侧各挂上下两层鞍袋，袋盖扣钟铜扣#b08840；钟铜马镫，浅色辔头搭在鞍桥上。干净利落，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A purified leather saddle in side three-quarter view: a pale cream-brown purified leather seat #c8a878 with fine double stitching; two tiers of saddlebags hang on each side with bronze buckles #b08840 on the flaps; bronze stirrups, and a pale bridle draped over the pommel. Clean and neat, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。浅色净革与每侧两层鞍袋是辨识点；颜色不能偏紫或偏灰。

subject.zh: 一副风牙鞍具，侧面四分之三：厚实的灰褐角兽皮#7a5a40带粗毛边，鞍桥前立一截磨圆的短角；两侧各挂两只缀骨片的鞍袋，袋口垂红黄靛三色流苏；钟铜扣件#b08840，彩绳辔头挂在角上。骨角作，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A windfang saddle in side three-quarter view: thick grey-brown hornbeast hide #7a5a40 with a coarse hairy edge, a short rounded horn standing up at the front of the pommel; two saddlebags hung with bone chips on each side, with red, yellow and indigo tassels at their mouths; bronze fittings #b08840, and a coloured-cord bridle hooked over the horn. Bone-and-horn style, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。鞍前短角与三色流苏是辨识点；粗毛边角兽皮，与渊革鞍具的黑色区分。

subject.zh: 一副渊革鞍具，侧面四分之三：近黑的渊革#1e1a22泛暗紫光泽，高鞍背、深鞍座，两侧有护腿垫；每侧挂三只层叠的鞍袋，钟铜扣件#b08840；黑革辔头搭在鞍桥上。最高一档，皮面细腻有光，不加纹饰。
subject.en: An abyss leather saddle in side three-quarter view: near-black abyss leather #1e1a22 with a dark purple sheen, a high back and deep seat with thigh rolls on both sides; three stacked saddlebags hang on each side with bronze fittings #b08840; a black leather bridle is draped over the pommel. The top tier, the leather fine and lustrous, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。高鞍背加护腿垫、每侧三只鞍袋；暗紫只是皮面光泽，不画紫纹。

subject.zh: 一件平铺的皮马衣，四分之三俯视，颈、胸、臀三片相连：中褐皮革#8a5a34裁成大片，边缘缝一圈本色粗布#d8c8a8，片与片之间用皮条系连；皮面有几处补丁。最朴素一档，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A leather horse coat laid out flat in three-quarter view from above, neck, chest and rump pieces joined: broad panels of mid-brown leather #8a5a34 bordered with undyed coarse cloth #d8c8a8, the pieces tied together with leather thongs; a few patches on the leather. The plainest tier, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。必须平铺、三片相连的马铠形；软皮加布边，与毡甲马衣的绗缝区分。

subject.zh: 一件平铺的毡甲马衣，四分之三俯视，颈、胸、臀三片相连：厚实的灰米色毛毡#b8ac98绗成一格格菱形，边缘与接缝包深褐硬革条#6a4226，钉几颗铁扣。厚软实用，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A felt horse armour laid out flat in three-quarter view from above, neck, chest and rump pieces joined: thick grey-beige felt #b8ac98 quilted in a grid of diamonds, its edges and seams bound with dark brown hardened leather strips #6a4226 and set with a few iron buckles. Thick, soft and practical, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。菱格绗缝毛毡加硬革包边是辨识点；与皮马衣的单层皮区分。

subject.zh: 一件平铺的黑铁马铠，四分之三俯视，颈、胸、臀三片相连：近黑蓝灰的黑铁甲片#3c3f46一排排铆成，高光偏蓝，边缘露出一线灰米色毛毡衬里#b8ac98；颈片是一节节可弯的甲环。沉重，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A black-iron horse barding laid out flat in three-quarter view from above, neck, chest and rump pieces joined: rows of riveted near-black blue-grey black-iron plates #3c3f46 with bluish highlights, a thin line of grey-beige felt lining #b8ac98 showing at the edges; the neck piece is made of flexible segmented lames. Heavy, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。黑铁甲片铆成、边缘露毡衬；与鳞革马铠的绿鳞区分，铁蹄重骑套的马铠同此型。

subject.zh: 一件平铺的鳞革马铠，四分之三俯视，颈、胸、臀三片相连：青铜绿细鳞的鳞革#6a7a50层层叠覆，颈脊与胸前加精钢护板#a8b0bc，带刃口般的一线高光；边缘露出毛毡衬里。轻韧，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A scale-leather horse barding laid out flat in three-quarter view from above, neck, chest and rump pieces joined: overlapping layers of bronze-green fine-scale leather #6a7a50, with steel plates #a8b0bc along the neck ridge and across the chest showing one keen line of highlight; felt lining shows at the edges. Light and tough, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。绿色细鳞加精钢护板是辨识点；鳞片要细密，与黑铁马铠的大甲片区分。

subject.zh: 一件平铺的穹铁马铠，四分之三俯视，颈、胸、臀三片相连：灰白穹铁甲板#c8ccd8表面散着几粒星点般的亮斑，甲板间用近黑渊革带#1e1a22连缀，边缘露出毛毡衬里。最高一档，甲板宽大流畅，不加纹饰。
subject.en: A vault-iron horse barding laid out flat in three-quarter view from above, neck, chest and rump pieces joined: pale grey vault-iron plates #c8ccd8 sprinkled with a few star-like bright specks, joined by straps of near-black abyss leather #1e1a22, felt lining showing at the edges. The top tier, its plates broad and flowing, no decoration.

items.notes: 坐骑装具：阶由主料（皮、毡、黑铁、鳞革、穹铁）体现。灰白穹铁上的星点亮斑是辨识点；渊革只作连带，不画紫纹。

subject.zh: 一把直刃匕首，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刃尖在右上；钢灰刃身#9aa0aa，短护手，中褐皮缠柄#8a5a34；刃面素净，柄尾一颗圆铁钉，没有纹饰与光。
subject.en: A straight-bladed dagger at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and tip at upper right; steel-grey blade #9aa0aa, short guard, mid-brown leather-wrapped grip #8a5a34; a plain blade with one round iron rivet at the pommel, no decoration and no glow.

subject.zh: 一把单手直剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；钢灰剑身#9aa0aa，十字护手，皮缠握柄#8a5a34，圆柄头；剑身素面，护手是一根平直铁条，没有纹饰与光。
subject.en: A one-handed straight sword at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right; steel-grey blade #9aa0aa, cross guard, leather-wrapped grip #8a5a34, round pommel; a plain blade and a straight bar crossguard, no decoration and no glow.

subject.zh: 一把双手大剑，斜放45度占满整条对角线，长握柄在左下、剑尖在右上；宽阔钢灰剑身#9aa0aa，宽十字护手，长皮缠柄#8a5a34；剑身厚实素净，护手是两截方铁，没有纹饰与光。
subject.en: A two-handed greatsword at 45 degrees spanning the whole diagonal, long grip at lower left and point at upper right; broad steel-grey blade #9aa0aa, wide cross guard, long leather-wrapped grip #8a5a34; a thick plain blade, a guard of two square iron bars, no decoration and no glow.
