subject.zh: 一枚细长刃形纹片（像一截剑刃的薄片），斜放45度；黑石片身配银边#d0d4dc，中央嵌一颗同色小晶；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：三道纹像月下铺开的苔藓，中央小晶是一弯浅绿月牙。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A slim blade-shaped rune plate like a thin length of sword blade, set at 45 degrees; black stone body with a silver rim #d0d4dc and a small crystal of the glow color at the center; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: three lines like moss spreading under the moon, the central crystal a pale green crescent. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件深档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一枚细长刃形纹片（像一截剑刃的薄片），斜放45度；乌金片身配镀金边，中央晶石明亮，外缘一像素光晕；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：一根带新芽的枝条纹贯穿片身，枝上几片嫩叶向外舒展。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A slim blade-shaped rune plate like a thin length of sword blade, set at 45 degrees; dark gold-black body with a gilded rim, a bright central crystal and a one-pixel halo around the outline; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: a branch pattern with new buds running through the plate, a few young leaves unfolding outward. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件极档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一枚四角切圆的方形纹片，正面；素灰石板片身#8a8a8a，无边框；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：一道纹画出一片张开的叶子。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A square rune plate with rounded corners, front view; plain grey slate body #8a8a8a with no rim; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: one line tracing a single open leaf. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件浅档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一枚四角切圆的方形纹片，正面；黑石片身配银边#d0d4dc，中央嵌一颗同色小晶；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：三层树冠形纹罩住中央小晶，像林荫护着一颗种子。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A square rune plate with rounded corners, front view; black stone body with a silver rim #d0d4dc and a small crystal of the glow color at the center; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: three layers of canopy pattern sheltering the central crystal like woods guarding a seed. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件深档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一枚竖长方形纹片，正面；黑石片身配银边#d0d4dc，中央嵌一颗同色小晶；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：三道纹像风中扬起的长鬃，向一侧飘。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A tall rectangular rune plate, front view; black stone body with a silver rim #d0d4dc and a small crystal of the glow color at the center; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: three lines like a long mane lifting in the wind, streaming to one side. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件深档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一枚五指并拢的掌形纹片，正面；磨光深灰石片配一圈铜边#c87a48；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：两道纹像指尖渗出的毒藤，末端挂着绿滴。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A palm-shaped rune plate with the fingers together, front view; polished dark grey stone with a copper rim #c87a48; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: two lines like poison vines seeping from the fingertips with green drops at the ends. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件中档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一枚靴底形纹片，竖放；磨光深灰石片配一圈铜边#c87a48；片面的发光纹路是叶绿#5cb84a：两道纹像掠过地面的风痕，向后拖出细线。纹路是抽象图形，不像文字。
subject.en: A boot-sole-shaped rune plate standing upright; polished dark grey stone with a copper rim #c87a48; the glowing lines on its face are leaf green #5cb84a: two lines like wind marks skimming the ground, trailing thin streaks. The lines are abstract shapes, never letters.

items.notes: 附纹图标：形状按槽位、发光色按相（生相叶绿）、复杂度按档（本件中档）；同相同档只靠纹路图形区分，纹路要大而清楚。

subject.zh: 一把家传短剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。精钢短剑身#a8b0bc略宽，刃口保养干净；剑格两端微垂，正中一枚圆章，章面的蜿蜒溪流纹磨得几乎看不清，只剩一道暗一阶的细刻纹；握柄缠旧深蓝皮，柄首一颗圆铁球。不发光。
subject.en: A family shortsword lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. Slightly broad steel blade #a8b0bc with a well-kept clean edge; the crossguard droops a little at both ends and carries a round medallion whose winding stream pattern is worn almost invisible, leaving only one fine engraved line a shade darker; the grip is wrapped in old dark blue leather and the pommel is a round iron ball. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。圆章上的溪流纹要磨到几乎看不见；短而宽，与 eq_valen_knight_sword 清晰的溪流纹圆章长剑区分。

subject.zh: 一顶门铜战盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。暗金铜色门铜盔身#9a7840，盔沿整段弯成一道门楣似的拱弧压在眉上，拱弧两端落到颊甲上像两根门柱；多道刻纹顺盔脊走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光#f0d890，颈甲一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A gatebronze war helm in three-quarter front view, facing lower left. Dark gold-bronze gatebronze shell #9a7840; the whole brim curves into a lintel-like arch over the brow, its two ends coming down onto the cheek plates like a pair of door posts; several engraved lines run along the crest with the faintest door-gold glow #f0d890 in the grooves, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the neck guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。盔沿的门楣拱弧是辨识点，门扉金只在纹槽；与 eq_gate_guard_helm 的灰烬色闭面盔和门形冠板区分。

subject.zh: 一对门铜腿甲，正面，两条腿并列。暗金铜色门铜甲板#9a7840，两只膝甲上各浮出半截门纹：两道门柱立在一条门槛上，没有拱顶；甲板边缘刻纹相连，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光#f0d890，腰带扣上一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A pair of gatebronze greaves seen from the front, two legs side by side. Dark gold-bronze gatebronze plates #9a7840; each knee cop carries the lower half of a door pattern in relief, two door posts standing on a threshold with no arch above; linked engravings run along the plate edges with the faintest door-gold glow #f0d890 in the grooves, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the belt buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。膝甲只画门的下半截（门柱加门槛，不带拱顶）；暗金铜色，与 gen_plate_legs_q3 的钢灰腿甲区分。

subject.zh: 一只门铜手甲，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。暗金铜色门铜甲片#9a7840，每个指节做成一节门铰：圆筒铰轴穿着铰钉，两侧连着小铰板；手背方甲浮一道拱门纹，刻纹透极淡门扉金微光#f0d890，腕甲一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A single gatebronze gauntlet, back of the hand facing out and fingers toward upper right. Dark gold-bronze gatebronze plates #9a7840; every knuckle is made as a door hinge, a round barrel with a hinge pin through it and a small leaf plate on each side; the square back plate carries an arched door pattern, the engravings glow the faintest door-gold #f0d890, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the cuff.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。指节的圆筒门铰要清楚可数；与 eq_rustlock_sluice_gauntlets 的齿轮指节区分。

subject.zh: 一只门铜战靴，单只，侧前四分之三，鞋尖朝左下。暗金铜色门铜甲板#9a7840，靴头横包一道厚实的门槛形方条，靴底平直如门槛石；踝甲外侧浮一个小拱门纹，多道刻纹顺靴面走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光#f0d890，靴筒一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A single gatebronze sabaton in three-quarter front side view, toe toward lower left. Dark gold-bronze gatebronze plates #9a7840; a thick threshold-shaped bar wraps across the toe and the sole is flat like a doorsill stone; a small arched door pattern rises on the outer ankle plate, several engravings run over the boot with the faintest door-gold glow #f0d890, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the shaft.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。靴头横着的门槛形方条是辨识点；与 eq_forgewarden_feet 的砧形方靴头区分，颜色是暗金铜。

subject.zh: 一对门铜拳环，两只并排斜放，环口朝右上。每只是一个粗圆的暗金门铜门环#9a7840，上缘仍连着一小块拱形门环座，座心一颗圆钉；环底被敲得磨亮一块；多道古纹绕环走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光#f0d890，座背一枚门形几何匠记。
subject.en: A pair of gatebronze knuckle rings lying side by side at a slant, ring openings toward upper right. Each is a thick round dark gold-bronze door ring #9a7840 still joined at its top to a small arched knocker plate with a round stud in the middle; the bottom of each ring is worn bright from striking; old patterns circle the rings with the faintest door-gold glow #f0d890 in the grooves, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits on the back of a plate.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。必须是一对，各带拱形门环座；是拳环不是挂件，与 eq_myriad_door_knocker 的单只门环挂坠区分。

subject.zh: 一面门铜门板盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。盾形是一扇拱顶小门：深褐门木竖板#5a3a24拼成门心，门铜#9a7840包边，左侧两道长铰链，中央一只小门环；刻纹沿铜边走，纹槽透极淡门扉金微光#f0d890，下角一枚门形匠记。
subject.en: A gatebronze door-panel shield in a slightly overhead three-quarter view, face toward the viewer. The whole shield is a small arch-topped door: vertical dark brown gatewood planks #5a3a24 form the panel, gatebronze #9a7840 binds the edge, two long strap hinges run along the left side and a small door ring hangs at the centre; engravings follow the bronze rim with the faintest door-gold glow #f0d890, and a door-shaped geometric maker's mark sits in the lower corner.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。必须一眼看出是带铰链和门环的小门；与 eq_keyholder_tower_shield 的镂空窗洞塔盾区分。

subject.zh: 一枚谷穗坠，居中，上方带一小段麻系绳。一束金黄麦穗#d8b860编成紧实的辫状坠子，穗粒饱满，夹着几片灰褐谷壳；顶端用一枚发黄的长鼠门齿#d8c890横穿扎牢，齿面一道暗一阶的细刻纹。不发光。
subject.en: A grain-ear charm, centred, with a short hemp cord above. A bundle of golden wheat ears #d8b860 braided into a tight plaited pendant, plump grains mixed with a few grey-brown husks; at the top it is pinned and tied with a long yellowed rat incisor #d8c890 set crosswise, the tooth bearing one fine engraved line a shade darker. No glow.

items.notes: 品质语言（良品）：一道暗一阶的细刻纹，不发光。主体是编成辫的麦穗，鼠齿只是横穿的扣；与 mat_barley 的散穗和 cs_last_sheaf 的麦秆小人区分。

subject.zh: 一面锈母甲圆盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。盾面是一整块锈红甲壳#8a4a2a，排着一行行铆钉似的圆凸，正中一道焊缝般的隆脊；外圈铁边#7a7f88用粗钉钉住，锈只到边缘为止；刻纹顺隆脊散开，纹槽透极淡浅青微光，边上一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A rust-matron buckler in a slightly overhead three-quarter view, face toward the viewer. The face is a single piece of rust-red carapace #8a4a2a with rows of rivet-like round bumps and a weld-like ridge down the middle; an iron rim #7a7f88 is spiked on around it with heavy nails, and the rust stops cleanly at the rim; engravings spread from the ridge with the faintest pale cyan glow in the grooves, and a small maker's mark sits on the rim.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。甲壳正中的焊缝隆脊和成排圆凸是辨识点；锈色稳定不剥落，与 dented_round_shield 的木盾凹坑区分。

subject.zh: 一把头狼牙刀，斜放45度，握柄在左下、刀尖在右上。铁灰单刃刀身#7a7f88，刀背镶一根弯长黄獠牙，牙尖略越过刀尖；握柄裹黑灰狼皮，柄尾一撮赤黑硬鬃#5a1a16；多道刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，细暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过刀身，护手一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A den-alpha fang knife lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. Single-edged iron-grey blade #7a7f88 with a long curved yellowed fang set along its spine, the fang tip reaching a little past the point; the grip is wrapped in black-grey wolf hide with a tuft of red-black bristles #5a1a16 at the pommel; several engravings carry the faintest sediment-violet glow, fine dark violet veins #4a3a62 creep over the blade, and a small maker's mark sits on the guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。刀身是铁、獠牙镶在刀背；与 grey_fang_dagger 的整片兽牙刃区分。中澱纹只到细纹，不整片发紫。

subject.zh: 一顶豺母皮兜帽，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。灰黄豺皮#9a8a6a褪得斑驳，帽顶留着一对豺耳，一只直立、一只折下；帽檐镶一圈全白的口鼻短毛；多道压纹沿帽缘走，透极淡浅青微光，皮面几处灰中带紫的斑点，颈侧一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A jackal-matriarch hide hood in three-quarter front view, facing lower left. Faded, mottled grey-yellow jackal hide #9a8a6a with a pair of jackal ears kept on top, one upright and one folded down; the brim is trimmed with a band of short all-white muzzle fur; several pressed lines run along the edge with the faintest pale cyan glow, a few grey-violet spots show on the hide, and a small maker's mark sits at the side of the neck.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。一立一折的豺耳是辨识点；轻澱纹只几处斑点；与 eq_greymane_hunter_hood 的彩绘帽沿区分。

subject.zh: 一柄骨冢头骨锤，占满整条对角线，锤头在右上。锤头是一颗灰黄头骨#c8bfa8，眼窝与裂缝里灌满凝固的铁#4a4e55，铁箍箍住颅顶；长柄是一截断枪杆，缠着长骨与皮绳；多道刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过颅骨，柄尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A bonepile skull maul spanning the whole diagonal, head at upper right. The head is a grey-yellow skull #c8bfa8 whose eye sockets and cracks are filled with set iron #4a4e55, an iron band clamped round the crown; the long haft is a broken spear shaft lashed with long bones and leather cord; several engravings carry the faintest sediment-violet glow, dark violet veins #4a3a62 creep over the skull, and a small maker's mark sits at the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。眼窝里灌的铁要看得清；中澱纹只到细纹；与 eq_thousandbone_flail 的骨球、eq_locust_king_bone_staff 的虫首区分。

subject.zh: 一枚灶心石戒，倾斜约30度露出戒面。戒圈是一段弯成环的旧铁锅钩#4a4e55，戒托扣着一块熏黑的灶膛石#5a5450，石缝透一点暖橙#d8783a；多道细刻纹顺戒圈走，透极淡澱紫微光，细暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过戒托，内侧一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A hearthstone ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face. The band is an old iron pot hook #4a4e55 bent into a loop, and the setting clasps a soot-blackened hearth stone #5a5450 with a touch of warm orange #d8783a showing in its crack; fine engravings run round the band with the faintest sediment-violet glow, fine dark violet veins #4a3a62 creep over the setting, and a small maker's mark sits inside the band.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。熏黑灶石和石缝里一点暖橙是辨识点，暖橙不发火光；锅钩戒圈，与 gen_ring_q3 的宝石戒区分。

subject.zh: 一只白囊手套，单只，手背朝外，手指朝右上。瓷白软皮#ede8dc光滑如釉，手背与手指一圈圈整齐的节纹，节缝泛淡金#d8c27a，纹样左右对称；多道细纹透极淡浅青微光，一处节缝里藏着一线暗紫#4a3a62，腕口一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A single pale-sac glove, back of the hand facing out and fingers toward upper right. Porcelain-white soft hide #ede8dc smooth as glaze, ringed across the back and fingers by neat segment lines whose seams shine pale gold #d8c27a, the pattern perfectly symmetrical; several fine lines carry the faintest pale cyan glow, one seam hides a single thread of dark violet #4a3a62, and a small maker's mark sits at the cuff.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。要像圣物：瓷白、淡金、对称，暗紫只在一处节缝一线；不用神光白金，与 eq_morningdew_healer_gloves 区分。

subject.zh: 一方回音砚，四分之三俯视。长方的青黑砚石#3a3e44，砚头雕成一座小讲台的轮廓；砚池墨面荡着一圈圈细同心波纹，池边压着一角泛黄书页#d8d2c0；多道边纹透极淡浅青微光，石面几处灰中带紫的斑点，砚侧一枚小匠记。
subject.en: An echo inkstone seen in three-quarter view from above. A rectangular blue-black stone #3a3e44 whose head is carved into the outline of a small lectern; the ink in its well is stirred into fine concentric ripples, and a corner of yellowed page #d8d2c0 is pinned at the well's edge; several border lines carry the faintest pale cyan glow, a few grey-violet spots show on the stone, and a small maker's mark sits on its side.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。砚头小讲台和墨池同心波纹是辨识点，书页不画可读文字；与 eq_bellcave_humming_focus 的晶柱波纹区分。

subject.zh: 一顶烽燧战盔，四分之三侧前视，面朝左下。厚重的赭红将官闭面盔#8a4a30，眉檐一圈被烟熏得焦黑#2a2624，面甲开几道横窥缝；盔顶垂下一束长长的赭红缨；多道刻纹顺盔脊走，透极淡澱紫微光，暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过面甲，颈甲一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A beacon-lord great helm in three-quarter front view, facing lower left. A heavy ochre-red officer's closed helm #8a4a30 whose brow eave is smoked black all round #2a2624, the faceplate cut with several horizontal sight slits; a long ochre-red plume falls from the crown; several engravings run along the crest with the faintest sediment-violet glow, dark violet veins #4a3a62 creep over the faceplate, and a small maker's mark sits on the neck guard.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。熏黑的眉檐和长赭红缨是辨识点；与 eq_karl_northgate_helm 的短红缨钢盔、eq_gate_guard_helm 区分。

subject.zh: 一件宝窟锁板背心，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。无袖背心由一块块发绿的旧铜锁板#8a7a3a用铁环串成，每块正中一个钥匙孔；胸口挂一把大挂锁当扣；多道刻纹沿锁板走，透极淡浅青微光，几处灰中带紫的斑点，肩扣一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A hoard lockplate vest seen from the front, slightly from above, as if hung on an invisible stand, shoulders at the top. A sleeveless vest of greening old brass lock plates #8a7a3a linked by iron rings, a keyhole in the middle of each plate; a large padlock hangs at the chest as the clasp; engravings run along the plates with the faintest pale cyan glow, a few grey-violet spots show, and a small maker's mark sits on a shoulder buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。成排带钥匙孔的锁板和胸前大挂锁是辨识点；与 eq_catfish_king_scale_vest 的圆鳞背心区分。

subject.zh: 一柄渣心锤，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锤头在右上。锤头是一团冷却的黑灰炉渣#3a3634，表面玻璃化起泡，裂缝里残着一线暗橙#c8682a；铁箍把渣块箍在木柄上；多道刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，细暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过渣面，锤颈一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A slagheart hammer lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. The head is a lump of cooled black-grey slag #3a3634, glassy and blistered, with a thin line of dull orange #c8682a left in its cracks; iron bands clamp it onto a wooden haft; several engravings carry the faintest sediment-violet glow, fine dark violet veins #4a3a62 creep over the slag, and a small maker's mark sits on the neck.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。渣块锤头不规则，裂缝暗橙不发亮；有铁箍与柄，与 eq_wanderforge_hammer、mat_dross 的澱渣块区分。

subject.zh: 一根菌冠杖，斜放45度，握端在左下、杖头在右上。灰褐木杖缠细白菌丝，杖头长一朵层叠大伞菌，菌伞灰白#c9c1a0边缘翘成冠形，带橄榄绿霉斑#6b7f3a，伞下见细褶；多道刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬过杖身，杖尾一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A sporecap staff lying at 45 degrees, grip end at lower left and head at upper right. A grey-brown wooden shaft wound with fine white mycelium, topped by a large layered mushroom whose grey-white cap #c9c1a0 curls up at the rim like a crown, spotted with olive-green mould #6b7f3a, fine gills showing beneath; several engravings carry the faintest sediment-violet glow, dark violet veins #4a3a62 creep over the shaft, and a small maker's mark sits at the butt.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。杖头冠形大伞菌是辨识点；中澱纹只到细纹；与 eq_rootlace_staff 的根笼、eq_ola_sparrow_rattan_staff 区分。

subject.zh: 一只蝗囊护腕，单只，斜放，腕口朝左下。一节节风干的枯黄卵囊#c9c1a0并排缝在硬革底上，囊面带橄榄绿脉纹#6b7f3a，像一排鼓起的小豆荚；两条皮带扣住；多道压纹沿缝线走，透极淡浅青微光，几处灰中带紫的斑点，皮扣上一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A single locust-sac bracer lying at a slant, wrist opening toward lower left. Dried, withered-yellow egg sacs #c9c1a0 stitched side by side onto a hardened leather base, their surfaces veined olive green #6b7f3a like a row of swollen pods; two leather straps buckle it; pressed lines follow the seams with the faintest pale cyan glow, a few grey-violet spots show, and a small maker's mark sits on a buckle.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。并排鼓起的卵囊节是辨识点；画护腕不画手套，与 gen_leather_hands_q3 区分。

subject.zh: 一杆巢母角戟，占满整条对角线，戟头在右上。戟头是一块削成弯刃的暗红黑角核#5a1a16，刃根歪生短角芽，裂纹透赤红#b33a2a；黑铁长杆；暗紫纹路#4a3a62爬满戟头，边缘绕一圈淡淡暗雾，刻纹透极淡澱紫微光，杆箍一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A brood-horn glaive spanning the whole diagonal, head at upper right. The head is a dark red-black horn core #5a1a16 pared into a curved blade, crooked horn buds growing from its base and red #b33a2a showing in its cracks; long black-iron shaft; dark violet veins #4a3a62 cover the head, a faint dark mist rings its edge, the engravings carry the faintest sediment-violet glow, and a small maker's mark sits on the shaft collar.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。重澱纹：暗紫纹加边缘暗雾都要画；角核弯刃与歪角芽是辨识点，与 eq_balthazar_greywolf_glaive 区分。

subject.zh: 一枚云阶霜符，居中，上方一小段银灰细绳。一块透明的小方冰#d8eef4，里面冻着一片完整的冰蓝灰鳞#8a9aa8，鳞缘泛银；冰面结着细霜花，四角包薄银托；多道细纹透极淡冰蓝微光#a0d0f0，银托背面一枚小匠记。
subject.en: A cloudstep frost charm, centred, with a short silver-grey cord above. A small clear block of ice #d8eef4 with a single whole ice-blue-grey scale #8a9aa8 frozen inside, its rim silvered; fine frost flowers cover the ice and thin silver mounts wrap its four corners; fine lines carry the faintest ice-blue glow #a0d0f0, and a small maker's mark sits on the back of a mount.

items.notes: 品质语言（精品）：多道刻纹透极淡微光，带一枚小几何匠记。冰里冻着的一片完整鳞是辨识点；与 eq_elder_scale_shield 的整鳞盾、eq_cecilia_scale_brooch 区分。

subject.zh: 一柄慈烛锤，斜放45度，握柄在左下、锤头在右上。银棱锤头#d0d4dc；握柄整段封进白蜡#ece6d8，蜡面满是指捏痕，柄尾露一截白烛芯；锤颈一滴白蜡封，印烛焰对称纹；光纹布满锤头，透稳定的浅蓝柔光#b8d8f0，烛芯尖一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A mercy-candle mace lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A flanged silver head #d0d4dc; the whole grip is sealed in white wax #ece6d8 covered in finger-pressed marks, with a short white candle wick poking from the butt; a drop of white wax seal stamped with a symmetrical candle-flame pattern sits at the neck; light patterns cover the head with a steady pale blue glow #b8d8f0, and one single-pixel highlight sits at the wick tip.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。白蜡封柄、柄尾烛芯和锤颈烛焰蜡封是标志（守烛盾同用此蜡封）；不用神光白金与紫，与 eq_whitebell_silver_mace 区分。

subject.zh: 一面守烛盾，正面略俯视的四分之三视角，盾面朝向观者。白釉鸢盾#ece6d8包银边，盾心嵌一面锃亮圆银镜，泛一抹浅蓝；上缘一滴白蜡封，印烛焰对称纹；盾缘满是细刮痕，对称光纹布满盾面，透稳定的浅蓝柔光#b8d8f0，镜心一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A vigil-candle shield in a slightly overhead three-quarter view, face toward the viewer. A white-glazed kite shield #ece6d8 bound in silver, a brightly polished round silver mirror set in its centre with a touch of pale blue; a drop of white wax seal stamped with a symmetrical candle-flame pattern sits at the top edge; the rim is covered in fine scratches, symmetrical light patterns cover the face with a steady pale blue glow #b8d8f0, and one single-pixel highlight sits at the mirror's centre.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。盾心圆银镜与上缘烛焰蜡封是标志，镜里不画映出的景物；与 eq_kit_paladin 的金环鸢盾、eq_count_guard_kite 区分。

subject.zh: 一把无名剑，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。蓝灰澱钢剑身#5a6a80笔直无纹，剑面布满细密均匀的锤痕；一字黑铁护手#3c3f46与圆饼柄首不刻任何印记，柄缠素色深褐皮，握处已磨出浅痕；只在刃口透一线稳定的浅青柔光，剑尖一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A nameless sword lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. Straight, unadorned blue-grey diansteel blade #5a6a80, its flats covered in fine even hammer marks; the straight black-iron crossguard #3c3f46 and disc pommel carry no mark of any kind, and the grip is wrapped in plain dark brown leather already worn shallow where the hand sits; only a single line of steady pale cyan glow runs along the edge, with one single-pixel highlight at the point.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。必须像凡品：无纹无印无宝石，名器感只在刃口微光；靠蓝灰剑身和满面锤痕与 eq_leonhart_plain_sword 区分。

subject.zh: 一根千页录杖，斜放45度，握柄在左下、杖头在右上。深褐木杖身螺旋缠满几层泛黄纸带#e8dcc0，纸带排满极小的点线，尾端翘起像书页角；杖头银爪托一枚透明浅青录晶#a8e8e8；握处纸带磨得起毛，纹路透稳定的浅青柔光，晶尖一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A thousand-page record wand lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and head at upper right. A dark brown wooden shaft spiral-wrapped in several layers of yellowed paper tape #e8dcc0 lined with tiny dots and dashes, a few loose ends curling up like page corners; silver claws at the head hold a clear pale cyan record crystal #a8e8e8; the tape at the grip is rubbed fuzzy, the patterns carry a steady pale cyan glow, and one single-pixel highlight sits at the crystal tip.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。螺旋纸带与翘起的页角是标志，纸带只画点线，不画可读文字；与 eq_jonas_scribe_wand、eq_scriva_examiner_wand 区分。

subject.zh: 一张苍紫杉长弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。不上漆的红褐林紫杉弓臂#9a4a3a顺倒木天然的弯，弓面露出年轮，上臂留着天然木节；握把下苔绿绳扎一截拾来的细枝；年轮纹透稳定叶绿柔光#7ac060，握处磨亮，弓梢两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A pale-yew longbow, upright and slightly tilted, back of the bow facing left, string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. Unvarnished red-brown forest-yew limbs #9a4a3a follow the natural bend of the fallen tree, growth rings showing on the belly and a natural knot left on the upper limb; below the grip a short gathered twig is bound on with moss-green cord; the ring patterns carry a steady leaf-green glow #7ac060, the grip is worn bright, and two single-pixel highlights sit at the tips.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。握把下扎的拾来细枝是萨伦的标记（落枝传弓同用）；弓臂无锯痕；与 eq_greenstring_yew_longbow 的苍绿弦和绳结区分。

subject.zh: 一件月梭斗篷袍，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。浅蓝白林丝#d8e6ee轻薄带柔光，肩披及肘短斗篷，领口扣一只磨亮的新月形银织梭；下摆织一道起伏的波浪纹带；织纹布满袍身，透稳定的冰蓝柔光#a0d0f0，梭尖一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A moonshuttle mantle-robe seen from the front, slightly from above, as if hung on an invisible stand, shoulders at the top. Light, softly sheened pale blue-white forest silk #d8e6ee with an elbow-length short cape over the shoulders, fastened at the collar by a crescent-shaped silver weaving shuttle worn bright with handling; a rising and falling wave band is woven along the hem; woven patterns cover the robe with a steady ice-blue glow #a0d0f0, and one single-pixel highlight sits at the shuttle tip.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。领口新月银织梭与下摆起伏波纹是标志，波纹不画成音符；与 eq_silvermoss_forestsilk_robe 的浅绿垂苔袍区分。

subject.zh: 一只冷锤拳套，单只，拳面朝右上，指节护甲清楚。多角夜铁甲片#26232a不反光，锤面泛冷灰蓝光泽#8a96a8；每个指节一格空白方框槽；拳背一枚短角，腕口暗红皮带磨亮；刻纹布满甲面透稳定火橙柔光，夹细暗紫纹路#4a3a62，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A single coldhammer gauntlet, fist facing upper right, knuckle armour clear. Many-angled nightiron plates #26232a with no shine, the hammered faces carrying a cold blue-grey sheen #8a96a8; each knuckle bears one empty framed square slot; a short horn sits on the back of the fist and the dark red cuff strap is worn bright; engravings cover the plates with a steady fire-orange glow threaded with fine dark violet veins #4a3a62, and two highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。指节上的空白方框槽是标志，槽里不画刻痕；与 eq_edgetrial_duel_fists 的角刺、eq_redfang_iron_fists 区分。

subject.zh: 一张千刻角弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。短反曲复合弓，弓臂贴满一列骨白角片#d8ccb0，每片刻一幅极小的图画，握把旁那片最新最白；弓梢缠红黄靛三色绳，握把刻一枚分叉鹿角小记；刻痕透稳定的浅青柔光，握处磨亮，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A thousand-carving horn bow, upright and slightly tilted, back of the bow facing left, string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. A short recurved composite bow whose limbs are covered in a row of bone-white horn plates #d8ccb0, each carved with a tiny picture, the plate beside the grip the newest and whitest; red, yellow and indigo cords wrap the tips and a small forked-antler mark is carved on the grip; the carvings carry a steady pale cyan glow, the grip is worn bright, with two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。一列各刻小图的角片与握把旁最新那片是标志，图不画可读文字；鹿角小记霍娅三件共用；与 eq_fangmouth_tribute_bow 区分。

subject.zh: 一枚祖灵骨饰，居中，上方一小段红黄靛三色编绳。一块椭圆骨片#e0d8c0，从中心向外刻一道细密的螺旋槽；骨片下垂两颗骨珠，背缘刻一枚分叉鹿角小记；骨面被摩挲得温润，螺旋槽透稳定的浅青柔光，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: An ancestor-spirit bone charm, centred, with a short braided red, yellow and indigo cord above. An oval bone plaque #e0d8c0 carved with one fine, tight spiral groove running out from its centre; two bone beads hang below it and a small forked-antler mark is carved on its back edge; the bone is rubbed smooth and warm, the spiral groove carries a steady pale cyan glow, with two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。骨面一道螺旋细槽是标志，不能像字；与 eq_ossuary_porcelain_charm 的白瓷水滴、eq_ancestor_bone_bell 区分。

subject.zh: 一只千刻战号，横放略斜，号口朝右。一整根向前弯的粗角兽角，从深褐#5a4632渐到号口的象牙白，号身刻满一列列细小刻痕；吹口包一圈骨箍，背带是红黄靛三色编绳；号口边刻一枚分叉鹿角小记；刻痕透稳定的浅青柔光，号口被摸亮，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A thousand-carving war horn lying sideways at a slight slant, bell to the right. One whole thick, forward-curving hornbeast horn shading from dark brown #5a4632 to ivory at the bell, its body carved with column after column of tiny notches; a bone ring binds the mouthpiece and the carrying strap is braided red, yellow and indigo cord; a small forked-antler mark is carved by the bell; the carvings carry a steady pale cyan glow, the bell is rubbed bright, with two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。号身刻痕不画可读文字；不嵌晶不包银；与 mt_command_horn 的银箍晶口、rl_brokenhorn_bugle 的黑角铁箍区分。

subject.zh: 一枚清渣戒，倾斜约30度露出戒面。方正厚重的黑铁戒圈#3c3f46，戒肩各压金色锤砧小纹#d8a840；方托四爪扣一粒净过的渣珠，灰白半透明#c8ccc8，内封细小气泡；戒圈边角磨圆，刻纹布满戒圈透稳定的浅青柔光，渣珠一颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A clear-slag ring tilted about 30 degrees to show its face. A square, heavy black-iron band #3c3f46 with a small gold hammer-and-anvil emblem #d8a840 pressed on each shoulder; a square four-claw setting holds a purified slag bead, translucent grey-white #c8ccc8 with tiny bubbles sealed inside; the band's corners are worn round, engravings cover it with a steady pale cyan glow, and one single-pixel highlight sits on the bead.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。渣珠干净半透明，不发黑不加紫；与 mat_dross 的澱渣块、本批 eq_empty_house_hearth_ring 的灶石区分。

subject.zh: 一把无主之刃，斜放45度，握柄在左下、剑尖在右上。剑身由无数断刃碎片熔成，钢灰铁黑暗铜色块交错如裂冰#8a8e94，碎片间露出旧刃尖与刃口；熔缝透稳定的浅青柔光，夹细暗紫纹路#4a3a62；护手素铁，握柄裸铁未缠、崭新无痕，两颗单像素亮点。
subject.en: A masterless blade lying at 45 degrees, grip at lower left and point at upper right. The blade is fused from countless broken-blade shards, steel-grey, iron-black and dark bronze patches interlocking like cracked ice #8a8e94, old tips and old edges faintly showing between the fragments; the fusion seams carry a steady pale cyan glow threaded with fine dark violet veins #4a3a62; plain iron guard, the grip bare unwrapped iron, brand new and unmarked, with two single-pixel highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（名器）：长年使用痕迹加满布柔光纹与单像素亮点，有专属标志。从没被握过：握柄裸铁无磨痕，名器感在熔缝柔光；碎片乱如裂冰，与 eq_outsider_gate_blade 的分段拼锻区分。

subject.zh: 一副守约炉心甲，正面略俯视，像挂在看不见的人台上，肩部在上。通体炉心金板甲#e0a030方正厚重，铆钉排成矿纹；护心方火玉外绕一圈相扣的方链浮雕；领口一枚白砧小印，护心旁被手按亮；刻纹透稳定火橙柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素火橙光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: An oathkeeper forgeheart cuirass seen from the front, slightly from above, as if hung on an invisible stand, shoulders at the top. Square, heavy plate made wholly of deep orange-gold forgeheart gold #e0a030, rivets set in an ore-vein pattern; a square fire jade at the heart is framed by a relief of interlocking square chain links; a small white-anvil stamp sits at the collar and the plate beside the jade is pressed bright by hands; engravings carry a steady fire-orange glow, with a partial one-pixel fire-orange halo outside the outline and two highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。护心火玉外一圈扣链浮雕与领口白砧小印是标志；通体炉心金，与 eq_deephammer_chest、eq_forgepact_chest 区分。

subject.zh: 一张落枝传弓，竖向略斜，弓背朝左、弦在右，上梢略向右倾。整根银白世界树落枝#e8e4d8，握处留一段灰褐原皮，挂弦处是天然留下的短侧枝，上梢分叉托两片嫩叶；握把下扎一截拾来细枝；年轮纹透稳定叶绿柔光，轮廓外缘局部一像素叶绿光晕，两颗亮点。
subject.en: A fallen-branch heirloom bow, upright and slightly tilted, back of the bow facing left, string on the right, upper limb leaning a little right. One whole silver-white world-tree branch #e8e4d8 keeping a strip of grey-brown bark at the grip; the string hangs on two short side shoots left naturally at the ends, and the upper tip forks to hold two young leaves; a short gathered twig is bound below the grip; growth-ring patterns carry a steady leaf-green glow, with a partial one-pixel leaf-green halo outside the outline and two highlights.

items.notes: 品质语言（传器）：名器之上再加轮廓外局部一像素光晕，造型独一无二。挂弦的天然侧枝与上梢两片叶是标志，握把下细枝同苍紫杉长弓；与 eq_worldtree_fallen_bow、eq_first_string_bow 区分。

subject.zh: 一捆帝国弩手军械，正面四分之三俯视：亮钢灰锁子甲#a8b0bc叠成方包，包后立一面精钢圆盾，盾心压一枚剑冠形几何纹；一张绞盘弩斜插过包，弩尾带绞盘摇柄；深红皮带#7a2a2a交叉扎紧，包缘无字编号刻痕，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled imperial crossbowman kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: bright steel-grey mail #a8b0bc folded into a square pack, a steel round shield standing behind it with a sword-and-crown geometric emblem pressed into its boss; a windlass crossbow is thrust slantwise through the pack, the winding crank at its butt; deep red straps #7a2a2a cross over it, unlettered serial notches mark the pack edge, and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。弩尾绞盘与圆盾剑冠纹是辨识点，编号刻痕不画数字；亮钢锁甲，与 eq_kit_dwarf_arbalest 的黑铁矿纹包区分。

subject.zh: 一捆攻城弩车组军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成方包，两肩缝着加厚的拖拽垫肩；一把精钢短剑#a8b0bc斜插过包，剑格方正；深红皮带#7a2a2a交叉扎紧，包缘一排无字编号刻痕，挂一块空白木签。军坊作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled ballista crew kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a square pack, thickened hauling pads sewn on both shoulders; a steel shortsword #a8b0bc with a square guard is thrust slantwise through the pack; deep red straps #7a2a2a cross over it, a row of unlettered serial notches marks the pack edge, and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Legion workshop style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。只画炮组一人的短剑与皮甲，不画弩车；厚垫肩与深红皮带是辨识点，与 eq_kit_city_guard 的锁甲圆盾区分。

subject.zh: 一捆投石机组军械，正面四分之三俯视：深褐硬革甲#6a4226叠成方包，前襟与护臂缝着几块厚皮补垫；一柄精钢钉锤#a8b0bc斜插过包，锤头一圈方钉；一条白皮带与一条深红皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled trebuchet crew kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: dark brown hardened leather armour #6a4226 folded into a square pack, a few thick leather pads sewn over the front and the arm guards; a steel spiked mace #a8b0bc with a ring of square studs on its head is thrust slantwise through the pack; one white strap and one deep red strap cross over it, and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。白与深红两色皮带表示白冕作与军坊作都出；不画投石机；与 eq_kit_zealot 的白布袍钉锤区分。

subject.zh: 一捆审判官军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成方包，包顶扣一顶黑铁锁头巾，脸前垂一片只留眼缝的锁片；一柄法冠形锤头的战锤斜插过包；浅奶褐净革皮带#c8a878交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。白冕作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled inquisitor kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a square pack, a black-iron mail coif set on top with a veil of mail over the face that leaves only an eye slit; a war hammer with a mitre-shaped head is thrust slantwise through the pack; pale cream purified-leather straps #c8a878 cross over it, and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Whitecrown style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。包顶只留眼缝的锁头巾是辨识点，无盾；不画照纹灯；与 eq_kit_paladin 的白漆鸢盾、eq_kit_war_priest 区分。

subject.zh: 一捆晶炮炮组军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁锁甲#3c3f46叠成矮宽方包，包缘铆钉排成矿纹；一柄短柄黑铁锤斜插过包，锤头一端方平、一端是圆饼形的夯头；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。深锤作方正厚重，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled crystal-cannon crew kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: black-iron mail #3c3f46 folded into a low, wide square pack, the rivets on its edge set in an ore-vein pattern; a short-handled black-iron hammer is thrust slantwise through the pack, one end of its head flat and square, the other a round disc-shaped tamping head; straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Deephammer style, square and heavy, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。圆饼夯头短锤是辨识点，不画炮体与晶；与 eq_kit_siege_engineer 的撬镐长锤、eq_kit_dwarf_arbalest 区分。

subject.zh: 一捆符文匠师军械，正面四分之三俯视：方正的黑铁胸甲#3c3f46叠成厚包，包顶扣一顶方盔；包后立一面黑铁塔盾，上缘做成砧面的轮廓，铆钉排成矿纹；一柄黑铁钉锤斜插过包；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled runesmith kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a square black-iron breastplate #3c3f46 folded into a thick pack with a square helm set on top; a black-iron tower shield stands behind it, its top edge shaped like an anvil face and its rivets set in an ore-vein pattern; a black-iron spiked mace is thrust slantwise through the pack; straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。塔盾上缘的砧面轮廓是辨识点；没有腿甲，不画小砧工具；与 eq_kit_dwarf_heavy 的火玉护心区分。

subject.zh: 一捆德鲁伊军械，正面四分之三俯视：浅奶褐净革甲#c8a878叠成方包；一根不上漆的红褐林紫杉长者杖#9a4a3a斜插在包上，杖头分出一根冒新芽的细枝；苔绿皮带交叉扎紧，结里别着一小簇苔藓与白色小花，挂一块空白木签。倒木作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled druid kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: pale cream purified leather armour #c8a878 folded into a square pack; an unvarnished red-brown forest-yew elder staff #9a4a3a is thrust slantwise through the pack, a thin twig with new buds branching from its head; moss-green straps cross over it with a little tuft of moss and small white flowers tucked into the knot, and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Fallenwood style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。杖头新芽与带结里的苔花是辨识点；不加紫；与 eq_kit_dian_hunter 的净革包加黑铁大斧区分。

subject.zh: 一捆兽伴游猎者军械，正面四分之三俯视：浅奶褐净革甲#c8a878叠成方包，一双净革靴绑在包顶；一张灰皮木复合短弓#8a8680斜插在包上，两梢反曲，套着骨白角片；青灰与苔绿两色绳交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled beastbond ranger kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: pale cream purified leather armour #c8a878 folded into a square pack with a pair of purified leather boots tied on top; a short ashbark composite bow #8a8680 with recurved, bone-white horn-capped tips is thrust slantwise through the pack; blue-grey and moss-green cords cross over it, and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。反曲的灰皮木短弓是辨识点；不画伴兽；与 eq_kit_hunters 的深色直长弓、eq_kit_remnant_scout 的匕首区分。

subject.zh: 一捆晨露治疗者军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件浅水青白的丝法袍#d8ece8叠成软包，袍面一道柔光；包前绑着一只浅口木碗，碗沿镶一圈冷白月银#e0e8f0；苔绿细带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。没有武器，倒木作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled dewmender kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a pale water-green-white silk robe #d8ece8 folded into a soft pack with a sheen across it; a shallow wooden bowl rimmed with cold white moonsilver #e0e8f0 is strapped to the front; thin moss-green straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No weapon, fallenwood style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。包前月银镶边木碗是辨识点，碗不发光；没有武器；与本批 eq_kit_field_medics 的灰蓝袍、eq_kit_night_caster 区分。

subject.zh: 一捆灵语者军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件青灰丝法袍#7a8a8a叠成软包，袍面一道柔光；一根红褐紫杉长者杖#9a4a3a斜插在包上，杖头雕成一截小图腾柱，叠几张几何脸，眼窝嵌黑曜石#1e1a22；苔绿皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled spirit-tongue kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a blue-grey silk robe #7a8a8a folded into a soft pack with a sheen across it; a red-brown forest-yew elder staff #9a4a3a is thrust slantwise through the pack, its head carved into a small totem pole of stacked geometric faces with obsidian #1e1a22 set in the eye sockets; moss-green straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No engraving, no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。杖头小图腾柱是辨识点，脸要几何简化；与 eq_kit_night_caster 的黑曜尖棱杖头、本批德鲁伊新芽杖区分。

subject.zh: 一捆兽王卫军械，正面四分之三俯视：黑铁胸甲、腿甲与盔#3c3f46叠成厚包；包后立一面黑铁塔盾，盾面缠满七色彩绳，上缘两角各套一枚弯兽角；一柄宽刃黑铁战斧斜插过包；皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。骨角作，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled beastking guard kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a black-iron breastplate, greaves and helm #3c3f46 stacked into a thick pack; a black-iron tower shield stands behind it, its face wound all over with cords of seven colours and a curved beast horn capping each top corner; a broad-bladed black-iron war axe is thrust slantwise through the pack; straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Bonehorn style, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。盾面七色彩绳与上缘两枚兽角是辨识点；与 eq_kit_hornbeast_rider 的三色绳、eq_kit_oni_infantry 的双角盔区分。

subject.zh: 一捆契约术士军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件炭黑丝法袍#2a2426滚暗红边，叠成软包；一根学士录杖斜插在包上；一条黑铁细链代替皮带斜缠过包，链端坠一颗浑浊灰小晶#8a8a90，晶芯一缕暗紫；挂一块空白木签。不反光，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled pact warlock kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a charcoal-black silk robe #2a2426 edged in dark red, folded into a soft pack; a scholar's record wand is thrust slantwise through it; a thin black-iron chain wraps diagonally across the pack in place of a strap, and a small cloudy grey crystal #8a8a90 with a wisp of dark violet at its core hangs from its end; a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. Matte, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。链端未净灰晶是辨识点，轻澱只在晶芯一缕暗紫；与 eq_kit_battle_mage 的深红袍和黑曜灯区分。

subject.zh: 一捆无旗医队军械，正面四分之三俯视：一件浅灰蓝细布法袍#a8b4c0叠成软包，一双深褐硬革靴#6a4226绑在包顶；包身中段套一条素白臂带，上面什么纹也没有；深蓝皮带交叉扎紧，挂一块空白木签。没有武器，无纹无光。
subject.en: A bundled field medics kit seen from the front in three-quarter view from above: a pale grey-blue fine cloth robe #a8b4c0 folded into a soft pack with a pair of dark brown hardened leather boots #6a4226 tied on top; a plain white armband bearing no mark of any kind is looped round the middle of the pack; dark blue straps cross over it and a blank wooden tag hangs at the side. No weapon, no engraving and no glow.

items.notes: 军械套：凡、良、精三档共用此图标，品质由界面边框表示，图上不加品质装饰。素白臂带完全空白，不画神纹与徽记；不画药箱；与 eq_kit_zealot 的白袍布章区分。
